nodes.name: Dependency-closed certificate shards with selective repair

mathematical_basis.known_method: Proof-carrying artifacts and modular skeptical checking: each admitted inference consumes propositions with explicit contexts and produces a proposition with a checked local witness.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Represent a mathematical response as a bounded DAG of certificate shards. Every shard carries statement-AST hash, assumption-context hash, branch scope, checker kind/version, witness, and dependency IDs. The host computes the backward closure of each requested conclusion and refuses a global certified label if any required shard is open, stale, ill-scoped, or merely numerical. Spend the second model call on the smallest deterministic failed dependency frontier, while preserving all unaffected shards.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: For a checked rule Gamma |- (P1 and ... and Pk) implies Q, Q can be closed only if all Pi are closed under compatible Gamma and branch scope. Residual(Q) includes every unclosed dependency and every explicit rule premise. Graph closure by itself is bookkeeping; the inference rule and semantic encoding still require a trusted checker or a residual marker.

assumptions: The public requested-conclusion inventory is separately fixed; the model may not delete requested sinks to improve apparent coverage.
A frozen finite inference-rule registry and parsers exist. New symbolic or analytic rules remain OPEN rather than inheriting a stronger label.
Exact checking is sound for its implemented fragment, and certificate/hash binding uses the intended serialization.
Initial pilot cap: at most 24 shards, 48 dependency edges, and 4 branch scopes; out-of-bound artifacts are incomplete rather than silently truncated.
nodes.hypothesis: At matched total token and dollar budgets, dependency-closed shards plus one frontier repair reduce accepted-but-unsupported conclusions relative to a whole-answer critique, without a material loss of final answer completeness.
typed_inputs: SeedBytes{utf8_bytes,sha256}; original seed bytes repeated unchanged in each model call
typed_outputs: FinalResponse{answer_text,claim_to_shard_map,residual_obligations}; mathematical content is generated only in a future experiment

stages.instruction: Hash seed bytes; preserve them as a separate unchanged message. Freeze requested sinks, inference registry, resource caps, and price metadata. Read no private evaluator material.

Produce the requested derivation and bounded typed shard DAG. State every assumption, domain condition, and dependency. Supply witnesses only in the allowed kinds. Label unsupported analytic claims OPEN; never declare your own host verdict. Preserve all requested conclusion IDs.

stages.role: Exact local checking and residual propagation
stages.instruction: Check schema, binding, acyclicity, contexts, local witnesses, and conclusion closure. Compute the first failed frontier in deterministic sink/ID order. Return only allowlisted public failure classes and artifact-local pointers, never private diagnostic text or expected answers.

Patch only named failed shards and downstream prose references. Do not change immutable seed, requested sink inventory, registry, or untouched shard hashes. Provide explicit residuals if the frontier cannot be closed within the allowed rule set.

Recheck changed shards and their descendants; never accept stale receipts. Freeze final output and cost receipt. Separate exact identities, admitted theorem applications, numerical checks, and open obligations. Trusted private evaluation occurs only after freezing and cannot trigger another stage.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Two-call draft plus whole-answer self-critique with the same total output cap, model endpoint, immutable seed, and public checking budget.
ablations: Typed shards without dependency/context closure
Full-answer rewrite instead of frontier repair
Closure ledger without a second call
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Freeze paired configurations before runs. On public synthetic certificate fixtures, measure corrupted-parent propagation, missing-premise detection, and valid-control preservation. On separately scored final answers, record completeness, unsupported certification, aggregate cost, and abstention. PCIV selection/confirmation is an offline experiment step; no seed feedback returns to model calls.

nodes.falsification: Reject the claimed advantage if matched-budget final correctness does not improve, if completeness declines beyond the preregistered tolerance, or if any deliberately corrupted required parent still produces a closed requested sink. A common-mode checker bug is a falsification of the checker contract, not evidence against the underlying mathematics.
risks: The model can omit a semantic premise even when its graph is syntactically complete; a host sink/rule inventory is necessary.
Token overhead can crowd out the derivation. Coverage must be measured alongside false-acceptance reduction.
A shared erroneous parser can validate both the claim and witness. Positive/negative controls do not prove parser adequacy.
Public host feedback may reveal mathematical structure; this is allowed only when derived from declared public predicates, never the answer key.
nodes.budget_formula: C_max <= 14000*p_in + 4400*p_out + sum(F_s) + R, two calls and zero retries. At the conditional thresholds p_in=0.000001, p_out=0.000005, F_s=0, R=0.01, reserve USD 0.046. Refuse if actual tokenization or current prices exceed the reservation.

nodes.name: Definedness certificates with exhaustive branch coverage

mathematical_basis.known_method: Partial-function definedness obligations, proof by cases, and exact Boolean/polynomial reasoning.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Make every division, logarithm, square root, inverse, and earliest-attainment assertion produce a typed domain obligation before it can contribute to a global answer. Require an explicit complement branch for any guarded formula. The host separately checks coverage, branch compatibility, and local definedness; it does not infer branch correctness from prose saying 'by continuity'.
mathematical_basis.obligations: For public domain D and branch guards B_i, certify D implies OR_i B_i and pairwise disjointness, or provide overlap-agreement certificates. For expression e_i, certify D and B_i implies Defined(e_i). A limit-extension is a distinct witness kind and cannot be replaced by substitution into an undefined term.
mathematical_basis.bounded_checker_fragment: Boolean partitions over at most 8 declared atoms can be enumerated exactly. Such enumeration proves propositional coverage for every valuation, not real feasibility. Algebraic implications require an independently checked witness; univariate rational cases may use Sturm certificates with explicit endpoints. Multivariate/transcendental implications remain residual unless an additional verified checker is supplied.

assumptions: A strict expression AST exposes every partial operator and rejects unsupported function syntax rather than treating it as total.
The public domain and variable sorts are fixed from the seed without adding answer-derived restrictions.
The pilot admits at most 8 domain atoms and 16 branches; more complex answers are reported incomplete.
Global answer correctness includes requested exceptional cases, not merely the generic branch.
nodes.hypothesis: One-call derivation with mechanically extracted definedness obligations and explicit complement branches reduces exceptional-case and undefined-expression errors more efficiently than a generic 'check edge cases' instruction.

stages.role: Seed binder and domain registry gate
stages.instruction: Preserve exact seed bytes in a separate message. Supply only operator semantics, schema, and public assumptions. Pin prices and the single-call reservation.

Return the requested derivation with typed guards and definedness witnesses. For each partial operator, state its domain. Every excluded guard requires a complement branch or an explicit unresolved obligation. Distinguish substitution from a proved limiting extension. Separate existence of an optimum from a claim about the earliest attaining argument.

Extract partial operators from ASTs, check declared branches cover the public domain, and dispatch only supported exact witnesses. Flag missing or incompatible branches and unsupported implication proofs. Generate synthetic mutations of these public artifacts by dropping a complement, weakening a guard, or changing an endpoint; do not mutate the seed and do not use private benchmark labels.

Freeze answer, branch receipt, mutation-control results, and usage receipt. Certification labels describe only checked coverage and definedness. Private answer evaluation remains separate with no repair feedback.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Single call with the same 4000-token cap and explicit natural-language edge-case instructions but no typed branch schema.
ablations: Branch list without host coverage check
Coverage check without extracted partial-operator obligations
Definedness checks without complement branches
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Use answer-independent synthetic fixtures with removable and non-removable singularities, empty attainment sets, constant functions, and overlapping branches. Measure missed undefined nodes, missing-domain regions, false rejection of valid branch encodings, final completeness, and per-run cost. The seed is one separately frozen evaluation target, not enough evidence for a general improvement claim.

nodes.falsification: A dropped required complement branch accepted as globally covered falsifies the coverage checker. No matched-budget improvement on exceptional-case error rate, or a completeness loss that cancels the gains, falsifies the workflow hypothesis. Passing Boolean coverage cannot count as verifying a real-arithmetic guard implication.
risks: A generic symbolic simplifier may silently cancel a denominator and erase the original definedness requirement.
Atom explosion exceeds the finite partition cap; fail explicitly rather than prune cases without evidence.
Analytic continuations, extrema, and transcendental signs need more than rational arithmetic.
The model may place important formulas only in prose, bypassing AST checks; unlinked prose must remain unchecked.
nodes.budget_formula: C_max <= 10000*p_in + 4000*p_out + F_1 + R, one call and zero retries. Conditional thresholds give USD 0.040 including the USD 0.01 reserve.

nodes.name: Witnessed representation transport at proof interfaces

mathematical_basis.known_method: Compositional certifying transformations and preservation proofs between mathematical representations.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Require an explicit transport witness whenever a derivation changes coordinate convention, basis ordering, tensor-factor order, polynomial encoding, or exact-number codec. A second bounded model call produces only missing transport witnesses from the first candidate. A host checks a commuting relation between source and destination representations and binds every downstream claim to the verified convention context.
mathematical_basis.transport_rule: For source object x, destination object y, and declared map T, check y=T(x), the map's admitted properties, and the theorem justifying transport of predicate P to P'. If a reversible change is claimed, also check an inverse witness. For finite rational matrix examples, check dimensions, exact equalities, and the required inverse or orthogonality identities. Predicate preservation is separate from equality of serialization hashes.
mathematical_basis.effect_rule: Each operad edge consumes a ConventionContext hash and produces one; unproved convention changes produce residual obligations. Scope cannot strengthen from numeric spot-check to exact identity, from exact instance to universal parameter claim, or from representation equivalence to physical interpretation.

assumptions: Source objects and conventions must be bound to the public task, not merely to two mutually consistent model artifacts.
A finite transport registry is fixed in advance; the pilot accepts only explicit permutations, declared exact codec maps, and bounded rational matrix identities.
Any required complex, multivariate, or analytic transport without an implemented checker is reported open.
Different syntactic representations and two model calls do not imply independent errors.
nodes.hypothesis: At matched two-call cost, transport witnesses detect convention drift and invalid claim reuse more reliably than asking a second model pass to judge whether the answer looks consistent.

stages.instruction: Keep the exact seed bytes as a separate message. Freeze the public convention schema, admitted transport registry, and two-call reservation. Do not provide solved seed objects or private formulas.

Produce the requested derivation. Give every object its dimensions, variable sorts, and convention-context ID. Mark each representation change as an edge with source and target hashes; identify the mathematical property that must survive that change.

Type-check the candidate and select at most four unresolved transport edges by fixed source order. Provide source/target artifacts and required witness schema only. No private scores or expected corrected expressions enter the request.

Supply explicit maps, inverse witnesses where needed, and preservation-rule applications for the selected edges. Do not approve the answer by agreement. Do not silently alter source objects. Return OPEN when no admitted witness applies.

Check every claimed transport under its context and scope; invalidate dependent reuse when an edge fails. Use public synthetic permutation/codec/transpose mutations as finite controls. Freeze final answer, open interfaces, and cost receipts before separate private scoring.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Two-call derivation plus consistency review at equal 4000-token total output cap and identical endpoint configuration.
ablations: Context IDs with no transport witness
Witness equality checks without predicate-preservation obligations
Transport checks without source-to-public-task binding
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Pair runs by task and repetition; include public synthetic changes of basis order, tensor-factor order, exact-number codec, and matrix transposition. Measure convention-error detection, false rejection, complete final correctness, and cost. Offline PCIV selection uses frozen receipts and an independent confirmation split.

nodes.falsification: The mechanism fails if a source/target pair with a deliberately incorrect transport map is admitted, or if a correct transport of the wrong public-task object is promoted to a correct task answer. The practical hypothesis fails if transport overhead does not improve matched-budget final accuracy or convention-error detection.
risks: Two incorrect encodings may agree; explicit source-task binding is still required.
A map can preserve algebraic form while changing semantic interpretation; the preservation theorem must match the intended predicate.
Existing RationalWire and Q codecs differ, so implicit parser interchange would create false agreement or unnecessary rejection.
The bounded four-edge witness budget can leave interfaces open; an honest partial receipt is not a complete solution.
nodes.budget_formula: C_max <= 12000*p_in + 4000*p_out + sum(F_s) + R, two calls and zero retries. Conditional thresholds give USD 0.042 including the USD 0.01 reserve.

nodes.name: Dual-panel negative selection with finite defect coverage

mathematical_basis.known_method: Negative selection screens out self-reactive detectors; metamorphic testing supplies related controls; finite set cover selects a bounded family covering declared defect examples.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Have a seed-free model propose at most 12 bounded AST detector rules from public development controls. Test the exact runtime matcher on paired benign and contract-invalid mutations. Select the smallest self-tolerant subset covering every required calibration family; then test that frozen subset once on untouched confirmation controls. Preserve an adequacy vector by family instead of converting panel success into a general correctness score. A second call constructs the task answer with the frozen warning schema, and the host reports hits and uncovered families without issuing a truth verdict.
mathematical_basis.finite_contract: For benign controls B, defect controls M partitioned into nonempty families M_f, and detector set S: FP_B(S)=sum_b 1[exists d in S: d(b)=1]; C_f(S)=sum_m in M_f 1[exists d in S: d(m)=1]/|M_f|. Enumerate subsets of at most 12 rules and lexicographically minimize (|S|, canonical_ids) subject to FP_B(S)=0 and C_f(S)=1 on calibration. No feasible set produces INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE. Confirmation failures produce UNCONFIRMED and no reselection. These are exact finite counts, not distributional bounds.
mathematical_basis.semantic_boundary: Mutation labels mean valid or invalid for the declared artifact contract. Removing a premise or domain guard does not automatically prove the underlying conclusion false. An independently specified checker must establish every label; unknown labels are excluded and recorded. A hit is a diagnostic hypothesis, and silence is NO_FINDING_WITHIN_PANEL.

assumptions: A public typed artifact grammar, finite safe detector DSL and actual matcher exist; arbitrary model-generated executable code is never run.
Development, calibration and confirmation are frozen before induction; partitions separate transformation templates, not merely names or random seeds of the same string.

Possible control families include stale witness binding, missing required premise, unsupported promotion of evidence scope and declared sort mismatch. Each uses contract-valid benign counterparts with lexical overlap.
All host selection is seed-independent. Confirmation details remain offline and cannot become hints to the answer-producing stage.
No adequate detector subset means an ordinary answer with an explicit coverage gap, not a fabricated clean certificate or an unbudgeted detector rewrite.
nodes.hypothesis: At matched total spend, dual-panel selection reduces benign-trigger counts and exposes more declared contract-defect families than self-only negative selection, while avoiding an increase in unsupported certainty in the final answer.
typed_inputs: SeedBytes{utf8_bytes,sha256}; delivered unchanged only to the answer-producing call

stages.instruction: Freeze the public control grammar, three partitions, DSL interpreter and price reservation. Record the seed digest without modifying or incorporating seed content into detector controls.

Using only generic development controls and the supplied DSL, propose at most 12 diagnostic rules with failure-family scopes. Include no solution, truth verdict or authorization field. Do not infer the withheld task or retrieve any benchmark information.

stages.role: Exact finite negative-selection and coverage checker
stages.instruction: Run the actual matcher on calibration, enumerate feasible self-tolerant covering subsets, and choose deterministically. Evaluate the frozen selection on confirmation once. Record all counts and missing families. Never tune on confirmation or turn detector agreement into truth.

Answer the unchanged seed using the public output schema and frozen generic diagnostic predicates. State assumptions and open obligations. Detector controls are not mathematical evidence for your answer. Do not claim panel adequacy proves correctness.

Run selected rules only if confirmed, retain separate deterministic checker outcomes, and render finite scope and coverage gaps. A candidate with no hits receives no global pass. Freeze candidate, receipts and costs before any trusted private evaluation.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Self-panel-only negative selection using the same proposed rules, matcher, model endpoint and aggregate token cap; compare also a fixed generic checklist.
ablations: Remove benign metamorphic variants
Remove required per-family coverage
Select and report on the same partition, explicitly labeled a leakage-positive experimental control
Use all retained rules instead of minimum-cover selection
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Primary host-only endpoints are confirmation FP counts, covered defect families, detection counts and coverage gaps. Separately score frozen task answers for correctness, unsupported certainty and completeness at matched actual spend and a matched cap. Report total denominators, not only FP/(TP+FP). A single seed gives instance-specific outcomes only.

nodes.falsification: Reject the advantage if untouched confirmation benign hits rise, required families remain uncovered, or answer correctness/completeness deteriorates beyond a preregistered tolerance. A detector passing calibration but failing confirmation falsifies its transfer claim, not the correctness of all candidate answers.
risks: Finite grammar defects can be easier than real proof errors; family coverage cannot establish semantic completeness.
Correlated metamorphic variants inflate counts; report template-level results as well as instance counts.
Model and host may share a mistaken control contract. Label-checker adequacy remains explicit.
Reusing confirmation to select another subset creates calibration leakage even if no private answer key is involved.
Induction consumes tokens that could otherwise be spent on the derivation.
nodes.budget_formula: C_max <= 9000*p_in + 3600*p_out + sum(F_s) + R for two calls, no retries; all billable reasoning must fit the completion envelope or be reserved separately. At the common conditional thresholds and R=0.01, reserve USD 0.037.

nodes.name: Subject-bound two-signal repair routing with disagreement controls

mathematical_basis.known_method: Conjunctive guard activation and independent host checks already exist in EIS. Factorial control interventions test that either required input can block a gate. Evidence-carrying local repair is an established verification pattern.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Use a frozen EIS-style detector hit to identify a repair class and a separately executed exact host check to supply a concrete public failure witness about the same claim and candidate hash. Route at most one repair call only when both are present, the optional diagnostic rule is authorized for this research profile, health is current, and the rule is unsuspended. This scheduler action is separate from EIS activation. Validate the routing with all four hit/danger combinations and deliberately mismatched, stale and copied receipts.
mathematical_basis.gate: RouteRepair = ProfileAllowed and D(x) and H(x,w) and SameSubject and FreshBindings and Healthy and not Suspended and BudgetReserved. D and H use different code paths and evidence provenance, but no statistical independence is inferred. H is a failure of a declared public predicate or a checked counterexample, not an LLM opinion. Every deterministic failure is reported even when D(x)=0; the conjunction controls repair allocation, never hides a known failure or certifies the ungated candidate.
mathematical_basis.preservation: A repair must bind to the original candidate hash, change only declared claim IDs and dependent prose, and invalidate/recheck affected receipts. Failed repairs remain failed; successful local predicate checks are reported only for their declared scope. Two passing checkers do not establish theorem truth.

assumptions: A frozen public diagnostic registry and exact host checker exist for at least one declared artifact fragment; unsupported analytic statements remain OPEN.
Danger evidence is produced by the host from public candidate artifacts and allowed rules; no hidden evaluator is callable during the workflow.
A versioned adapter is required if mathematical danger classes are outside the existing EIS closed registry; the proposal does not silently add new signal kinds to the current implementation.
Benchmark routing authorization is stored outside model output and does not create production admission or enforcement authority.
No repair is attempted on a checker infrastructure error, unknown subject binding, stale witness, or missing health evidence.
nodes.hypothesis: Compared with unconditional critique or detector-hit-only repair, two-signal routing spends fewer calls rewriting sound artifacts while preserving visibility of host-detected defects and improving the local repair success per dollar.

stages.instruction: Freeze the diagnostic profile, checker registry and two-call reservation. Keep the exact seed bytes in their own message. Confirm that no private evaluator or key material is reachable.
Produce the requested answer with stable claim IDs and declared public artifacts. State assumptions and missing checks. You cannot supply host danger, activation or admission flags.

stages.role: Independent public checking and repair scheduler
stages.instruction: Run the frozen detector and the separate host checker on the same bound subject. Validate freshness, scope, health and evidence provenance. Record every checker failure. If all routing conjuncts hold, emit one allowlisted public failure class, artifact pointer and public witness reference for repair; otherwise retain the draft and findings.

Only when RouteDecision is REPAIR_ONCE, repair the indicated artifacts and their dependent prose under the original public assumptions. Do not change the seed, checker, scope or unrelated claim IDs. If the failure cannot be repaired, return explicit unresolved obligations. Do not infer private expected answers.

Apply a hash-bound patch only if well formed; recheck changed artifacts and dependencies. If the model stage was skipped retain the draft. Report remaining failures, unsupported checks and local passes separately, freeze all outputs, and reconcile the aggregate reservation. No private evaluation result can cause a retry.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Two-call draft plus unconditional whole-answer critique under the same cap; also compare detector-only and host-failure-only routing to distinguish the added value of the detector.
ablations: D-only repair
H-only repair
Reused detector digest masquerading as danger
Stale candidate hash
Missing host health
Same predicate under two observer names
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: On public synthetic controls exercise D/H = 00,01,10,11 while keeping admission, suspension and health explicit. Measure spurious repair calls, hidden host failures, benign-answer damage, patch success and total cost. Private scoring occurs after all final answers are frozen. Structural separation and agreement are never reported as statistical independence.

nodes.falsification: A routed repair when either required signal is absent, stale or copied falsifies gate correctness. Suppressing a host failure because the detector was silent falsifies the reporting contract. If H-only routing matches or beats the conjunction on defect repair and cost, the extra detector has no demonstrated utility for this setting.
risks: Two-signal routing can miss useful repair opportunities when the detector has low sensitivity; host failures must still remain visible.
Different observer names can conceal common implementation errors. Evidence lineage must record code and data provenance, without claiming causal independence is proven.
Exact local witness failure may reflect a codec or assumption mismatch rather than a false mathematical conclusion.
A local patch can break a distant prose dependency unless dependency rechecking is complete.
Conditional call savings can make equal-cap comparisons unfair; report matched actual spend as well.
nodes.budget_formula: C_max <= 14000*p_in + 4200*p_out + sum(F_s) + R, reserve both calls before dispatch and permit no retries. At common conditional thresholds and R=0.01, reserve USD 0.045; a skipped repair releases its unused reservation only after first-call usage is known.

nodes.name: Expiring diagnostic memory with paired transfer challenges

mathematical_basis.known_method: Scoped failure guidance and optional-guard regulation exist in EIS. Negative selection and metamorphic controls test unwanted cross-reaction. Selective prediction motivates reporting the coverage lost when guidance is withheld rather than rewarding blanket abstention.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Turn each generic diagnostic memory into a content-addressed lease over a precise parser, matcher, public scope and paired witness/benign-control family. Before reuse, the host challenges the entry on frozen transfer variants. A changed dependency, benign hit or failure to detect its own reproducer makes that entry inactive for the run; it cannot silently survive by accumulating more votes. Present at most three active, solution-free obligations to a single answer-producing call. Keep every expired entry and reason in an append-only diagnostic record, and leave production admission untouched.
mathematical_basis.lease_rule: Active(m,x) = ScopeMatch(m,x) and VersionsMatch(m) and not Expired(m) and forall b in B_m: d_m(b)=0 and forall r in R_m: d_m(r)=1, where B_m and R_m are finite public transfer controls not used to choose m. Max age is a preregistered run count or dependency change, not a learned confidence score. Unknown or failed controls give INACTIVE_FOR_RUN, never benignity or correctness.
mathematical_basis.support_and_metrics: Deduplicate evidence by canonical occurrence and lineage keys before selecting memories. An MIS support count can label declared non-overlap only; missing keys imply UNKNOWN_CORRELATION and cannot boost support. Track active guidance coverage, benign-trigger counts, detected control defects, abstentions and task-answer completeness separately. Do not infer a risk bound from the selective-classification literature without its sampling assumptions.
mathematical_basis.distinctive_test: Use adversarially close but contract-valid transformations to distinguish the failure mechanism from its surface wording. Revoke a rule's use within the current run when this public challenge disproves its specificity, then test whether withholding that guidance prevents an otherwise valid answer from being rewritten into error. This is diagnostic-memory control, not autonomous learning or deployment immunity.

assumptions: The initial memory bank is a bounded, deterministic public research registry with reproducers and checker-established benign controls; it contains no seed solution, private score or paid generation hidden outside the run budget.
Scope matching uses a frozen public typed schema. Model-authored claims of scope compatibility are insufficient.
At most 12 memory entries are considered and at most three are injected; deterministic order is fixed before benchmark evaluation.
Control generation preserves declared semantics only where the host has a checked transformation; lexical similarity alone is not a benignity proof.
Withholding optional research guidance never disables protected gates, modifies authenticated production admission, or deletes historical evidence.
nodes.hypothesis: Expiring and transfer-challenged diagnostic memory reduces false guidance and benign-answer damage compared with always-on retrieval, while retaining useful defect reminders on the declared public grammar.

stages.instruction: Freeze public memory entries, deterministic retrieval order, expiry rule, transfer panels and one-call reservation. Reject answer-bearing, private-derived or unbound memories. Preserve the original seed bytes.

stages.role: Finite transfer challenge and scoped anergy
stages.instruction: Check every candidate lease against scope, versions, age and paired transfer controls using the actual matcher. Deduplicate evidence and mark unknown lineage. Inactivate failing optional guidance only for this run; retain entries and receipts. Select at most three active generic obligations without observing private benchmark results.

stages.role: Answer producer with limited diagnostic memory
stages.instruction: Answer the unchanged seed. Treat the supplied generic obligations as reminders to justify your own assumptions, not as facts or proof of correctness. Preserve requested coverage and explicitly state unsupported claims. Do not invent activation, custody, health or memory-promotion receipts.

Run public checks, record which reminders were used and all unresolved findings, then freeze answer and cost receipts. A quiet detector panel is only no observed finding. Do not promote memory, change admission or request a repair from private evaluation feedback.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Always-on retrieval of the same top-three public entries using the same one-call model and token cap; compare no memory as a second baseline.
ablations: No dependency expiry
Reproducer controls without benign counterparts
Benign controls without transfer variants
Count duplicated or inherited reports as new support
Expire all entries, to expose apparent gains caused only by withholding guidance
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Use public paired tasks from a fixed grammar to measure guidance-induced errors, reminders that catch their declared defects, abstention and completeness. Include code-version changes and renamed syntax that preserve the control contract. Frozen benchmark outputs may be scored separately, but their feedback cannot enter this memory bank. One seed supports no claim of durable immunity.

nodes.falsification: The proposal fails if expired or scope-mismatched guidance reaches the model, if a known benign-triggering rule stays active, if an inherited duplicate increases independent-support claims, or if transfer challenges remove useful guidance without improving correctness or benign preservation at comparable coverage.
risks: Overly narrow leases can disable most guidance; blanket inactivity can look safe while providing no utility.
Public transfer controls can be overfit through repeated policy changes; policy tuning requires fresh confirmation families.
Scope/parser drift may be semantic even when version hashes are unchanged; hashes identify bytes, not meaning.
A detector passing every pair can still be wrong outside that finite grammar.
A registry that later incorporates evaluator-derived failures would contaminate subsequent benchmark runs; it must remain isolated.
nodes.budget_formula: C_max <= 9500*p_in + 3000*p_out + F_1 + R for one call, no retries and no hidden paid memory construction. At common conditional thresholds and R=0.01, reserve USD 0.0345.

nodes.name: Precommitted sibling wrappers with a public exact Pareto gate

mathematical_basis.known_method: Finite prompt variation and exact multiobjective dominance over measured records. For vectors v=(coverage, -public_defects, -completion_tokens), x dominates y iff every coordinate of v(x) is at least v(y) and at least one is strictly greater.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Construct exactly two sibling wrappers from one fixed parent before any model response: a dependency-first outline and a branch-first outline. The seed message remains byte-identical. Obtain two separate answer artifacts, compute a public obligation/detector vector, and choose from the exact nondominated set using a preregistered lexicographic tie rule. Preserve both candidates, all failures, and both execution costs.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: Compile immutable SeedBytes x WrapperPolicy -> Request; Request -> CandidateArtifact; CandidateArtifact x PublicPredicateRegistry -> PublicMetricVector; vector records -> FrontReceipt -> selected artifact. Host replay witnesses each wrapper edit. Both candidates descend from the template, not from one another, and a shared task ID does not create an inheritance edge. Exact dominance is exact only for the declared proxies.

assumptions: A public obligation inventory and detector registry are frozen before model outputs. Coverage counts only required IDs with nonempty bound artifact sections; it is labeled structural coverage, not mathematical correctness.

Both wrappers preserve every requested obligation. Their only differences are instruction order and explicit scaffold. They contain no target solution, guessed branch answer, or private-grader material.

Eligibility requires valid encoding, preserved seed, bounded size, and declared schema. Unsupported mathematical checks remain OPEN; public_defects counts only calibrated public predicate failures, not arbitrary prose judgments.

An independently specified exact vector comparator is implemented and validated before execution. Do not call the audited ParetoFrontSelectorV1 unmodified; this three-coordinate extension is not already supplied by it.
The two responses are separate provider samples, but their errors can be correlated. Shared provider, model, prompt library, and detectors do not establish statistical independence.
nodes.hypothesis: At matched total dollar and output-token budgets, two distinct frozen scaffolds plus public selection reduce missing requested sections and improve blinded final score relative to two samples of one fixed scaffold; the effect is explicitly within this single item.

stages.role: Frozen policy compiler and shared budget gate
stages.instruction: Freeze both wrapper byte strings, mutation edits, fixed public detector definitions and lexicographic rule. Validate immutable seed-message round trip and request hashes. Reserve the worst-case cost of both calls before dispatch. A wrapper edit is host-recorded; hashes alone do not authorize lineage.

Answer the complete unchanged seed. Organize the derivation by prerequisite dependencies; include every declared obligation ID, explicit assumptions and unresolved steps. Supply only candidate-side evidence requested by the public schema. Do not self-score or claim host acceptance.

Answer the complete unchanged seed independently of sibling A, which is not supplied. Organize the derivation by parameter and boundary cases before common conclusions. Include every declared obligation ID, explicit assumptions and unresolved steps. Do not self-score or claim host acceptance.

Record both attempts including failures. Run the frozen public schema, dependency, and independently calibrated consistency predicates without private evaluation. Compute structural coverage, public defect count and billed completion tokens as exact integers. Missing cost or invalid artifact is ineligible; preserve the failure receipt.

stages.role: Exact frontier and fixed tie rule
stages.instruction: Using the separately validated comparator, compute the nondominated eligible set. Sort that front by public_defects ascending, structural coverage descending, completion tokens ascending, then preassigned wrapper ID ascending. Empty set emits INCOMPLETE; singleton returns that element without pairwise code. Selection does not create a new genome or causal improvement claim. Charge both calls regardless of the selected answer.

Freeze selected answer bytes, both raw candidates, policy and ledger. Trusted mathematical scoring occurs afterward in an isolated evaluator with no return channel. Report accuracy/cost/time frontier separately from the public-proxy frontier.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Two independent direct same-model answers with the identical aggregate budget and the same public selector, differing only by use of one fixed wrapper; also report a single-call baseline with the same total output budget when feasible.
ablations: Choose wrapper A by preregistered ID without public selection
Use two identical wrapper strings but distinct occurrence IDs
Remove one public detector family at a time, retaining the same eligibility and budget rules
Use exact Pareto set without the final lexicographic choice and report the entire set
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Pre-register paired run blocks and independent provider sampling, randomize arm order, keep every failure in the denominator, and freeze all configurations before the campaign. Evaluate selected and unselected artifacts only after freezing, to measure selection regret. Public detector sensitivity/false rejection is measured on independent positive and corrupted synthetic fixtures. Repeated samples measure this item's response variability, not a population of tasks.

falsification: A public synthetic fixture has a dominated candidate selected, inconsistent permutation results, singleton failure, missing-token defaulted to zero, or a duplicate occurrence counted as a new genome: selection implementation fails its claim.
The chosen answer has lower trusted score than the discarded answer often enough to reverse the preregistered benefit margin: the proxy selector is counterproductive even when exact.

Sibling wrappers do not improve the preregistered within-item paired score/completeness criterion relative to identical-wrapper sampling at matched budgets: proposed diversity mechanism is unsupported.
Any request omits or changes seed bytes, or any private diagnostic influences selection before output freeze, invalidates the blind run.
risks: Structural coverage is easy to satisfy with incorrect prose; public Pareto membership is not a correctness certificate.
Lexicographic order expresses a preference and can discard meaningful tradeoffs; the complete frontier and both costs must remain visible.
Protected seed bytes do not prevent a wrapper from semantically contradicting the seed; wrapper invariance still needs a frozen allowlist and review.
Known event-log disk failure means successful append alone is insufficient; freeze must verify durable readback before reporting a complete receipt.
nodes.budget_formula: C_max <= 10000*p_in + 6000*p_out + sum(F_s) + R; two calls, no retries. At the conditional thresholds and R=0.01 this is USD 0.050. The selected candidate's individual cost must never replace total run cost.

nodes.name: One-step public-failure repair with replayable mutation lineage

mathematical_basis.known_method: A bounded deterministic controller over public observations, unrolled into an acyclic execution. With draft x, detector vector d(x), and frozen branch table T, the repair prompt is P1=T(P0,d(x)); one repair produces y, then execution stops.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Use one complete draft and one targeted patch call. The host maps only public artifact-local failures to a fixed instruction table, mutates a separate repair-wrapper message, and records exactly which observation and edit caused the child request. Repair feedback contains allowlisted classes and candidate IDs, never raw judge text. Retain the draft and patch so the host can choose a nonregressing result without another model call.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: ObservationReceipt binds candidate hash, checker/version and public failure IDs. MutationReceipt binds parent request, frozen transition table, observation receipt, edited wrapper bytes and child request. OPERADS types enforce that only PublicObservation can enter the RepairPrompt slot; PrivateEvaluation has no outgoing edge. Exact status comparison is over the same fixed obligation set, never model-declared success.

assumptions: Public detectors are fixed before drafting and have independent calibration fixtures, including correct but nonstandard forms. A numeric spot check is labeled numerical evidence and cannot certify an analytic claim.

The transition table permits at most four neutral classes: SCHEMA, MISSING_OBLIGATION, UNBOUND_ASSUMPTION, and FAILED_PUBLIC_IDENTITY. Each has fixed answer-free instructions; only public candidate-local pointers vary.
Repair output is a bounded patch over stable artifact IDs. Host rendering is deterministic, untouched sections retain their hashes, and changed sections plus dependencies are rechecked.

At most one repair is permitted. With no failures the second node is skipped and emits a host no-op receipt; unused reservation is released only after usage is known. No failure triggers a third call.
Parent-child operational lineage requires replay of the actual observed edit and occurrence, not merely a caller-sealed assertion. Lineage is not evidence that repair caused a score improvement.
nodes.hypothesis: A fixed public-failure repair controller reduces structural omissions and independently detected inconsistencies per billed token relative to whole-answer self-critique, while preserving all original requested obligations; trusted-score benefit remains an empirical within-item question.

stages.instruction: Freeze public predicates, neutral feedback table, patch IDs and nonregression rule before the draft. Preserve the seed message independently of wrappers and verify bytes at dispatch. Reserve both calls; load no private evaluation data.

Answer every part of the unchanged seed with explicit assumptions and dependency-linked sections. Use the public artifact schema and distinguish exact derivations, numerical checks and open obligations. The host, not you, determines public check outcomes.

Run frozen bounded checks. Encode at most four allowlisted failure classes and artifact-local IDs; never include raw diagnostics. Apply the frozen table to append a separate repair-wrapper message, record byte edits and actual parent occurrence, and verify immutable seed round trip. If there are no actionable public failures, record a no-op and skip repair.

If dispatched, use only the unchanged seed, your draft, and the public allowlisted failure receipt. Patch the indicated sections and any explicitly listed dependent references. Recompute candidate-supplied identities; do not invent checker outcomes, remove requested obligations, alter the detector registry, or turn an unsupported claim into a certified one. Return unresolved fields if a repair cannot be made.

If skipped, retain draft. Otherwise render the patch and recheck all affected dependencies. Child is eligible only if it loses no previously satisfied fixed predicate and improves at least one public predicate or required-section status. Compute the exact frontier on structural coverage, negative public defects and negative artifact-generation tokens; apply fixed priority of fewer defects, more coverage, then fewer tokens, retaining the draft on ties. A costlier child may be nondominated, not dominant. Report total draft-plus-repair cost regardless of the retained candidate.

Replay lineage from raw request and wrapper bytes, reject stale receipts, verify durable readback, and freeze both alternatives plus the chosen output. Offline trusted scoring may compare them afterward but cannot trigger another repair or future prompt selection in this blind run.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Draft plus whole-answer self-critique using the same model, aggregate token cap, seed and public checks; include draft-only as a cost reference.
ablations: Replace specific public failure classes with one generic review instruction
Supply the same public failures but ask for a whole-answer rewrite
Use patch generation with no nonregression gate
Use replay-verified host lineage versus declarative receipts on synthetic corruption fixtures; this tests custody, not mathematical quality
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Track public defect removal, new-defect introduction, patch size, restored obligation coverage, false rejection on valid synthetic artifacts, and final isolated trusted score. Pair repeats by seed/model/configuration and count skipped repairs, incomplete patches and infrastructure failures. A fixed feedback policy is still within-item adaptation; repeated private-score-informed redesign must be labeled a separate exploratory campaign.

falsification: An unchanged valid synthetic artifact is rejected beyond a preregistered false-rejection tolerance, or a mutated required section bypasses rechecking.
Repair creates a new public failure or removes a previously covered obligation but is nevertheless selected: the nonregression contract is violated.
Swapping the observation receipt or parent occurrence leaves a replay receipt accepted: lineage binding is inadequate.
Whole-answer critique matches or exceeds the repair controller's preregistered paired score and defect-removal criterion at the same budget: targeted repair has no established advantage.
Any raw private-feedback text or key-derived failure class reaches the repair prompt invalidates the blind interpretation.
risks: Neutral failure classes still encode information about public tests; adapting to them can overfit those tests.
An incorrect draft can pass every finite detector; absence of actionable failure is not correctness.
Hash sealing is not authentication of the event source; broker-captured request/response evidence and replay are extra requirements.
The current taint implementation is order-dependent. Do not use it to clear ancestry; compute any required reachability/taint conservatively in a separately validated topological pass.
nodes.budget_formula: C_max <= 12000*p_in + 4300*p_out + sum(F_s) + R; at most two calls and no retry. Conditional thresholds with R=0.01 give USD 0.0435. The no-op path uses one call but reserves the two-call worst case until the branch is known.

nodes.name: Typed scaffold evolution before solving with exact plan selection

mathematical_basis.known_method: Finite typed program synthesis and partial-order scheduling: a plan is a DAG over a frozen operation grammar, with edge compatibility target(g)=source(f)[i], acyclicity, and explicit requested sinks. Structural validity is decidable for a finite plan but does not prove the semantics of the later answer.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: The first small model call proposes up to three plan-only scaffold candidates. Each is a sequence/DAG of IDs from a fixed neutral grammar, not a rewritten task or mathematical answer. The host rejects plans that omit obligations, introduce undeclared assumptions or fail coloured composition. It compiles the survivors into wrapper messages and chooses an exact Pareto plan using structural check placement, auxiliary node count and actual wrapper-token cost. A second call solves the complete unchanged seed under the selected scaffold.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: Plan grammar atoms are inventory_assumptions, split_public_domains, derive_required_result, declare_dependencies, check_candidate_identity, label_numeric_evidence, state_residual, and render_requested_answer. Slots carry SeedRef, ObligationRef, CandidateClaim, CheckRequest and RenderableSection colours. Every requested sink is represented and connected; checker nodes only consume already-produced candidate claims. Typed composition retains unsupported semantic obligations as residuals.

assumptions: The grammar, maximum three candidates, maximum 16 nodes/32 edges per plan, obligation inventory and exact selector are committed before any target response. The first call may inspect the public seed but receives no target-score history.

Only operation IDs and references are accepted from the planner. Free-form mathematical assertions, numerical results, new assumptions and edits to seed text make a plan ineligible; the host renders all instruction prose from frozen templates.
All required derivation and rendering nodes are mandatory. Optional check requests are deduplicated by obligation/checker ID, so adding repeated checks cannot inflate the objective.

Structural check coverage is the fraction of required claims assigned an applicable registered public check kind. An unsupported symbolic claim is OPEN and gains no check-coverage credit; assigning a kind does not mean that the later claim passes.
The baseline scaffold is a frozen feasible fallback. If all plans fail, the solve stage uses that fallback within the same reservation; no replanning or extra model call occurs.

Typed plan correctness, wrapper byte integrity, and final mathematical correctness are separate claims. Selection on public plan proxies is adaptive to this item, not evidence of task-general learning.
nodes.hypothesis: Allocating a small planning call to a typed scaffold, then selecting a compact complete plan, improves final obligation completeness and reduces unsupported-check claims compared with unconstrained plan-and-solve at equal total budget.

stages.instruction: Freeze grammar templates, legal colours, requested sink inventory, comparator and fallback plan. Verify all plan candidates must use the same unchanged seed reference. Reserve both calls and pass only public inputs to the planner.

Propose at most three typed plan DAGs using only the allowed operation IDs and public obligation references. Cover every requested part, name dependencies, and place checks only after their candidate claims. Return plan structure only: no derivation, formula, numerical answer, new assumption, or edited seed text.

stages.role: Typed compilation and exact Pareto selection
stages.instruction: Reject free-form assertions, invalid IDs, cycles, unbound assumptions and missing requested sinks. Compile legal plans using frozen template text. Calculate exact structural check coverage, negative auxiliary-node count and negative tokenized wrapper length. Compute a validated exact nondominated set and choose by coverage descending, wrapper tokens ascending, auxiliary nodes ascending, plan ID ascending. Empty set uses the frozen fallback. Record planner-to-scaffold derivation as a host transformation, not evidence of efficacy.

Answer the complete unchanged seed using the selected scaffold. Supply all requested results and explicit premises. A planned check is only an obligation until evidence is actually supplied and checked; mark unsupported mathematics OPEN. Do not treat plan acceptance as mathematical approval.

Check schema, coverage and plan adherence under bounded public predicates. Preserve all proposed plans, rejected-plan reasons, fallback use, final answer and cost ledger. Do not silently repair the answer. Freeze artifacts before isolated trusted scoring; no grader feedback can evolve the plan grammar or templates inside the run.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Unconstrained plan-and-solve with a 900-token plan and 3100-token solution under the same model and input limits; also compare one 4000-token direct solve as a call-overhead baseline.
ablations: Fixed fallback scaffold with no planner call
Accept first eligible plan rather than exact Pareto selection
Check only plan acyclicity, removing colour compatibility
Keep typed structure but remove checker-applicability filtering; evaluate unsupported-check claims explicitly
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Pre-register within-item completeness, trusted score, unsupported-check assertions, typed-plan refusal rate, fallback rate, and plan/solve token split. Synthetic malformed plans test omitted sinks, type mismatch, cycles, duplicate check inflation and invented premises before any paid run. Do not count proposed plan diversity or compiler acceptance as solver accuracy.

falsification: A compiled plan omits a mandatory sink, consumes a check before the claim exists, gains duplicate check credit or includes a new assumption: the structural admission claim fails.
The typed compiler rejects independently reviewed valid alternative plans at an unacceptable preregistered rate, or its overhead erases any score/completeness benefit under the same spend cap.
The final solver treats planned checks as passed without witnesses more often than the unconstrained baseline: the scaffold is inducing unjustified confidence.
Target trusted scores are used to revise the grammar, choose the fallback, or reprioritize plan objectives while reporting a held-out result: the comparison is invalid.
risks: A too-small grammar may suppress useful reasoning routes; refused plans and fallback frequency must be reported.
Model-proposed plan variants within one response are not independent samples and are not three solver attempts.
Exact structural metrics can prefer a concise but ineffective plan; no mathematical or causal guarantee follows from the frontier.
OPERADS colour checking validates declared interfaces only. Semantic preservation needs explicit host templates and review, and final mathematical claims remain evaluator obligations.
nodes.budget_formula: C_max <= 10000*p_in + 4000*p_out + sum(F_s) + R; two calls, no retry. At the conditional thresholds with R=0.01 this is USD 0.040. The full cost includes rejected plans and fallback use.

nodes.name: Context-indexed adapter diamonds

mathematical_basis.known_method: An operad supplies typed substitution; its algebra supplies the meaning of the composite. A matching interface is necessary but does not establish preservation of a task or proposition.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Index each port by immutable task, assumption-context, artifact, evidence-scope, and schema identities. An adapter must expose a preservation relation and a refusal branch. For two admitted routes from the same representation to the same target, compare the preserved requested-claim inventory and assumptions, not just serialized output equality. The commuting diagram is an obligation until a checker establishes it for the declared fragment.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: An edge requires equal full five-field native port contracts plus equal task/context indices. A bridge A:X->Y carries a checked relation P_A(x,y); composed preservation is P_A(x,y) and P_B(y,z). Without an implemented relation checker, append OPEN_BRIDGE and retain candidate-only status. No implicit coercion of numerical evidence into symbolic evidence.

assumptions: At most two explicit bridge routes, four bridges per route, and 24 claim identifiers; both routes retain the complete requested inventory.
Artifact mutation changes its hash and invalidates all artifact-bound receipts. Task and assumption hashes cannot be recomputed from rewritten prose to disguise a change.
New state types require reviewed schema/validator bindings under the current closed native colour vocabulary; naming a new colour is not an admitted extension.
nodes.hypothesis: Explicit context indices and checked bridges reduce invalid composition and stale-evidence acceptance compared with colour-only composition, while retaining all valid public controls and improving complete-answer quality at matched budgets.

stages.instruction: Freeze immutable seed, public inventory and adapter contracts; reject unresolved native mappings before any attempt to run them.
Return the requested response with explicit context and representation tags; do not assert host acceptance.
Run only implemented public bridge predicates on both routes. Detect dropped branches, changed assumptions, stale hashes and unsupported scope promotions; preserve refusals and open bridges.
Repair artifact-local interface failures from allowlisted public diagnostics, preserving the original seed and claim inventory. Unproved semantic bridges remain explicit.
Recompute bridge checks on current hashes, render bounded claim scopes, and freeze bytes before isolated evaluation.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Same two-call envelope with only colour/schema checks and ordinary critique.
ablations: Full native ports without context indices
Context indices without preservation predicates
One route only; no diamond comparison
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Public fixtures deliberately change assumptions, remove exceptional branches, reuse stale receipts, and preserve valid alternative encodings. Report false accepts, false rejects, completeness and trusted final scores separately. Diamond agreement is not semantic adequacy.

nodes.falsification: One accepted context-changing bridge or unjustified evidence promotion falsifies the preservation implementation. The performance hypothesis fails if matched-budget final quality does not improve or valid-control refusal offsets the reduction in false acceptance.
risks: Both routes can share the same faulty parser or omission.
Interface overhead can displace useful mathematical reasoning.
One finite fixture panel cannot prove a universal translation theorem.
nodes.budget_formula: Two calls, zero retries: I_total<=14000, O_total<=4400. At the conditional common thresholds, C_max<=0.014+0.022+0.010=USD 0.046 for the complete execution.

nodes.name: Law-carrying residual folds with replayable discharge

mathematical_basis.known_method: Program rewrites require laws for the effects that observations retain; associativity of syntax does not establish equality of effectful execution.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Use an append-only event word together with integer microusd cost, bounded integer diagnostic risk, and declared effect sets. Define accumulation as concatenation, exact addition, max, and union. Treat discharge as a checked event replay, not removal by matching a string. Keep chronological evidence separate from the currently open-obligation projection.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: For event words L and L', combine (L,c,r,E)*(L',c',r',E')=(LL',c+c',max(r,r'),E union E'); identity=(empty,0,0,empty), with c nonnegative integer and r in {0,...,100}. Refuse nonfinite, negative or out-of-domain values. The product is associative but generally noncommutative because logs retain order. A discharge event requires an earlier exact obligation ID/context/artifact hash and an independent public receipt; replay failure stays OPEN.

assumptions: At most 64 residual events and 24 obligation IDs per run; duplicate IDs are rejected.
The integer risk field is diagnostic, not an estimated probability or a correctness score.
Budget reservations and actual costs remain distinct; recomputing a fold never redispatches a paid operation.
nodes.hypothesis: A law-checked fold and evidence-bound discharge eliminate representation/order-dependent loss of obligations without increasing unsupported final certification or exceeding the matched two-call budget.

stages.instruction: Check all finite risk triples and bounded event-word controls for associativity/unit; include NaN, infinity, negative cost, duplicate IDs, forged discharge and stale-artifact controls. Tests establish only this finite implementation panel.
Produce the requested response with explicit open obligations and artifact-bound evidence references.
Check public artifacts and replay typed events in order; do not accept model-authored discharge strings as evidence.
Respond to the public residual frontier once, emitting new artifacts or retaining open obligations. Never delete historical events.
Validate new discharge receipts, invalidate stale dependencies, retain failures and freeze output before trusted scoring.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: The same draft/repair schedule with a plain unresolved-string list.
ablations: Finite integer risk and exact cost only
Append-only history without evidence-bound discharge
Reassociation tests without mutable-state/callable controls
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Compare folds for both bracketings of the same ordered operation occurrences on public fixtures; check full traces and values, not scalar risk alone. A separate adversarial body fixture mutates hidden state to demonstrate why residual laws do not certify arbitrary callables.

nodes.falsification: Any admitted unequal bracketing for the declared product or unproved discharge closes an obligation falsifies the contract. Equal diagnostic scalars with different trace meanings do not count as success. Final-quality benefits must survive matched-budget scoring.
risks: Correct event accumulation does not prove checker adequacy or pure operation behavior.
A trace schema may omit a relevant side effect.
Associativity permits rebracketing a fixed order, not swapping dependent operations.
nodes.budget_formula: Two calls, zero retries: I_total<=13000, O_total<=4200. At the conditional common thresholds, C_max<=0.013+0.021+0.010=USD 0.044 for the complete execution.

nodes.name: Typed order squares for screen-and-rewrite interactions

mathematical_basis.known_method: Commutation is a separate property from associativity and requires a declared observation and noninterference assumptions. A failure to commute can be an experimental interaction rather than a type error.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Compare A;B with B;A on the same frozen draft, where A adds public detector annotations and B is one bounded model rewrite that may consume current annotations. Both act on an indexed packet and both arms end with a common fresh A check. Different output distributions are allowed and measured; no equivalence is presumed.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: Packet(seed_hash,context_hash,candidate_hash,annotations) is the shared state type. A returns annotations bound to candidate_hash. B preserves seed/context but replaces candidate_hash and invalidates every old annotation. Identity of public interfaces makes both orders candidates; artifact validity rules and frozen effects determine executability. Final A never consults private evaluation.

assumptions: One draft and two branch rewrites: three model calls total across the paired execution, no retries or model judge.
A is a deterministic frozen public detector with an independently specified control panel; B uses the same model/settings and cap in each arm.
Each branch has isolated mutable state and child ledger reservations; both share immutable draft bytes. The pair is one correlated block, not two independent replicates.
A;B;A and B;A;A have equal public check counts. Randomize actual arm dispatch order; stale annotations are never silently reused.
nodes.hypothesis: Providing public diagnostic annotations before a rewrite improves the subsequent complete response relative to checking only afterward; any improvement is an order interaction on this seed, not a universal commutation law or transfer result.

stages.instruction: Freeze A/B interfaces, controls, budgets, effect declarations and dispatch randomization. Reserve both arms before starting.
Answer the unchanged seed; emit a bounded draft without private feedback.
Snapshot draft; run A before B only in AB. Use a neutral, explicitly diagnostic-free input in BA; record actual framing token counts.
Rewrite using current public annotations; preserve seed/context and emit new candidate bytes.
Rewrite using the frozen draft with no detector diagnosis supplied; preserve seed/context and emit new candidate bytes.
Run A once after AB and twice after BA, yielding two check occurrences per arm overall. Freeze both outputs, including refusals or truncations, with no score-based selection or repair.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Same-model direct answer at matched total dollars/tokens, reported separately from the paired order contrast.
ablations: Supply only schema-format diagnostics
Replace A with a preregistered irrelevant public control detector
Pure deterministic A/B fixture pair expected to commute; no paid calls
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Trusted evaluator scores both frozen answers independently after the pair ends. Across repeated independently generated drafts, randomize arm order and report raw paired differences, false rejections, completeness, cost and latency. Shared-prefix dependence must remain in uncertainty calculations; one item supports only within-item conclusions.

nodes.falsification: The claimed benefit fails if AB has no preregistered meaningful gain over BA at matched bounds, harms completeness, or depends on answer-bearing hints. Any stale annotation accepted after rewriting is a contract failure regardless of score.
risks: A's errors can anchor B; finite calibration is not semantic completeness.
Different prompt contents alter tokenization and can confound an unbalanced comparison.
The paired fork is a proposed external executor feature: the current native compiler forbids shared output nodes.
nodes.budget_formula: Entire paired execution, not per branch: three calls, I_total<=18000, O_total<=5400. At the conditional common thresholds, C_max<=0.018+0.027+0.010=USD 0.055; zero retries and zero paid judge calls.

nodes.name: Frozen independent proposals with a premise-aware disagreement frontier

mathematical_basis.known_method: Independent proposal sampling plus deterministic claim comparison; dependency graphs locate the earliest represented divergence rather than counting answer strings.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Two isolated solvers receive different preregistered public method contracts but the same unchanged seed, with no shared model-generated mining. Freeze both complete answers. Align claims only by public obligation IDs, context and domain; compare exact normal forms in an admitted fragment. Compute the minimal disagreeing nodes under ancestor order and list their descendants. Unknown equivalence is a separate status. Select one complete candidate by a frozen public-check rule, retaining the other and the frontier; never splice prose with incompatible assumptions.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: For an aligned DAG G and proven-incompatible node set D, frontier F={v in D: no ancestor of v lies in D}. F is minimal only relative to the represented graph and admitted alignment. Equality f=g under Gamma says nothing about whether either solves the intended task. If equal-marginal Bernoulli error indicators have rate e and correlation rho under a declared sampling distribution, P(E1=E2=1)=e^2+rho*e*(1-e); rho is not inferable from two artifacts.

assumptions: Public obligation IDs and premise/domain schemas are fixed without consulting the answer key; incorrect semantic extraction remains an explicit residual.

A trusted equivalence checker exists only for an advertised rational/polynomial fragment. Different printed expressions are not automatically incompatible; non-equivalence needs a sound witness in a common valid domain.

Isolation establishes no cross-call artifact visibility. Distinct role labels, prompts or model families do not establish independent errors. Independent decoder draws may be conditionally independent on a fixed task while error rates across tasks share common difficulty; neither model is assumed here.
At most 24 aligned claims, 48 edges and two complete candidates; malformed, truncated or missing candidates remain recorded failures.
nodes.hypothesis: At matched total money or tokens, premise-aware frontiers identify more actionable disagreements and fewer false disagreements than final-string comparison, while preserving final-answer completeness.

stages.instruction: Bind exact seed and public schemas; record that neither solver can read the other, histories, evaluator or shared generated notes. Preregister ranking: fewer soundly refuted obligations, then more fixed obligations supported by admitted exact checks, then A on ties. Ranking is heuristic outside checked predicates.
Answer all original requested parts under method contract A; emit short public claim DAG with explicit domains and premises. Mark unsupported steps. No self-issued verification label.
Answer all original requested parts under method contract B without seeing A. Preserve obligation IDs and emit claim DAG. Declare method inapplicability rather than inventing an alternative task.

Freeze both artifacts; validate bindings, acyclicity and premises. Align admitted claims, check witnesses and compute the represented disagreement frontier. Mark unmatched/unsupported claims UNKNOWN. Do not use a model judge.

Apply preregistered ranking only to fixed obligation IDs; render the selected complete answer with explicit contradictions/open obligations and retain alternative provenance. Do not interpret agreement as certification. Freeze before private scoring.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Two isolated same-model answers under identical public contracts, final-answer equality with deterministic A tie-break; same combined token budget and no judge call.
ablations: Remove distinct method contracts while preserving isolation
Replace premise-aware comparison with final-string agreement
Replace frontier with an unordered full disagreement list
Use a single call with the same total output allowance
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Synthetic public pairs include equivalent rewrites, different domains, shared wrong answers and one corrupted ancestor. Measure localization precision, unknown rate and false disagreements. Separately evaluate frozen seed answers with paired repetitions; report correctness, completeness, joint errors and cost. No correlation estimate is justified by a single pair.

nodes.falsification: Advantage fails if localization does not improve over string comparison, if valid rewrites are labeled contradictory, or if ranking loses completeness beyond a preregistered tolerance. A shared wrong answer receiving a certified label immediately violates the design.
risks: Both solvers can share the same false premise; no disagreement detector catches universal agreement on an error.
Canonicalization can erase domain restrictions or confuse merely different with contradictory answers.
Check-count ranking can reward easy claims; only a frozen requested-obligation inventory may contribute.
nodes.budget_formula: Two branches together: C_max <= 12000*p_in + 5000*p_out + sum(F_s) + R. At conditional ceilings and R=0.01, reserve USD 0.047; 2500 output tokens per branch, no additional calls.

nodes.name: Candidate-blind challenge panel with witness-gated objections

mathematical_basis.known_method: Independent test design and finite counterexample checking separate candidate production from the search for disconfirming evidence.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Run one full solver and one challenge designer independently. The challenger sees the seed and public obligation types but never the solver answer, confidence, endpoint or check results. It emits bounded typed boundary tests and premise audits, not a rhetorical verdict. After both are frozen the host applies admissible challenges to the candidate and annotates exact counterexamples, numerical concerns, unsupported tests and untouched claims. No repair call follows.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: For a candidate universal assertion forall x in D, P(x), an exact witness x0 in D with checked not P(x0) refutes that assertion. Finite passing tests do not prove a universal statement. For a merely sufficient condition A=>B, failure of A is not a counterexample; require A(x0) and not B(x0). Numerical discrepancies require sound error bounds to count as exact refutations.

assumptions: Candidate claims explicitly encode quantifiers, domains, premise IDs and obligation IDs; ambiguous prose receives an uncheckable annotation.
The public challenge language is non-executable data: rational substitutions, domain-boundary probes and prerequisite-presence queries. No model-supplied shell or unrestricted code runs.
A challenger lacking the candidate may miss its specific failure; its statistical independence from the solver is unavailable even though candidate visibility is absent.
At most 12 challenges; each must target an existing public obligation and distinguish a required premise from an optional sufficient condition.
nodes.hypothesis: At matched budget, candidate-blind test design catches more shared-premise and boundary omissions than a visible prose critique without increasing false rejections of valid controls.

stages.instruction: Bind original seed, fixed obligation IDs and grammar; reserve both calls. Challenger receives no solver artifact or candidate-selected hint.
Answer all seed parts with explicit assumptions, domains and typed claim records. Supply candidate witnesses without claiming host approval.

From the immutable task and public grammar alone, propose at most 12 high-yield boundary/premise challenges. Do not solve the task or guess what another solver said. Encode sufficient-condition versus necessary-condition distinctions explicitly.

Freeze both outputs; validate challenge applicability against candidate domains and quantifiers. Evaluate only admitted typed predicates. Require checked witnesses for refutation; unsupported, floating-point-only and timed-out checks remain separately labeled.

Retain the original complete candidate, mark exact refutations as withdrawn claims and untested claims as open. Do not silently replace refuted conclusions. Record completeness loss and all challenge outcomes before trusted evaluation.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Same two calls/caps, but critic sees the complete candidate and emits the same typed challenge format.
ablations: Replace model challenge designer with a fixed deterministic public checklist
Allow candidate visibility while removing confidence/identity metadata only
Replace typed challenges with freeform critique, with verdicts still untrusted
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Use unrelated synthetic public controls with known boundary errors and valid sufficient conditions. Measure witnessed fault discovery, challenge applicability, valid-control false rejection and completeness. Seed scoring occurs only on frozen artifacts; no rejected claim is repaired using evaluator information.

nodes.falsification: Reject the advantage if blinded challenges miss more faults at equal cost, or if false rejections increase. A critique without a valid-domain witness being treated as a mathematical refutation falsifies the host contract.
risks: Blind challenge generation may duplicate generic checks and miss candidate-specific algebraic errors.
A wrong challenge interpreter can manufacture counterexamples outside the declared domain.
Absence of detected faults can be mistaken for global approval; render untested/unsupported coverage explicitly.
nodes.budget_formula: C_max <= 10000*p_in + 4500*p_out + sum(F_s) + R. At conditional ceilings and R=0.01, reserve USD 0.0425; solver cap 3000 plus critic cap 1500, no retries or repair branches.

nodes.name: Masked-conclusion replay at dependency seams

mathematical_basis.known_method: Blind reconstruction and compositional interface checking test whether intermediate conclusions can be reproduced from declared premises without exposing the proposed result.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: The first call supplies a full answer and typed dependency DAG. A deterministic host selects up to four seams by descendant requested-obligation count, ties by public ID. The second call receives the unchanged seed plus each seam's input premises, domains and output type, but not the candidate seam conclusion, downstream text, model identity or confidence. It reconstructs those outputs. The host compares the frozen reconstructions with originals and propagates disagreement/unknown status; it does not ask the critic to endorse the answer.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: If a seam declares Gamma and inputs P1..Pk, reconstructing Q' and proving Gamma entails Q iff Q' establishes equivalence under Gamma only. Correctness still requires Gamma and each Pi, and a sound rule from them to Q. A refuted/open parent propagates to dependent conclusions. Agreement of reconstructions does not close a proof obligation by itself.

assumptions: Seam inputs are explicit and treated as assumptions, not trusted facts. The original seed stays visible even if it permits independently inferring a masked conclusion.

Selection and masking use structural fields only, not private evaluation. All candidate-generated labels and prose are removed except whitelisted typed premises/conditions; residual leakage through premises is possible and logged.
