Allowed origin sets, synthetic leak/benign fixtures, observation fields and request-builder source pins are frozen before seeing a candidate.
Host-only sealed artifacts are inaccessible to the model transport adapter; all referenced views have concrete schemas and validators.
Timing, provider caching and underlying model pretraining may correlate attempts; absence of declared data flow does not establish statistical independence.
nodes.hypothesis: On a held-out synthetic composition panel, origin/control-flow enforcement blocks every preregistered candidate-to-blind-role leak while rejecting at most 2% of valid compositions, and catches more leaks than colour-only or data-lineage-only enforcement. The benchmark accuracy effect is measured separately and may be zero.

stages.instruction: Bind external inputs, reserve both calls, preserve the exact seed, and build isolated model views. PrivateEvaluation is not an input type.

Check topological data/control-origin closure and run finite twin probes against the pinned builder. Public synthetic values only; never use real private storage as a leak probe. Any prohibited observed dependency refuses dispatch.

Receive only the unchanged seed and frozen answer instructions. Produce one complete derivation with public claim IDs. The broker stores output in a host-only field and retains both pre-reserved slots.

Receive only the unchanged seed and the preregistered generic challenge grammar. Never receive candidate bytes, length, hashes, checks, confidence or candidate-dependent routing. Emit up to four public predicate tests without producing or endorsing a full task answer. Dispatch remains fixed even if the first response is unusable, except run-wide infrastructure refusal.

Only after both outputs are frozen, apply admissible public tests and annotate the original answer. Do not splice or repair it. Record bounded visibility assurance, unresolved channels and all failures. Trusted private grading is strictly afterward.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: The same two-call solver/challenger schedule with ordinary port-colour checks and the same token caps; host-only synthetic tests compare composition enforcement before any paid benchmark.
ablations: Origin tags without control-dependency propagation
Correct type checks with full-packet serialization enabled in the synthetic harness
Data-flow enforcement without twin-trace compiler probes
Compiler probes without pinned request-builder identity
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Use disjoint public development and confirmation compositions. Leak fixtures include candidate-conditioned wrapper selection, candidate hashes, swallowed-error text and shared-history serialization; benign fixtures carry host-only artifacts without exposing them. Report leaks admitted, benign refusals, OPEN channels and complete-answer score/cost separately. No intentionally leaking paid seed run is required.

nodes.falsification: Any known prohibited origin appearing in an admitted blind request falsifies the contract. A candidate-dependent dispatch choice also falsifies it even when message text is unchanged. Failing the false-refusal threshold or showing no gain over data-only taint falsifies the practical hypothesis; unchanged QM scores do not invalidate a genuine isolation improvement.
risks: Incomplete origin instrumentation or a shared buggy serializer can satisfy both type checks and synthetic probes.
An opaque model/provider can have undeclared cache/history channels beyond the observed broker boundary.
Copying only a candidate hash still breaks strict candidate blindness; cryptographic opacity is not noninterference.
The challenge pattern is inherited from earlier research; the novel contribution is enforceable visibility at composition, not an additional correctness witness.
nodes.budget_formula: Two calls, zero retries: I_total<=12000; O_total<=4200 (3600+600). C_max<=12000*p_in+4200*p_out+sum(F_s)+R+C_metered_host+C_paid_evaluation. Under common conditional assumptions reserve USD0.043. Every later added compiler/helper/judge call consumes the same two-call and USD0.10 limits.

nodes.name: Premise stress tests with replayable finite countermodels

mathematical_basis.known_method: Bounded model finding, antecedent satisfiability checks and countermodels for premise dependence.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Require candidate inference claims to expose a bounded, independently interpretable premise context. The host enumerates a frozen public carrier and separately tests whether the antecedent has any instances, whether the stated implication has a countermodel, and which declared premise omissions admit countermodels. EIS reports distinct vacuity, invalid-inference and dependence findings; PCIV produces a single wrapper patch tied to a replayed witness; OPERADS keeps audit-view hypotheses separate from immutable task premises.
mathematical_basis.finite_queries: For explicit finite Omega and candidate Gamma={a1,...,ak}, Q, let S={w in Omega: all a in Gamma hold}; W0={w in S: not Q(w)}. For each j let Wj={w in Omega: all a_i with i!=j hold, not a_j(w), and not Q(w)}. Nonempty W0 is a checked countermodel to the encoded implication. Empty S is VACUOUS_IN_SCOPE, not proof of global inconsistency. Nonempty Wj demonstrates that dropping a_j permits a failure in this finite interpretation; it does not prove a_j is globally necessary or scientifically causal.
mathematical_basis.countermodel_scope: A valuation over uninterpreted atoms may be unrealizable under the intended mathematics. Such valuations are only abstract dependency diagnostics. A claim-level refutation requires a concrete witness satisfying a separately checked decoder and every original domain constraint. Empty W0 is NO_COUNTERMODEL_IN_SCOPE unless Omega is demonstrably the entire declared finite domain; it never certifies an unbounded analytic statement.
mathematical_basis.system_bridge: PFP's relation is encoded-premises-and-counterexample, checked by independent exact replay. The EIS signal is the replayed failed implication or vacuous scope, not agreement with the solver. PCIV records the public witness class and a protected wrapper edit. OPERADS ports distinguish OriginalTaskContext from AuditContextMinusPremise and forbid substituting the latter for the former.
mathematical_basis.distinct_from_prior: R01-I01 checks dependency closure; R01-I02 checks formula definedness/branch coverage; R08-I02 challenges extractor distinctions; R05-I02 generates blind tests. This mechanism instead searches for premise inconsistency and relative premise necessity in a fixed finite interpretation, including cases where every listed parent is present but the implication is invalid or vacuous.
mathematical_basis.external_signature: (RunContext, PublicPremiseTheory, FiniteCarrier, ReferenceReplay) -> OutcomeWithPremiseAudit. These theory/decoder inputs must be frozen independently of private scores. A solver-generated premise AST is untrusted input, not authority to define the host theory. Missing interpretation produces OPEN_UNSUPPORTED rather than an invented checker.

assumptions: Only explicit finite relations, bounded Boolean formulas with independently justified interpretation, and bounded exact-rational ASTs are admitted.
Candidate claims remain linked to original seed obligations; audit deletions never modify seed bytes, task assumptions or the final requested scope.
The independent replayer does not reuse the candidate evaluator's parsing/normalization path for every critical operation.
Countermodels or apparent vacuity under abstract/unrealizable interpretations are not passed off as task errors; each receipt carries its interpretation scope.
nodes.hypothesis: Against dependency-closure checking alone, premise stress testing detects more injected vacuous or invalid local implications on an untouched synthetic panel while preserving every supported valid implication; on the frozen seed it reduces unqualified use of extra assumptions without losing more than 3 rubric points at equal total resources.

stages.instruction: Freeze public interpretation, bounds and controls; reserve the two-call envelope and include exact original seed bytes. Refuse a theory bundle derived from private seed labels.

Return a complete answer and at most eight local implication claims with explicit premise ASTs and public-obligation bindings. Do not select or relabel host interpretation rules. Extra assumptions must be identified as extra.

Evaluate S,W0,Wj within the declared carrier, replay selected witnesses independently, and preserve all original task assumptions. Select at most four findings in fixed claim-ID order. A failed realization bridge remains abstract; empty search and resource exhaustion are never correctness.

Receive the unchanged seed, original candidate and only allowlisted public claim IDs, premise IDs, scope labels and witness classes. Correct the original derivation or qualify unresolved local steps; never weaken the task. No private evaluator feedback and no second search/repair cycle.

Apply schema-valid claim patches, recheck changed public implications and dependency receipts, retain the original if patch binding fails, and freeze answer plus all unresolved premise/encoding obligations. Public finite checks remain separate from private mathematical grading.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Same two-call complete draft plus dependency/context audit and one repair, with identical endpoint, input/output ceilings and checker CPU allowance.
ablations: Countermodel search without antecedent satisfiability
No premise-removal views
Shared candidate/replay evaluator instead of separately implemented replay
Abstract Boolean witnesses accepted without realization checks, in synthetic controls only
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Synthetic confirmation families include inconsistent antecedents, an omitted necessary premise, a genuinely redundant premise, a valid implication with no sampled antecedent instance, and unrealizable Boolean countermodels. Report scope-conditioned false refutations, witnessed invalid implications, vacuity findings, premise coverage, original-answer completeness and later trusted rubric score.

nodes.falsification: A purported concrete countermodel that fails an original domain constraint falsifies the replay bridge. Treating an empty sampled antecedent as globally inconsistent, or an empty search as a universal proof, falsifies the reporting contract. No increased detection over closure-only checking, any false refutation of supported valid fixtures, or violation of the preregistered accuracy-loss margin defeats the stated benefit.
risks: An independent finite interpretation may be unavailable for the seed's analytic claims; many results may correctly remain OPEN.
Candidate and replayer may share the same erroneous semantic encoding even when their arithmetic code differs.
A premise needed in one finite carrier need not be globally minimal, and a redundant premise need not be safe to delete from the user's requested formulation.
A patch may repair its abstract encoding while leaving prose wrong; unlinked prose remains unchecked.
nodes.budget_formula: Two calls, zero retries: I_total<=14000; O_total<=4400 (3000+1400). C_max<=14000*p_in+4400*p_out+sum(F_s)+R+C_metered_host+C_paid_evaluation. Under common conditional assumptions reserve USD0.046, with all public searches local and bounded.

nodes.name: Factorial isolation of proof-context and diagnostic-repair synergy

mathematical_basis.known_method: A randomized full 2x2 factorial experiment identifies interactions separately from main effects.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Fix one two-call draft/repair graph. Factor A adds typed premise/dependency context to the draft and host validation. Factor B replaces generic repair instructions with a calibrated, allowlisted public diagnostic packet. PCIV freezes the four wrapper configurations and their ancestry, PFP checks candidate-bound artifacts, EIS supplies the fixed diagnostic intervention, and OPERADS guarantees the same input/output skeleton and visibility policy in every arm. Each run executes only its assigned arm.
mathematical_basis.estimand: For fixed-seed expected final rubric score mu_ab under A=a,B=b, define Delta=mu_11-mu_10-mu_01+mu_00. With Y=beta0+betaA*A+betaB*B+betaAB*A*B+error and 0/1 coding, betaAB=Delta. Positive individual gains do not imply Delta>0. Report all four cell means, marginal contrasts and Delta; do not claim every named subsystem contributes from mu_11 alone.
mathematical_basis.design: Use equal allocation within preregistered time/model blocks, fresh provider samples, fixed N per cell, no arm selection from private outcomes, and intention-to-treat inclusion of refusals/truncations/timeouts. Endpoint/settings and total output allowance are equal across arms. Actual input/cost differences remain measured; equal-token and equal-money comparisons are distinct preregistered analyses, not assumed identical.
mathematical_basis.finite_uncertainty: For independent bounded scores Y in [0,100] and N samples per cell, Hoeffding plus a union bound gives simultaneous mean radius epsilon=100*sqrt(log(8/alpha)/(2*N)). Then Delta is within plus/minus 4*epsilon of the plug-in contrast with confidence at least 1-alpha under those assumptions. This deliberately conservative bound can be inconclusive; no invented small-N significance or cross-problem generalization. Blocking/randomization may justify a tighter preregistered randomization analysis.
mathematical_basis.distinct_from_prior: R04-I03 studies operation order; R09-I01 randomizes repair versus re-derivation; R03-I01 compares sibling wrappers. This experiment isolates the interaction of two independently toggled mechanisms at a fixed order and fixed call count. A hybrid win with zero or negative Delta is reported as additive benefit or interference, not synergy.
mathematical_basis.external_signature: Single assigned run: (RunContext, FactorialAssignment, FrozenFactorialProtocol, CalibratedPublicCheckerBundle) -> OutcomeWithArmReceipt. Analysis: (FrozenOutcomes, PostFreezeTrustedScores, FactorialProtocol) -> InteractionReport. The analysis is a separate offline campaign operator, not RunContext -> Outcome and not eligible for blind solver composition.
mathematical_basis.composition_constraint: No four-arm branch executes inside a run. Four isolated invocations form a campaign block, each with its own complete-run cap and an aggregate campaign ledger. Private scores enter only the terminal offline analysis, which has no edge back to wrappers, selection or either model call.

assumptions: All four configurations are semantically the same full unchanged seed task; disabling A removes optional artifact structure, never requested mathematical content or task assumptions.
The same public checker definitions apply wherever an arm has a parseable artifact; missing machine-readable claims remain unavailable rather than being counted correct.
Factor B's off arm still performs the same bounded generic revision and final public measurement; it simply receives no candidate-specific detector guidance before revision.
Assignments and sample sizes are frozen before results. Repetitions estimate provider variability on one item; shared model/parser biases remain possible in every cell.
nodes.hypothesis: The joint mechanism has Delta at least +3 rubric points and mu_11 is no more than 2 points below the best single-mechanism arm, while every assigned run respects USD0.10 and two calls. Claim synergy only if the preregistered interval supports the +3 threshold; otherwise report inconclusive or antagonistic interaction.

stages.instruction: Verify the precommitted arm and external checker provenance. Reserve just this run's two calls under its cap and the already-authorized aggregate campaign budget. Preserve the exact seed and fixed graph shape.

Receive the unchanged seed and exactly the assigned A wrapper. A=1 requests premise/dependency artifact context; A=0 requests the same full derivation with ordinary section labels. Both have identical output ceilings.

Run fixed public checks without private scoring. B=1 exposes only calibrated, scope-labelled public diagnostic classes; B=0 supplies the fixed generic revision instruction. Bind diagnostics to the draft hash. Do not adapt the selected arm or spend ceiling.

Receive the unchanged seed, draft and assigned revision view. Return a complete revised answer under the same 1600-token ceiling in all arms, with explicit unresolved parts if needed. No additional judge or synthesis call.

Run the same final public measurements and freeze the revised answer, or an explicit failure when no usable revision exists, with both raw artifacts retained. Later trusted scores belong only to offline analysis. No best-arm selection or prompt update occurs within this protocol.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: A=0,B=0 is the same-model two-call draft plus generic revision baseline. A=1,B=0 and A=0,B=1 identify the single-mechanism controls; A=1,B=1 is the hybrid.
ablations: Remove candidate binding from diagnostics only in public fault controls
Replace calibrated diagnostics with length-matched generic guidance in a separately budgeted follow-up, not an unregistered fifth primary arm
Compare raw draft and final response offline to locate repair-induced harm without choosing between them online
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: The campaign has four cells, not one eight-call run. Record every raw score/cost and all failures before aggregation. Report common failure clusters across all cells to expose shared-semantic/parser errors. Freeze one primary interaction contrast and uncertainty method; additional contrasts are labelled exploratory. No score-driven PCIV promotion until a separately preregistered fresh confirmation experiment.

nodes.falsification: If the interaction interval excludes +3 from above, the specified synergy hypothesis fails; an interval spanning the threshold is inconclusive. Unequal call counts, answer-key-dependent assignment, hidden arm-specific retries or dropping failed runs invalidate the comparison. A positive Delta cannot certify the checker or imply transfer beyond this item.
risks: Short revised-answer caps may create arm-specific truncation; that is an observed failure, not permission to silently expand one arm.
Typed contexts consume prompt/output space, so equal ceilings estimate the complete mechanism package rather than an isolated zero-cost mathematical effect.
A common faulty parser or shared model misconception can make all arms agree while remaining wrong.
Four-arm replication can require substantial aggregate spend despite small per-run costs; no campaign has been authorized or launched here.
nodes.budget_formula: Each assigned run makes exactly two planned calls and zero retries: I_total<=14000; O_total<=4400 (2800+1600). Conditional reserve USD0.046 per complete run. A four-cell block reserves up to USD0.184 at these thresholds, or USD0.40 at the absolute per-run caps, and needs separate aggregate authorization. Offline analysis uses no paid model calls.

research_agent_reports.focus: Typed mathematical certificates, proof-obligation decomposition, and checked interfaces between representations

scope.seed_access: Read only dag/benchmark/seed_prompt.txt to classify required proof obligations. No seed solution, derived seed formula, answer-key material, or paid-model output is included in this report.
scope.novelty_claim: These are proposed adaptations to this repository and benchmark, not claims of literature-wide novelty. Proof-carrying artifacts, skeptical checking, case splitting, and compositional validation are established methods.
scope.implementation_boundary: The certificate schemas, claim-scope lattice, obligation compiler, and symbolic adapters below are proposals. Existing exact rational and univariate polynomial code does not certify arbitrary multivariate, transcendental, or quantum statements.
scope.benchmark_isolation: Every workflow sends the unchanged UTF-8 seed as its own message, with its exact original byte sequence preserved and hashed before and after request construction. Instructions and artifacts occupy separate messages. Never normalize or rewrite seed bytes. Host checks use only public input, frozen checker definitions, and model artifacts. Freeze all candidate outputs before separate trusted answer-key evaluation. Never feed private scores, labels, diagnostics, key-derived examples, or key-selected repair hints into any workflow stage.

primary_sources.title: George C. Necula, Proof-Carrying Code, POPL 1997
primary_sources.relevance: Established separation between an untrusted producer supplying evidence and a consumer checking that evidence against a declared policy. Motivates binding each certificate to an exact proposition and explicit assumptions; does not establish semantic adequacy of our proposed mathematical policies.

primary_sources.title: Armand et al., A Modular Integration of SAT/SMT Solvers to Coq through Proof Witnesses, CPP 2011
primary_sources.relevance: Established skeptical use of external solvers via independently rechecked witnesses and modular certified checking. Motivates separate certificate kinds and explicit unsupported-theory residuals rather than one general correctness flag.

primary_sources.title: SMTCoq project documentation
primary_sources.relevance: Documents proof-witness checking and small compositional certifying preprocessing transformations. Useful precedent for checked representation changes; this report does not claim SMTCoq is installed or supports the benchmark's analytic theories.

primary_sources.title: OpenRouter API: List all models and their properties
primary_sources.relevance: Documents model pricing, supported parameters, and completion limits. Execution must fetch and pin current endpoint prices; the numerical costs here are conditional admission examples, not current model-price quotations.

repository_evidence.observation: Separates inventory, proof review, and executable evaluation; requires immutable seed, isolated key, bounded workflows, and aggregate USD 0.10 reservations.
PFP acceptance is relative to injected judges; envelope validity, judge agreement, and predicate adequacy are distinct.
Host-authored feedback classes exist because raw judge messages may contain answers; judges are injected and their failures are recorded. A new repair stage must preserve that information boundary.
Q refuses floats and booleans, canonicalizes an explicit rational representation, and refuses inversion of zero. Supplies a bounded arithmetic substrate, not a symbolic analytic proof engine.

Implements univariate rational polynomial division and Sturm root counting with a stated half-open interval convention. This supports some branch certificates only after symbolic scope and endpoint conventions are fixed.

RationalWire uses bare integers for unit denominators, unlike q.py's p/q codec. RationalDualityGap computes equality of objective values; feasibility remains an additional obligation. New witnesses must version their codecs and retain premise obligations.
Exact matrix input is shape/type checked, and computational operations require an injected port; an unbound port is an infrastructure failure, not a mathematical refutation.

Partial composition checks arity and colour compatibility and records residual effects. Proposed proof-interface obligations can attach to these existing typed boundaries, but colour equality alone does not prove semantic compatibility.
Finite detectors do not establish semantic completeness or observer independence; clean reports do not admit candidates. Proposed mutations are finite controls, not soundness proofs.

Experimental selection requires paired records, rejects incomplete/infrastructure states, checks provenance, and requires fresh confirmation. It is suitable for offline evaluation after freezing outputs, never for leaking private feedback into seed-solving stages.

Certificate synthesis and independent checking already exist as workflow ideas. The proposals below extend obligation closure, branch coverage, and representation transport rather than rebranding certificate synthesis.

common_budget_policy.formula: Reserve C_max = sum_s(I_s*p_in_s + O_s*p_out_s + F_s) + R before dispatch, with prices in USD/token. I_s includes the unchanged seed, schema, system instructions, and prior artifacts; O_s includes all billable reasoning and response tokens. Require C_max <= 0.10. R covers any explicitly priced additional fees; unknown charges or uncapped billable reasoning cause refusal.
common_budget_policy.conditional_example: With each admitted endpoint at p_in <= 0.000001 and p_out <= 0.000005, F_s=0, R=0.01, all three specified token envelopes fit. These are admissibility thresholds, not asserted current prices or a selected model.
common_budget_policy.routing: OpenRouter or direct Anthropic is admissible only after current endpoint prices, actual input token bounds, completion caps, and billable-token semantics are pinned. Disable automatic model fallback and retries. Timeouts retain the full reservation; unknown usage stops the run. A second planned stage is not an unbounded repair loop.
common_budget_policy.receipts: Record endpoint/model/version, price snapshot, exact request hashes, maximum completion tokens, provider usage, actual charged cost, and remaining reservation. No paid calls were made for this report.
common_budget_policy.host_compute: Host checking has explicit degree, AST-size, node-count, integer-bit-size, memory, and time bounds. Provider spend ceiling excludes already provisioned local CPU with zero incremental monetary charge; any metered host charge must also be reserved or execution refused.

ideas.name: Dependency-closed certificate shards with selective repair

mathematical_basis.known_method: Proof-carrying artifacts and modular skeptical checking: each admitted inference consumes propositions with explicit contexts and produces a proposition with a checked local witness.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Represent a mathematical response as a bounded DAG of certificate shards. Every shard carries statement-AST hash, assumption-context hash, branch scope, checker kind/version, witness, and dependency IDs. The host computes the backward closure of each requested conclusion and refuses a global certified label if any required shard is open, stale, ill-scoped, or merely numerical. Spend the second model call on the smallest deterministic failed dependency frontier, while preserving all unaffected shards.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: For a checked rule Gamma |- (P1 and ... and Pk) implies Q, Q can be closed only if all Pi are closed under compatible Gamma and branch scope. Residual(Q) includes every unclosed dependency and every explicit rule premise. Graph closure by itself is bookkeeping; the inference rule and semantic encoding still require a trusted checker or a residual marker.

assumptions: The public requested-conclusion inventory is separately fixed; the model may not delete requested sinks to improve apparent coverage.
A frozen finite inference-rule registry and parsers exist. New symbolic or analytic rules remain OPEN rather than inheriting a stronger label.
Exact checking is sound for its implemented fragment, and certificate/hash binding uses the intended serialization.
Initial pilot cap: at most 24 shards, 48 dependency edges, and 4 branch scopes; out-of-bound artifacts are incomplete rather than silently truncated.
ideas.hypothesis: At matched total token and dollar budgets, dependency-closed shards plus one frontier repair reduce accepted-but-unsupported conclusions relative to a whole-answer critique, without a material loss of final answer completeness.
typed_inputs: SeedBytes{utf8_bytes,sha256}; original seed bytes repeated unchanged in each model call
typed_outputs: FinalResponse{answer_text,claim_to_shard_map,residual_obligations}; mathematical content is generated only in a future experiment

stages.instruction: Hash seed bytes; preserve them as a separate unchanged message. Freeze requested sinks, inference registry, resource caps, and price metadata. Read no private evaluator material.

Produce the requested derivation and bounded typed shard DAG. State every assumption, domain condition, and dependency. Supply witnesses only in the allowed kinds. Label unsupported analytic claims OPEN; never declare your own host verdict. Preserve all requested conclusion IDs.

stages.role: Exact local checking and residual propagation
stages.instruction: Check schema, binding, acyclicity, contexts, local witnesses, and conclusion closure. Compute the first failed frontier in deterministic sink/ID order. Return only allowlisted public failure classes and artifact-local pointers, never private diagnostic text or expected answers.

Patch only named failed shards and downstream prose references. Do not change immutable seed, requested sink inventory, registry, or untouched shard hashes. Provide explicit residuals if the frontier cannot be closed within the allowed rule set.

Recheck changed shards and their descendants; never accept stale receipts. Freeze final output and cost receipt. Separate exact identities, admitted theorem applications, numerical checks, and open obligations. Trusted private evaluation occurs only after freezing and cannot trigger another stage.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Two-call draft plus whole-answer self-critique with the same total output cap, model endpoint, immutable seed, and public checking budget.
ablations: Typed shards without dependency/context closure
Full-answer rewrite instead of frontier repair
Closure ledger without a second call
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Freeze paired configurations before runs. On public synthetic certificate fixtures, measure corrupted-parent propagation, missing-premise detection, and valid-control preservation. On separately scored final answers, record completeness, unsupported certification, aggregate cost, and abstention. PCIV selection/confirmation is an offline experiment step; no seed feedback returns to model calls.

ideas.falsification: Reject the claimed advantage if matched-budget final correctness does not improve, if completeness declines beyond the preregistered tolerance, or if any deliberately corrupted required parent still produces a closed requested sink. A common-mode checker bug is a falsification of the checker contract, not evidence against the underlying mathematics.
risks: The model can omit a semantic premise even when its graph is syntactically complete; a host sink/rule inventory is necessary.
Token overhead can crowd out the derivation. Coverage must be measured alongside false-acceptance reduction.
A shared erroneous parser can validate both the claim and witness. Positive/negative controls do not prove parser adequacy.
Public host feedback may reveal mathematical structure; this is allowed only when derived from declared public predicates, never the answer key.
ideas.budget_formula: C_max <= 14000*p_in + 4400*p_out + sum(F_s) + R, two calls and zero retries. At the conditional thresholds p_in=0.000001, p_out=0.000005, F_s=0, R=0.01, reserve USD 0.046. Refuse if actual tokenization or current prices exceed the reservation.

ideas.name: Definedness certificates with exhaustive branch coverage

mathematical_basis.known_method: Partial-function definedness obligations, proof by cases, and exact Boolean/polynomial reasoning.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Make every division, logarithm, square root, inverse, and earliest-attainment assertion produce a typed domain obligation before it can contribute to a global answer. Require an explicit complement branch for any guarded formula. The host separately checks coverage, branch compatibility, and local definedness; it does not infer branch correctness from prose saying 'by continuity'.
mathematical_basis.obligations: For public domain D and branch guards B_i, certify D implies OR_i B_i and pairwise disjointness, or provide overlap-agreement certificates. For expression e_i, certify D and B_i implies Defined(e_i). A limit-extension is a distinct witness kind and cannot be replaced by substitution into an undefined term.
mathematical_basis.bounded_checker_fragment: Boolean partitions over at most 8 declared atoms can be enumerated exactly. Such enumeration proves propositional coverage for every valuation, not real feasibility. Algebraic implications require an independently checked witness; univariate rational cases may use Sturm certificates with explicit endpoints. Multivariate/transcendental implications remain residual unless an additional verified checker is supplied.

assumptions: A strict expression AST exposes every partial operator and rejects unsupported function syntax rather than treating it as total.
The public domain and variable sorts are fixed from the seed without adding answer-derived restrictions.
The pilot admits at most 8 domain atoms and 16 branches; more complex answers are reported incomplete.
Global answer correctness includes requested exceptional cases, not merely the generic branch.
ideas.hypothesis: One-call derivation with mechanically extracted definedness obligations and explicit complement branches reduces exceptional-case and undefined-expression errors more efficiently than a generic 'check edge cases' instruction.

stages.role: Seed binder and domain registry gate
stages.instruction: Preserve exact seed bytes in a separate message. Supply only operator semantics, schema, and public assumptions. Pin prices and the single-call reservation.

Return the requested derivation with typed guards and definedness witnesses. For each partial operator, state its domain. Every excluded guard requires a complement branch or an explicit unresolved obligation. Distinguish substitution from a proved limiting extension. Separate existence of an optimum from a claim about the earliest attaining argument.

Extract partial operators from ASTs, check declared branches cover the public domain, and dispatch only supported exact witnesses. Flag missing or incompatible branches and unsupported implication proofs. Generate synthetic mutations of these public artifacts by dropping a complement, weakening a guard, or changing an endpoint; do not mutate the seed and do not use private benchmark labels.

Freeze answer, branch receipt, mutation-control results, and usage receipt. Certification labels describe only checked coverage and definedness. Private answer evaluation remains separate with no repair feedback.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Single call with the same 4000-token cap and explicit natural-language edge-case instructions but no typed branch schema.
ablations: Branch list without host coverage check
Coverage check without extracted partial-operator obligations
Definedness checks without complement branches
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Use answer-independent synthetic fixtures with removable and non-removable singularities, empty attainment sets, constant functions, and overlapping branches. Measure missed undefined nodes, missing-domain regions, false rejection of valid branch encodings, final completeness, and per-run cost. The seed is one separately frozen evaluation target, not enough evidence for a general improvement claim.

ideas.falsification: A dropped required complement branch accepted as globally covered falsifies the coverage checker. No matched-budget improvement on exceptional-case error rate, or a completeness loss that cancels the gains, falsifies the workflow hypothesis. Passing Boolean coverage cannot count as verifying a real-arithmetic guard implication.
risks: A generic symbolic simplifier may silently cancel a denominator and erase the original definedness requirement.
Atom explosion exceeds the finite partition cap; fail explicitly rather than prune cases without evidence.
Analytic continuations, extrema, and transcendental signs need more than rational arithmetic.
The model may place important formulas only in prose, bypassing AST checks; unlinked prose must remain unchecked.
ideas.budget_formula: C_max <= 10000*p_in + 4000*p_out + F_1 + R, one call and zero retries. Conditional thresholds give USD 0.040 including the USD 0.01 reserve.

ideas.name: Witnessed representation transport at proof interfaces

mathematical_basis.known_method: Compositional certifying transformations and preservation proofs between mathematical representations.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Require an explicit transport witness whenever a derivation changes coordinate convention, basis ordering, tensor-factor order, polynomial encoding, or exact-number codec. A second bounded model call produces only missing transport witnesses from the first candidate. A host checks a commuting relation between source and destination representations and binds every downstream claim to the verified convention context.
mathematical_basis.transport_rule: For source object x, destination object y, and declared map T, check y=T(x), the map's admitted properties, and the theorem justifying transport of predicate P to P'. If a reversible change is claimed, also check an inverse witness. For finite rational matrix examples, check dimensions, exact equalities, and the required inverse or orthogonality identities. Predicate preservation is separate from equality of serialization hashes.
mathematical_basis.effect_rule: Each operad edge consumes a ConventionContext hash and produces one; unproved convention changes produce residual obligations. Scope cannot strengthen from numeric spot-check to exact identity, from exact instance to universal parameter claim, or from representation equivalence to physical interpretation.

assumptions: Source objects and conventions must be bound to the public task, not merely to two mutually consistent model artifacts.
A finite transport registry is fixed in advance; the pilot accepts only explicit permutations, declared exact codec maps, and bounded rational matrix identities.
Any required complex, multivariate, or analytic transport without an implemented checker is reported open.
Different syntactic representations and two model calls do not imply independent errors.
ideas.hypothesis: At matched two-call cost, transport witnesses detect convention drift and invalid claim reuse more reliably than asking a second model pass to judge whether the answer looks consistent.

stages.instruction: Keep the exact seed bytes as a separate message. Freeze the public convention schema, admitted transport registry, and two-call reservation. Do not provide solved seed objects or private formulas.

Produce the requested derivation. Give every object its dimensions, variable sorts, and convention-context ID. Mark each representation change as an edge with source and target hashes; identify the mathematical property that must survive that change.

Type-check the candidate and select at most four unresolved transport edges by fixed source order. Provide source/target artifacts and required witness schema only. No private scores or expected corrected expressions enter the request.

Supply explicit maps, inverse witnesses where needed, and preservation-rule applications for the selected edges. Do not approve the answer by agreement. Do not silently alter source objects. Return OPEN when no admitted witness applies.

Check every claimed transport under its context and scope; invalidate dependent reuse when an edge fails. Use public synthetic permutation/codec/transpose mutations as finite controls. Freeze final answer, open interfaces, and cost receipts before separate private scoring.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Two-call derivation plus consistency review at equal 4000-token total output cap and identical endpoint configuration.
ablations: Context IDs with no transport witness
Witness equality checks without predicate-preservation obligations
Transport checks without source-to-public-task binding
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Pair runs by task and repetition; include public synthetic changes of basis order, tensor-factor order, exact-number codec, and matrix transposition. Measure convention-error detection, false rejection, complete final correctness, and cost. Offline PCIV selection uses frozen receipts and an independent confirmation split.

ideas.falsification: The mechanism fails if a source/target pair with a deliberately incorrect transport map is admitted, or if a correct transport of the wrong public-task object is promoted to a correct task answer. The practical hypothesis fails if transport overhead does not improve matched-budget final accuracy or convention-error detection.
risks: Two incorrect encodings may agree; explicit source-task binding is still required.
A map can preserve algebraic form while changing semantic interpretation; the preservation theorem must match the intended predicate.
Existing RationalWire and Q codecs differ, so implicit parser interchange would create false agreement or unnecessary rejection.
The bounded four-edge witness budget can leave interfaces open; an honest partial receipt is not a complete solution.
ideas.budget_formula: C_max <= 12000*p_in + 4000*p_out + sum(F_s) + R, two calls and zero retries. Conditional thresholds give USD 0.042 including the USD 0.01 reserve.

recommended_reusable_primitive.name: ScopedObligationReceiptV1
recommended_reusable_primitive.recommendation: Implement this host-owned primitive before any particular workflow: it is shared by shard closure, branch definedness, and representation transport.
recommended_reusable_primitive.invariant: Only the host issues statuses. Composition cannot erase inherited residuals, change seed/candidate binding, or strengthen scope without a separately checked rule. Distinct statement, candidate, and codec hashes are mandatory; no universal VERIFIED bit.
recommended_reusable_primitive.research_prompt_instruction: Design the ScopedObligationReceiptV1 schema, bounded checker dispatch, and synthetic positive/negative controls. Do not solve the benchmark seed. Do not include any seed-specific derived formula, spectral value, state, optimum, entanglement condition, or worked seed example in this research report. You may describe obligation categories required by the public seed. Never read an answer key or private benchmark storage. Preserve the seed's exact bytes and keep it separate from instructions.
recommended_reusable_primitive.first_experiment: A host-only synthetic receipt test suite followed by one matched-budget R01-I02 pilot. This starts with an observable gap, requires only one paid model call in any later authorized run, and makes unsupported analytic obligations visible. No such pilot was executed here.

research_agent_reports.focus: EIS finite detector adequacy, negative selection, two-signal gating, and bounded diagnostic immunity

scope.source_baseline: Parent-assigned 8050c66900899771766f33e8f5fdd200b7dd9120 plus the in-progress dag audit; repository observations refer to the local files read for this report.
scope.seed_access: Seed contents were not read or solved. A read-only SHA-256 integrity check gave 9941ab91f8e6b6637e49bb364cc0e6451788dd96442afcdb7f7024de042500a7. No private benchmark storage or answer key was accessed.
scope.novelty_claim: These are new proposed compositions for this repository, not literature-wide novelty claims. Negative selection, metamorphic controls, finite coverage optimization, selective prediction, and scoped regulation are established methods or existing repository components.
scope.benchmark_isolation: Future answer-producing calls receive the original UTF-8 seed as a separate unchanged message; round-trip decoding and re-encoding must retain the exact bytes and SHA-256. A seed-free detector-induction call is explicitly marked as such. Instructions, controls and artifacts remain separate from the seed. No key, private label, private score, key-derived example, evaluator diagnostic or key-selected repair hint enters any model call, host rule selection, memory or retrieval corpus. Freeze all candidate outputs before separate trusted evaluation; evaluator feedback never triggers another stage.
scope.calibration_boundary: All controls below come from a separately specified public synthetic grammar, not benchmark answer material. Freeze development, calibration and confirmation partitions before inducing detectors. Selection uses calibration once; confirmation can reject the frozen selection but cannot tune or repair it. If a partition is reused for tuning it is development evidence, and a fresh confirmation partition is required. Public availability does not by itself prevent model pretraining contamination.
scope.single_seed_limit: Repeated runs on one public seed can compare stochastic outcomes for that instance. They cannot establish detector completeness, a general error rate, out-of-distribution immunity, or population-level learning improvement. Tuning on this seed makes it development data; fresh independent tasks are required for generalization claims.
scope.implementation_boundary: No workflow was implemented or run. Proposed AST detector DSLs, confirmation controls, repair routing, memory leases and typed adapters require implementation. Existing EIS activation emits FINDING/HOLD/REFUSE with AuthorityEffect None and does not authorize repair or admit a candidate. Any future repair stage is a separate benchmark scheduler operation. Current guards and native ports must be validated before integration.

primary_sources.title: Forrest, Perelson, Allen and Cherukuri, Self-Nonself Discrimination in a Computer, IEEE S&P 1994
primary_sources.relevance: Primary negative-selection method: screen candidate detectors against self before using retained detectors for change detection. This supports the finite screening design, not a theorem that our learned rules detect all mathematical errors.

primary_sources.title: Chen, Cheung and Yiu, Metamorphic Testing: A New Approach for Generating Next Test Cases, HKUST-CS98-01
primary_sources.relevance: Primary report proposing related follow-up tests to expose failures when full test oracles are unavailable. Motivates benign syntax transformations and paired defect mutations; each proposed relation still needs an independently justified contract.

primary_sources.title: El-Yaniv and Wiener, On the Foundations of Noise-free Selective Classification, JMLR 2010
primary_sources.relevance: Primary treatment of coverage versus risk with a reject option. Motivates measuring diagnostic coverage and errors together. Its distributional results do not transfer to a single mathematical seed or finite hand-designed controls without their assumptions.

primary_sources.title: OpenRouter Models API documentation
primary_sources.relevance: Documents per-token/request/unit pricing fields, possible pricing overrides, supported parameters and completion limits. Every future run must pin current endpoint metadata and reserve every billable component; this report does not quote a current model price.

repository_evidence.observation: Audit coverage is distinct from evaluation; seed bytes are immutable; key evaluation is separate; paid runs require aggregate USD 0.10 reservations.

Audit bounds exact EIS thresholds and declared correlation support; warns that fixture success is not detector completeness. It also records a tolerance-equality/hash mismatch in DetectorRule and Signal1Match, so proposed registries use canonical byte digests rather than those objects as set keys.

evaluate_rule forces active screening, binds the actual matcher, and tests every self fixture. Passing means no hit on those fixtures only. The proposed adequate-set selection adds defect sensitivity and untouched confirmation, which this screen alone does not establish.

Activation requires admission, detector match, host danger and no suspension; model danger, common evidence and subject mismatch are rejected. Receipt distinctions are structural safeguards, not statistical independence. Dispositions exclude repair and admission.

The operational path obtains custody externally, calls a host DangerSensor on the subject bytes, uses native activation, and requires authenticated host health. The low-level Boolean law is not the complete deployment trust boundary.

Hill activation is an exact monotone sum threshold. A per-sensor cap gives a lower bound on distinct positive names, not independent observations or truth. The proposed workflows do not treat quorum as a correctness certificate.

Support deduplicates occurrences and declared provenance, rejects propagated references, and computes exact MIS for at most 32 deduplicated observations. Missing correlation edges remain an epistemic limitation.

Existing scoped guidance chooses at most three signatures above an execution-error threshold, requiring a reproducer and non-triggered benign control. It is candidate-only and does not request activation. The third proposal adds freshness, paired transfer controls and abstention.

Regulation can narrow only selected optional guards within a bounded scope. Independent benign checks are subject-bound; unavailable checks cannot establish benignity; protected gates cannot be suspended.
A benign-hit threshold emits a proposal and leaves is_suspended false. Repetition alone does not supply evidence or authorize suspension.

Finite controls do not give a population rate; telemetry without TN cannot yield FP/(FP+TN); observer independence and detector completeness remain open. Clean reports, scores, support and signatures each answer only their declared question.

common_budget_policy.formula: Before dispatch reserve C_max = sum_s(I_s*p_in_s + O_s*p_out_s + Q_s*p_reason_s + F_s) + R <= USD 0.10. I_s covers all instructions, unchanged seed when present, schemas and prior artifacts; O_s covers ordinary output; Q_s covers separately billed reasoning if it is not already included in O_s. Never double-count or omit provider-specific reasoning charges. Any uncapped billable component causes refusal.
common_budget_policy.conditional_example: The per-idea numerical examples assume p_in <= USD 0.000001/token and all billable completion/reasoning tokens together cost <= USD 0.000005/token, with F_s=0 and R=USD 0.01. These are endpoint admission thresholds, not assertions of current OpenRouter or Anthropic prices.
common_budget_policy.routing: Admit a pinned OpenRouter endpoint or direct Anthropic endpoint only after current prices, pricing overrides, tokenization, context limits, output limits and usage semantics fit the envelope. Disable retries, automatic fallback, paid tools, web search and uncapped reasoning. For an unknown price override refuse or reserve a verified upper bound. Reserve the full second call before the first even when conditional. A timeout retains its reservation and unknown usage ends the run.
common_budget_policy.receipts: Store model/provider identity, price timestamp, request hashes, input and output bounds, actual token usage and charged costs. Do not place secrets in receipts. Detector induction in I01 is charged in that run; I02 and I03 use only frozen deterministic public registries, not an unaccounted paid training process.
common_budget_policy.host_compute: Bound controls to 96 per partition, 12 detector candidates, 64 AST nodes per detector, 4096 subset evaluations, and declared per-check memory/time limits. Zero-incremental-cost local checking is assumed; any metered host cost must be added or the run refused. Paid model calls made for this research report: zero.

ideas.name: Dual-panel negative selection with finite defect coverage

mathematical_basis.known_method: Negative selection screens out self-reactive detectors; metamorphic testing supplies related controls; finite set cover selects a bounded family covering declared defect examples.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Have a seed-free model propose at most 12 bounded AST detector rules from public development controls. Test the exact runtime matcher on paired benign and contract-invalid mutations. Select the smallest self-tolerant subset covering every required calibration family; then test that frozen subset once on untouched confirmation controls. Preserve an adequacy vector by family instead of converting panel success into a general correctness score. A second call constructs the task answer with the frozen warning schema, and the host reports hits and uncovered families without issuing a truth verdict.
mathematical_basis.finite_contract: For benign controls B, defect controls M partitioned into nonempty families M_f, and detector set S: FP_B(S)=sum_b 1[exists d in S: d(b)=1]; C_f(S)=sum_m in M_f 1[exists d in S: d(m)=1]/|M_f|. Enumerate subsets of at most 12 rules and lexicographically minimize (|S|, canonical_ids) subject to FP_B(S)=0 and C_f(S)=1 on calibration. No feasible set produces INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE. Confirmation failures produce UNCONFIRMED and no reselection. These are exact finite counts, not distributional bounds.
mathematical_basis.semantic_boundary: Mutation labels mean valid or invalid for the declared artifact contract. Removing a premise or domain guard does not automatically prove the underlying conclusion false. An independently specified checker must establish every label; unknown labels are excluded and recorded. A hit is a diagnostic hypothesis, and silence is NO_FINDING_WITHIN_PANEL.

assumptions: A public typed artifact grammar, finite safe detector DSL and actual matcher exist; arbitrary model-generated executable code is never run.
Development, calibration and confirmation are frozen before induction; partitions separate transformation templates, not merely names or random seeds of the same string.

Possible control families include stale witness binding, missing required premise, unsupported promotion of evidence scope and declared sort mismatch. Each uses contract-valid benign counterparts with lexical overlap.
All host selection is seed-independent. Confirmation details remain offline and cannot become hints to the answer-producing stage.
No adequate detector subset means an ordinary answer with an explicit coverage gap, not a fabricated clean certificate or an unbudgeted detector rewrite.
ideas.hypothesis: At matched total spend, dual-panel selection reduces benign-trigger counts and exposes more declared contract-defect families than self-only negative selection, while avoiding an increase in unsupported certainty in the final answer.
typed_inputs: SeedBytes{utf8_bytes,sha256}; delivered unchanged only to the answer-producing call

stages.instruction: Freeze the public control grammar, three partitions, DSL interpreter and price reservation. Record the seed digest without modifying or incorporating seed content into detector controls.

Using only generic development controls and the supplied DSL, propose at most 12 diagnostic rules with failure-family scopes. Include no solution, truth verdict or authorization field. Do not infer the withheld task or retrieve any benchmark information.

stages.role: Exact finite negative-selection and coverage checker
stages.instruction: Run the actual matcher on calibration, enumerate feasible self-tolerant covering subsets, and choose deterministically. Evaluate the frozen selection on confirmation once. Record all counts and missing families. Never tune on confirmation or turn detector agreement into truth.

Answer the unchanged seed using the public output schema and frozen generic diagnostic predicates. State assumptions and open obligations. Detector controls are not mathematical evidence for your answer. Do not claim panel adequacy proves correctness.

Run selected rules only if confirmed, retain separate deterministic checker outcomes, and render finite scope and coverage gaps. A candidate with no hits receives no global pass. Freeze candidate, receipts and costs before any trusted private evaluation.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Self-panel-only negative selection using the same proposed rules, matcher, model endpoint and aggregate token cap; compare also a fixed generic checklist.
ablations: Remove benign metamorphic variants
Remove required per-family coverage
Select and report on the same partition, explicitly labeled a leakage-positive experimental control
Use all retained rules instead of minimum-cover selection
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Primary host-only endpoints are confirmation FP counts, covered defect families, detection counts and coverage gaps. Separately score frozen task answers for correctness, unsupported certainty and completeness at matched actual spend and a matched cap. Report total denominators, not only FP/(TP+FP). A single seed gives instance-specific outcomes only.

ideas.falsification: Reject the advantage if untouched confirmation benign hits rise, required families remain uncovered, or answer correctness/completeness deteriorates beyond a preregistered tolerance. A detector passing calibration but failing confirmation falsifies its transfer claim, not the correctness of all candidate answers.
risks: Finite grammar defects can be easier than real proof errors; family coverage cannot establish semantic completeness.
Correlated metamorphic variants inflate counts; report template-level results as well as instance counts.
Model and host may share a mistaken control contract. Label-checker adequacy remains explicit.
Reusing confirmation to select another subset creates calibration leakage even if no private answer key is involved.
Induction consumes tokens that could otherwise be spent on the derivation.
ideas.budget_formula: C_max <= 9000*p_in + 3600*p_out + sum(F_s) + R for two calls, no retries; all billable reasoning must fit the completion envelope or be reserved separately. At the common conditional thresholds and R=0.01, reserve USD 0.037.

ideas.name: Subject-bound two-signal repair routing with disagreement controls

mathematical_basis.known_method: Conjunctive guard activation and independent host checks already exist in EIS. Factorial control interventions test that either required input can block a gate. Evidence-carrying local repair is an established verification pattern.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Use a frozen EIS-style detector hit to identify a repair class and a separately executed exact host check to supply a concrete public failure witness about the same claim and candidate hash. Route at most one repair call only when both are present, the optional diagnostic rule is authorized for this research profile, health is current, and the rule is unsuspended. This scheduler action is separate from EIS activation. Validate the routing with all four hit/danger combinations and deliberately mismatched, stale and copied receipts.
mathematical_basis.gate: RouteRepair = ProfileAllowed and D(x) and H(x,w) and SameSubject and FreshBindings and Healthy and not Suspended and BudgetReserved. D and H use different code paths and evidence provenance, but no statistical independence is inferred. H is a failure of a declared public predicate or a checked counterexample, not an LLM opinion. Every deterministic failure is reported even when D(x)=0; the conjunction controls repair allocation, never hides a known failure or certifies the ungated candidate.
mathematical_basis.preservation: A repair must bind to the original candidate hash, change only declared claim IDs and dependent prose, and invalidate/recheck affected receipts. Failed repairs remain failed; successful local predicate checks are reported only for their declared scope. Two passing checkers do not establish theorem truth.

assumptions: A frozen public diagnostic registry and exact host checker exist for at least one declared artifact fragment; unsupported analytic statements remain OPEN.
Danger evidence is produced by the host from public candidate artifacts and allowed rules; no hidden evaluator is callable during the workflow.
A versioned adapter is required if mathematical danger classes are outside the existing EIS closed registry; the proposal does not silently add new signal kinds to the current implementation.
Benchmark routing authorization is stored outside model output and does not create production admission or enforcement authority.
No repair is attempted on a checker infrastructure error, unknown subject binding, stale witness, or missing health evidence.
ideas.hypothesis: Compared with unconditional critique or detector-hit-only repair, two-signal routing spends fewer calls rewriting sound artifacts while preserving visibility of host-detected defects and improving the local repair success per dollar.

stages.instruction: Freeze the diagnostic profile, checker registry and two-call reservation. Keep the exact seed bytes in their own message. Confirm that no private evaluator or key material is reachable.
Produce the requested answer with stable claim IDs and declared public artifacts. State assumptions and missing checks. You cannot supply host danger, activation or admission flags.

stages.role: Independent public checking and repair scheduler
stages.instruction: Run the frozen detector and the separate host checker on the same bound subject. Validate freshness, scope, health and evidence provenance. Record every checker failure. If all routing conjuncts hold, emit one allowlisted public failure class, artifact pointer and public witness reference for repair; otherwise retain the draft and findings.

Only when RouteDecision is REPAIR_ONCE, repair the indicated artifacts and their dependent prose under the original public assumptions. Do not change the seed, checker, scope or unrelated claim IDs. If the failure cannot be repaired, return explicit unresolved obligations. Do not infer private expected answers.

Apply a hash-bound patch only if well formed; recheck changed artifacts and dependencies. If the model stage was skipped retain the draft. Report remaining failures, unsupported checks and local passes separately, freeze all outputs, and reconcile the aggregate reservation. No private evaluation result can cause a retry.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Two-call draft plus unconditional whole-answer critique under the same cap; also compare detector-only and host-failure-only routing to distinguish the added value of the detector.
ablations: D-only repair
H-only repair
Reused detector digest masquerading as danger
Stale candidate hash
Missing host health
Same predicate under two observer names
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: On public synthetic controls exercise D/H = 00,01,10,11 while keeping admission, suspension and health explicit. Measure spurious repair calls, hidden host failures, benign-answer damage, patch success and total cost. Private scoring occurs after all final answers are frozen. Structural separation and agreement are never reported as statistical independence.

ideas.falsification: A routed repair when either required signal is absent, stale or copied falsifies gate correctness. Suppressing a host failure because the detector was silent falsifies the reporting contract. If H-only routing matches or beats the conjunction on defect repair and cost, the extra detector has no demonstrated utility for this setting.
risks: Two-signal routing can miss useful repair opportunities when the detector has low sensitivity; host failures must still remain visible.
Different observer names can conceal common implementation errors. Evidence lineage must record code and data provenance, without claiming causal independence is proven.
Exact local witness failure may reflect a codec or assumption mismatch rather than a false mathematical conclusion.
A local patch can break a distant prose dependency unless dependency rechecking is complete.
Conditional call savings can make equal-cap comparisons unfair; report matched actual spend as well.
ideas.budget_formula: C_max <= 14000*p_in + 4200*p_out + sum(F_s) + R, reserve both calls before dispatch and permit no retries. At common conditional thresholds and R=0.01, reserve USD 0.045; a skipped repair releases its unused reservation only after first-call usage is known.

ideas.name: Expiring diagnostic memory with paired transfer challenges

mathematical_basis.known_method: Scoped failure guidance and optional-guard regulation exist in EIS. Negative selection and metamorphic controls test unwanted cross-reaction. Selective prediction motivates reporting the coverage lost when guidance is withheld rather than rewarding blanket abstention.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Turn each generic diagnostic memory into a content-addressed lease over a precise parser, matcher, public scope and paired witness/benign-control family. Before reuse, the host challenges the entry on frozen transfer variants. A changed dependency, benign hit or failure to detect its own reproducer makes that entry inactive for the run; it cannot silently survive by accumulating more votes. Present at most three active, solution-free obligations to a single answer-producing call. Keep every expired entry and reason in an append-only diagnostic record, and leave production admission untouched.
mathematical_basis.lease_rule: Active(m,x) = ScopeMatch(m,x) and VersionsMatch(m) and not Expired(m) and forall b in B_m: d_m(b)=0 and forall r in R_m: d_m(r)=1, where B_m and R_m are finite public transfer controls not used to choose m. Max age is a preregistered run count or dependency change, not a learned confidence score. Unknown or failed controls give INACTIVE_FOR_RUN, never benignity or correctness.
mathematical_basis.support_and_metrics: Deduplicate evidence by canonical occurrence and lineage keys before selecting memories. An MIS support count can label declared non-overlap only; missing keys imply UNKNOWN_CORRELATION and cannot boost support. Track active guidance coverage, benign-trigger counts, detected control defects, abstentions and task-answer completeness separately. Do not infer a risk bound from the selective-classification literature without its sampling assumptions.
mathematical_basis.distinctive_test: Use adversarially close but contract-valid transformations to distinguish the failure mechanism from its surface wording. Revoke a rule's use within the current run when this public challenge disproves its specificity, then test whether withholding that guidance prevents an otherwise valid answer from being rewritten into error. This is diagnostic-memory control, not autonomous learning or deployment immunity.

assumptions: The initial memory bank is a bounded, deterministic public research registry with reproducers and checker-established benign controls; it contains no seed solution, private score or paid generation hidden outside the run budget.
Scope matching uses a frozen public typed schema. Model-authored claims of scope compatibility are insufficient.
At most 12 memory entries are considered and at most three are injected; deterministic order is fixed before benchmark evaluation.
Control generation preserves declared semantics only where the host has a checked transformation; lexical similarity alone is not a benignity proof.
Withholding optional research guidance never disables protected gates, modifies authenticated production admission, or deletes historical evidence.
ideas.hypothesis: Expiring and transfer-challenged diagnostic memory reduces false guidance and benign-answer damage compared with always-on retrieval, while retaining useful defect reminders on the declared public grammar.

stages.instruction: Freeze public memory entries, deterministic retrieval order, expiry rule, transfer panels and one-call reservation. Reject answer-bearing, private-derived or unbound memories. Preserve the original seed bytes.

stages.role: Finite transfer challenge and scoped anergy
stages.instruction: Check every candidate lease against scope, versions, age and paired transfer controls using the actual matcher. Deduplicate evidence and mark unknown lineage. Inactivate failing optional guidance only for this run; retain entries and receipts. Select at most three active generic obligations without observing private benchmark results.

stages.role: Answer producer with limited diagnostic memory
stages.instruction: Answer the unchanged seed. Treat the supplied generic obligations as reminders to justify your own assumptions, not as facts or proof of correctness. Preserve requested coverage and explicitly state unsupported claims. Do not invent activation, custody, health or memory-promotion receipts.

Run public checks, record which reminders were used and all unresolved findings, then freeze answer and cost receipts. A quiet detector panel is only no observed finding. Do not promote memory, change admission or request a repair from private evaluation feedback.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Always-on retrieval of the same top-three public entries using the same one-call model and token cap; compare no memory as a second baseline.
ablations: No dependency expiry
Reproducer controls without benign counterparts
Benign controls without transfer variants
Count duplicated or inherited reports as new support
Expire all entries, to expose apparent gains caused only by withholding guidance
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Use public paired tasks from a fixed grammar to measure guidance-induced errors, reminders that catch their declared defects, abstention and completeness. Include code-version changes and renamed syntax that preserve the control contract. Frozen benchmark outputs may be scored separately, but their feedback cannot enter this memory bank. One seed supports no claim of durable immunity.

ideas.falsification: The proposal fails if expired or scope-mismatched guidance reaches the model, if a known benign-triggering rule stays active, if an inherited duplicate increases independent-support claims, or if transfer challenges remove useful guidance without improving correctness or benign preservation at comparable coverage.
risks: Overly narrow leases can disable most guidance; blanket inactivity can look safe while providing no utility.
Public transfer controls can be overfit through repeated policy changes; policy tuning requires fresh confirmation families.
Scope/parser drift may be semantic even when version hashes are unchanged; hashes identify bytes, not meaning.
A detector passing every pair can still be wrong outside that finite grammar.
A registry that later incorporates evaluator-derived failures would contaminate subsequent benchmark runs; it must remain isolated.
ideas.budget_formula: C_max <= 9500*p_in + 3000*p_out + F_1 + R for one call, no retries and no hidden paid memory construction. At common conditional thresholds and R=0.01, reserve USD 0.0345.

recommended_reusable_primitive.name: FiniteDetectorAdequacyLeaseV1
recommended_reusable_primitive.recommendation: Implement a host-owned receipt joining actual-matcher identity, finite positive/negative control counts, independent host-evidence bindings and scoped expiry before adding any adaptive repair or memory policy.
recommended_reusable_primitive.invariant: Only host code issues counts and statuses. A detector hit, panel agreement, signature or support count cannot set a global correctness bit. No-hit, unknown, checker error and scoped pass remain distinct. A second signal must be bound to the same current subject with separately executed host evidence; distinct names alone never establish independence. Dependencies or control partitions changing invalidates the lease. No private benchmark feedback enters any field.
recommended_reusable_primitive.research_prompt_instruction: Design the finite detector DSL, paired public control grammar, immutable partition protocol and FiniteDetectorAdequacyLeaseV1 serializer. Propose deterministic tests for benign transformations, defect-family omissions, copied evidence, stale subject hashes, matcher drift and duplicate lineage. Keep every instruction generic and solution-free. Do not solve or rewrite any benchmark seed, read private benchmark storage, access an answer key or infer expected answers from evaluator diagnostics. Preserve seed bytes as a separate immutable artifact.
recommended_reusable_primitive.first_experiment: Host-only controls validate no vacuous inactive-rule pass, all four detector/danger combinations, stale-hash rejection and lease invalidation. Then a future authorized one-call R02-I03 pilot can compare frozen guidance with no memory. No such implementation or paid pilot was performed for this report.

research_agent_reports.focus: PCIV protected prompt mutations, witnessed lineage, exact Pareto selection, and bounded within-item adaptation

scope.seed_access: Only the public seed's SHA-256 was read; its text was not opened or solved. Observed SHA-256: 9941ab91f8e6b6637e49bb364cc0e6451788dd96442afcdb7f7024de042500a7. No answer-key path, private storage, grader output, or paid model call was accessed.
scope.novelty_claim: These are proposed repository-specific compositions of established prompt search, multiobjective selection, typed composition, and restricted feedback; no literature-wide novelty or measured performance is claimed.
scope.implementation_boundary: The workflow policies, public metric schema, byte-preserving transport adapter, exact multidimensional selector, and replayable mutation receipt below are proposals. Existing PCIV components are reusable only within their checked limits. The singleton Pareto bug and protected-span offset bug must not be silently inherited.
scope.benchmark_isolation: Every model request contains a separate seed message whose decoded content re-encodes to the exact original UTF-8 bytes. Do not normalize line endings, Unicode, whitespace, or assumptions. Preserve the raw seed and hash the full serialized request separately. Wrapper mutations operate on separate instruction artifacts; they never replace or omit the seed. Only public inputs, fixed host predicates, and candidate artifacts enter online checks. Outputs and policies are frozen before trusted private evaluation; no private score, verdict, diagnostic, rubric deduction, key-selected example, or derived hint returns to a workflow.
scope.adaptation_boundary: Preseed policy means the mutation grammar, public detectors, branch table, candidate cap, tie rule, and stopping rule are committed before any target response or target grader result. I01 fixes both wrappers before solving; I02 adapts once to public artifact checks under a fixed transition rule; I03 adapts a plan to the public input under a fixed grammar. These differ from choosing future prompts after observing the target's trusted score, which is exploratory tuning on this item. Even fresh stochastic confirmations on the same item are not held-out task transfer. Transfer requires a new preregistered problem sample with task/family separation; none is claimed here.

primary_sources.title: Fernando et al., Promptbreeder: Self-Referential Self-Improvement via Prompt Evolution, ICML 2024
primary_sources.relevance: Primary proceedings describe task-prompt mutation, training-set fitness evaluation, and evolving mutation-prompts. Motivates explicit mutation lineage and separates an evolving policy from our fixed, two-call policies. Reported results on their tasks do not predict this benchmark.

primary_sources.title: Dwork et al., Generalization in Adaptive Data Analysis and Holdout Reuse, 2015
primary_sources.relevance: Primary author paper explains why adaptive reuse can overfit a holdout and supplies specialized validity mechanisms. Motivates strict separation of online public checks from frozen-output evaluation. This proposal does not implement its reusable-holdout algorithms or claim their guarantees.

repository_evidence.observation: Inventory, proof review, proposed workflows, and measured effectiveness are distinct; immutable seed and aggregate USD 0.10 reservation are required.
Online checks cannot consult the key. Same-item repeats have only within-item scope; PCIV mutation policies must be fixed; target-score-driven future prompt choices are exploratory tuning.

SYS-BUG-001 records singleton Pareto failure; SYS-BUG-004 records silent event-log disk failure; SYS-BUG-005 records order-dependent taint; SYS-BUG-006 records protected-span offset failure. Proposed execution must fail closed on persistence and replay, rather than assuming existing adapters certify those properties.

PromptMutationEngineV1 checks byte edit bounds, overlapping edits, and interior zero-width insertions. Boundary insertions are allowed. It returns bytes but does not relocate protected-span offsets or independently establish semantic preservation.

Post-mutation slice checking shifts only the protected end offset when an edit precedes a span, matching the audited false rejection. These proposals keep the seed in a separate immutable message and do not call that relocation path.

Existing selector supports correctness/cost and lexicographic ties. _to_fraction is defined inside the pairwise loop yet used by the tie key; a singleton has no pair and fails. New selectors must explicitly handle zero, one, duplicates, ties, and partially measured candidates, and must not rename public proxy metrics as correctness.

Research selection computes exact private-pass fractions, checks paired rows and provenance, rejects incomplete/infrastructure rows, and requires fresh confirmation. This is evaluator-side code; calling it during online solving would create a private-feedback channel. Same-item confirmation is not new-task validation.

Immutable genome construction binds declared fields and protected spans; create_verified checks generation from supplied parents; unchanged-prompt executions have distinct ExecutionOccurrenceV1 records. Genome identity and execution identity must remain distinct.

Inheritance edges require a SealedCausalWitness naming the parent and child, and cycle checks. Matching objectives alone do not authorize inheritance. A host must record actual byte transformations for operational lineage.
A seal checks a hash against a caller-supplied canonical body. This establishes content binding, not independent authenticity or evidence that the asserted transformation happened.

bind_mutation protects the host experiment contract and checks candidate.parent; suitable design precedent for separating immutable context from candidate edits, but it does not itself construct or inspect the benchmark's executed seed message.

Host-authored repair classes exist because raw judge messages may contain answers. Use a newly scoped public-only allowlist; do not forward task-specific judge messages or assume existing task-specific rules apply.
Finite detectors do not establish completeness or observer independence; clean reports do not admit candidates. Fixture coverage and analytic correctness stay distinct.

Partial composition enforces arity and colour-slot compatibility and retains residual effects; proposed prompt scaffold colours must have explicit operational semantics. Type compatibility alone is not a mathematical validity proof.

common_budget_policy.formula: For a run reserve C_max = sum_s(I_s*p_in_s + O_s*p_out_s + F_s) + R <= USD 0.10 before any paid dispatch. I_s includes seed, wrapper, schema, prior artifacts and protocol overhead; O_s caps every billable output/reasoning token. Use current pinned per-token prices and exact endpoint semantics. Additional metered host/tool charges belong in F_s. Unbounded hidden reasoning, unknown fees, or unknown input bounds cause refusal.
