common_budget_policy.conditional_example: Illustrative admission thresholds only: p_in <= USD 0.000001/token, p_out <= USD 0.000005/token, F_s=0 and R=USD 0.01. They are not a current tariff quotation or a model recommendation. All three proposed run envelopes fit individually under these conditions; they are separate experiments, not permission to spend their sum.
common_budget_policy.routing: At most two model calls and zero retries per idea. One shared reservation ledger covers both candidates, rejected/truncated outputs, timeouts and checker-caused failures. Disable automatic retry/fallback. If usage is unavailable, retain the reservation and stop; a failed branch is not replaced for free.
common_budget_policy.receipts: Record policy hash, model/provider/version, tariff observation, request/response hashes, maximum completion token settings, actual input/output/reasoning/cache fields when available, provider duration, wall time, and charged cost. A genome is not an occurrence. No paid calls or experimental claims were made in this research task.
common_budget_policy.host_compute: Bound host runs to at most 32 obligation IDs, 64 edges, 3 plan candidates or 2 answer candidates, 64 public predicates, 1 MiB per artifact, and 2 seconds per checker invocation on already provisioned local CPU. Timeout or unsupported analytic checking produces OPEN/INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR, never a pass. Incremental metered compute must be added to the reservation.

ideas.name: Precommitted sibling wrappers with a public exact Pareto gate

mathematical_basis.known_method: Finite prompt variation and exact multiobjective dominance over measured records. For vectors v=(coverage, -public_defects, -completion_tokens), x dominates y iff every coordinate of v(x) is at least v(y) and at least one is strictly greater.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Construct exactly two sibling wrappers from one fixed parent before any model response: a dependency-first outline and a branch-first outline. The seed message remains byte-identical. Obtain two separate answer artifacts, compute a public obligation/detector vector, and choose from the exact nondominated set using a preregistered lexicographic tie rule. Preserve both candidates, all failures, and both execution costs.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: Compile immutable SeedBytes x WrapperPolicy -> Request; Request -> CandidateArtifact; CandidateArtifact x PublicPredicateRegistry -> PublicMetricVector; vector records -> FrontReceipt -> selected artifact. Host replay witnesses each wrapper edit. Both candidates descend from the template, not from one another, and a shared task ID does not create an inheritance edge. Exact dominance is exact only for the declared proxies.

assumptions: A public obligation inventory and detector registry are frozen before model outputs. Coverage counts only required IDs with nonempty bound artifact sections; it is labeled structural coverage, not mathematical correctness.

Both wrappers preserve every requested obligation. Their only differences are instruction order and explicit scaffold. They contain no target solution, guessed branch answer, or private-grader material.

Eligibility requires valid encoding, preserved seed, bounded size, and declared schema. Unsupported mathematical checks remain OPEN; public_defects counts only calibrated public predicate failures, not arbitrary prose judgments.

An independently specified exact vector comparator is implemented and validated before execution. Do not call the audited ParetoFrontSelectorV1 unmodified; this three-coordinate extension is not already supplied by it.
The two responses are separate provider samples, but their errors can be correlated. Shared provider, model, prompt library, and detectors do not establish statistical independence.
ideas.hypothesis: At matched total dollar and output-token budgets, two distinct frozen scaffolds plus public selection reduce missing requested sections and improve blinded final score relative to two samples of one fixed scaffold; the effect is explicitly within this single item.

stages.role: Frozen policy compiler and shared budget gate
stages.instruction: Freeze both wrapper byte strings, mutation edits, fixed public detector definitions and lexicographic rule. Validate immutable seed-message round trip and request hashes. Reserve the worst-case cost of both calls before dispatch. A wrapper edit is host-recorded; hashes alone do not authorize lineage.

Answer the complete unchanged seed. Organize the derivation by prerequisite dependencies; include every declared obligation ID, explicit assumptions and unresolved steps. Supply only candidate-side evidence requested by the public schema. Do not self-score or claim host acceptance.

Answer the complete unchanged seed independently of sibling A, which is not supplied. Organize the derivation by parameter and boundary cases before common conclusions. Include every declared obligation ID, explicit assumptions and unresolved steps. Do not self-score or claim host acceptance.

Record both attempts including failures. Run the frozen public schema, dependency, and independently calibrated consistency predicates without private evaluation. Compute structural coverage, public defect count and billed completion tokens as exact integers. Missing cost or invalid artifact is ineligible; preserve the failure receipt.

stages.role: Exact frontier and fixed tie rule
stages.instruction: Using the separately validated comparator, compute the nondominated eligible set. Sort that front by public_defects ascending, structural coverage descending, completion tokens ascending, then preassigned wrapper ID ascending. Empty set emits INCOMPLETE; singleton returns that element without pairwise code. Selection does not create a new genome or causal improvement claim. Charge both calls regardless of the selected answer.

Freeze selected answer bytes, both raw candidates, policy and ledger. Trusted mathematical scoring occurs afterward in an isolated evaluator with no return channel. Report accuracy/cost/time frontier separately from the public-proxy frontier.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Two independent direct same-model answers with the identical aggregate budget and the same public selector, differing only by use of one fixed wrapper; also report a single-call baseline with the same total output budget when feasible.
ablations: Choose wrapper A by preregistered ID without public selection
Use two identical wrapper strings but distinct occurrence IDs
Remove one public detector family at a time, retaining the same eligibility and budget rules
Use exact Pareto set without the final lexicographic choice and report the entire set
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Pre-register paired run blocks and independent provider sampling, randomize arm order, keep every failure in the denominator, and freeze all configurations before the campaign. Evaluate selected and unselected artifacts only after freezing, to measure selection regret. Public detector sensitivity/false rejection is measured on independent positive and corrupted synthetic fixtures. Repeated samples measure this item's response variability, not a population of tasks.

falsification: A public synthetic fixture has a dominated candidate selected, inconsistent permutation results, singleton failure, missing-token defaulted to zero, or a duplicate occurrence counted as a new genome: selection implementation fails its claim.
The chosen answer has lower trusted score than the discarded answer often enough to reverse the preregistered benefit margin: the proxy selector is counterproductive even when exact.

Sibling wrappers do not improve the preregistered within-item paired score/completeness criterion relative to identical-wrapper sampling at matched budgets: proposed diversity mechanism is unsupported.
Any request omits or changes seed bytes, or any private diagnostic influences selection before output freeze, invalidates the blind run.
risks: Structural coverage is easy to satisfy with incorrect prose; public Pareto membership is not a correctness certificate.
Lexicographic order expresses a preference and can discard meaningful tradeoffs; the complete frontier and both costs must remain visible.
Protected seed bytes do not prevent a wrapper from semantically contradicting the seed; wrapper invariance still needs a frozen allowlist and review.
Known event-log disk failure means successful append alone is insufficient; freeze must verify durable readback before reporting a complete receipt.
ideas.budget_formula: C_max <= 10000*p_in + 6000*p_out + sum(F_s) + R; two calls, no retries. At the conditional thresholds and R=0.01 this is USD 0.050. The selected candidate's individual cost must never replace total run cost.

ideas.name: One-step public-failure repair with replayable mutation lineage

mathematical_basis.known_method: A bounded deterministic controller over public observations, unrolled into an acyclic execution. With draft x, detector vector d(x), and frozen branch table T, the repair prompt is P1=T(P0,d(x)); one repair produces y, then execution stops.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Use one complete draft and one targeted patch call. The host maps only public artifact-local failures to a fixed instruction table, mutates a separate repair-wrapper message, and records exactly which observation and edit caused the child request. Repair feedback contains allowlisted classes and candidate IDs, never raw judge text. Retain the draft and patch so the host can choose a nonregressing result without another model call.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: ObservationReceipt binds candidate hash, checker/version and public failure IDs. MutationReceipt binds parent request, frozen transition table, observation receipt, edited wrapper bytes and child request. OPERADS types enforce that only PublicObservation can enter the RepairPrompt slot; PrivateEvaluation has no outgoing edge. Exact status comparison is over the same fixed obligation set, never model-declared success.

assumptions: Public detectors are fixed before drafting and have independent calibration fixtures, including correct but nonstandard forms. A numeric spot check is labeled numerical evidence and cannot certify an analytic claim.

The transition table permits at most four neutral classes: SCHEMA, MISSING_OBLIGATION, UNBOUND_ASSUMPTION, and FAILED_PUBLIC_IDENTITY. Each has fixed answer-free instructions; only public candidate-local pointers vary.
Repair output is a bounded patch over stable artifact IDs. Host rendering is deterministic, untouched sections retain their hashes, and changed sections plus dependencies are rechecked.

At most one repair is permitted. With no failures the second node is skipped and emits a host no-op receipt; unused reservation is released only after usage is known. No failure triggers a third call.
Parent-child operational lineage requires replay of the actual observed edit and occurrence, not merely a caller-sealed assertion. Lineage is not evidence that repair caused a score improvement.
ideas.hypothesis: A fixed public-failure repair controller reduces structural omissions and independently detected inconsistencies per billed token relative to whole-answer self-critique, while preserving all original requested obligations; trusted-score benefit remains an empirical within-item question.

stages.instruction: Freeze public predicates, neutral feedback table, patch IDs and nonregression rule before the draft. Preserve the seed message independently of wrappers and verify bytes at dispatch. Reserve both calls; load no private evaluation data.

Answer every part of the unchanged seed with explicit assumptions and dependency-linked sections. Use the public artifact schema and distinguish exact derivations, numerical checks and open obligations. The host, not you, determines public check outcomes.

Run frozen bounded checks. Encode at most four allowlisted failure classes and artifact-local IDs; never include raw diagnostics. Apply the frozen table to append a separate repair-wrapper message, record byte edits and actual parent occurrence, and verify immutable seed round trip. If there are no actionable public failures, record a no-op and skip repair.

If dispatched, use only the unchanged seed, your draft, and the public allowlisted failure receipt. Patch the indicated sections and any explicitly listed dependent references. Recompute candidate-supplied identities; do not invent checker outcomes, remove requested obligations, alter the detector registry, or turn an unsupported claim into a certified one. Return unresolved fields if a repair cannot be made.

If skipped, retain draft. Otherwise render the patch and recheck all affected dependencies. Child is eligible only if it loses no previously satisfied fixed predicate and improves at least one public predicate or required-section status. Compute the exact frontier on structural coverage, negative public defects and negative artifact-generation tokens; apply fixed priority of fewer defects, more coverage, then fewer tokens, retaining the draft on ties. A costlier child may be nondominated, not dominant. Report total draft-plus-repair cost regardless of the retained candidate.

Replay lineage from raw request and wrapper bytes, reject stale receipts, verify durable readback, and freeze both alternatives plus the chosen output. Offline trusted scoring may compare them afterward but cannot trigger another repair or future prompt selection in this blind run.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Draft plus whole-answer self-critique using the same model, aggregate token cap, seed and public checks; include draft-only as a cost reference.
ablations: Replace specific public failure classes with one generic review instruction
Supply the same public failures but ask for a whole-answer rewrite
Use patch generation with no nonregression gate
Use replay-verified host lineage versus declarative receipts on synthetic corruption fixtures; this tests custody, not mathematical quality
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Track public defect removal, new-defect introduction, patch size, restored obligation coverage, false rejection on valid synthetic artifacts, and final isolated trusted score. Pair repeats by seed/model/configuration and count skipped repairs, incomplete patches and infrastructure failures. A fixed feedback policy is still within-item adaptation; repeated private-score-informed redesign must be labeled a separate exploratory campaign.

falsification: An unchanged valid synthetic artifact is rejected beyond a preregistered false-rejection tolerance, or a mutated required section bypasses rechecking.
Repair creates a new public failure or removes a previously covered obligation but is nevertheless selected: the nonregression contract is violated.
Swapping the observation receipt or parent occurrence leaves a replay receipt accepted: lineage binding is inadequate.
Whole-answer critique matches or exceeds the repair controller's preregistered paired score and defect-removal criterion at the same budget: targeted repair has no established advantage.
Any raw private-feedback text or key-derived failure class reaches the repair prompt invalidates the blind interpretation.
risks: Neutral failure classes still encode information about public tests; adapting to them can overfit those tests.
An incorrect draft can pass every finite detector; absence of actionable failure is not correctness.
Hash sealing is not authentication of the event source; broker-captured request/response evidence and replay are extra requirements.
The current taint implementation is order-dependent. Do not use it to clear ancestry; compute any required reachability/taint conservatively in a separately validated topological pass.
ideas.budget_formula: C_max <= 12000*p_in + 4300*p_out + sum(F_s) + R; at most two calls and no retry. Conditional thresholds with R=0.01 give USD 0.0435. The no-op path uses one call but reserves the two-call worst case until the branch is known.

ideas.name: Typed scaffold evolution before solving with exact plan selection

mathematical_basis.known_method: Finite typed program synthesis and partial-order scheduling: a plan is a DAG over a frozen operation grammar, with edge compatibility target(g)=source(f)[i], acyclicity, and explicit requested sinks. Structural validity is decidable for a finite plan but does not prove the semantics of the later answer.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: The first small model call proposes up to three plan-only scaffold candidates. Each is a sequence/DAG of IDs from a fixed neutral grammar, not a rewritten task or mathematical answer. The host rejects plans that omit obligations, introduce undeclared assumptions or fail coloured composition. It compiles the survivors into wrapper messages and chooses an exact Pareto plan using structural check placement, auxiliary node count and actual wrapper-token cost. A second call solves the complete unchanged seed under the selected scaffold.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: Plan grammar atoms are inventory_assumptions, split_public_domains, derive_required_result, declare_dependencies, check_candidate_identity, label_numeric_evidence, state_residual, and render_requested_answer. Slots carry SeedRef, ObligationRef, CandidateClaim, CheckRequest and RenderableSection colours. Every requested sink is represented and connected; checker nodes only consume already-produced candidate claims. Typed composition retains unsupported semantic obligations as residuals.

assumptions: The grammar, maximum three candidates, maximum 16 nodes/32 edges per plan, obligation inventory and exact selector are committed before any target response. The first call may inspect the public seed but receives no target-score history.

Only operation IDs and references are accepted from the planner. Free-form mathematical assertions, numerical results, new assumptions and edits to seed text make a plan ineligible; the host renders all instruction prose from frozen templates.
All required derivation and rendering nodes are mandatory. Optional check requests are deduplicated by obligation/checker ID, so adding repeated checks cannot inflate the objective.

Structural check coverage is the fraction of required claims assigned an applicable registered public check kind. An unsupported symbolic claim is OPEN and gains no check-coverage credit; assigning a kind does not mean that the later claim passes.
The baseline scaffold is a frozen feasible fallback. If all plans fail, the solve stage uses that fallback within the same reservation; no replanning or extra model call occurs.

Typed plan correctness, wrapper byte integrity, and final mathematical correctness are separate claims. Selection on public plan proxies is adaptive to this item, not evidence of task-general learning.
ideas.hypothesis: Allocating a small planning call to a typed scaffold, then selecting a compact complete plan, improves final obligation completeness and reduces unsupported-check claims compared with unconstrained plan-and-solve at equal total budget.

stages.instruction: Freeze grammar templates, legal colours, requested sink inventory, comparator and fallback plan. Verify all plan candidates must use the same unchanged seed reference. Reserve both calls and pass only public inputs to the planner.

Propose at most three typed plan DAGs using only the allowed operation IDs and public obligation references. Cover every requested part, name dependencies, and place checks only after their candidate claims. Return plan structure only: no derivation, formula, numerical answer, new assumption, or edited seed text.

stages.role: Typed compilation and exact Pareto selection
stages.instruction: Reject free-form assertions, invalid IDs, cycles, unbound assumptions and missing requested sinks. Compile legal plans using frozen template text. Calculate exact structural check coverage, negative auxiliary-node count and negative tokenized wrapper length. Compute a validated exact nondominated set and choose by coverage descending, wrapper tokens ascending, auxiliary nodes ascending, plan ID ascending. Empty set uses the frozen fallback. Record planner-to-scaffold derivation as a host transformation, not evidence of efficacy.

Answer the complete unchanged seed using the selected scaffold. Supply all requested results and explicit premises. A planned check is only an obligation until evidence is actually supplied and checked; mark unsupported mathematics OPEN. Do not treat plan acceptance as mathematical approval.

Check schema, coverage and plan adherence under bounded public predicates. Preserve all proposed plans, rejected-plan reasons, fallback use, final answer and cost ledger. Do not silently repair the answer. Freeze artifacts before isolated trusted scoring; no grader feedback can evolve the plan grammar or templates inside the run.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Unconstrained plan-and-solve with a 900-token plan and 3100-token solution under the same model and input limits; also compare one 4000-token direct solve as a call-overhead baseline.
ablations: Fixed fallback scaffold with no planner call
Accept first eligible plan rather than exact Pareto selection
Check only plan acyclicity, removing colour compatibility
Keep typed structure but remove checker-applicability filtering; evaluate unsupported-check claims explicitly
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Pre-register within-item completeness, trusted score, unsupported-check assertions, typed-plan refusal rate, fallback rate, and plan/solve token split. Synthetic malformed plans test omitted sinks, type mismatch, cycles, duplicate check inflation and invented premises before any paid run. Do not count proposed plan diversity or compiler acceptance as solver accuracy.

falsification: A compiled plan omits a mandatory sink, consumes a check before the claim exists, gains duplicate check credit or includes a new assumption: the structural admission claim fails.
The typed compiler rejects independently reviewed valid alternative plans at an unacceptable preregistered rate, or its overhead erases any score/completeness benefit under the same spend cap.
The final solver treats planned checks as passed without witnesses more often than the unconstrained baseline: the scaffold is inducing unjustified confidence.
Target trusted scores are used to revise the grammar, choose the fallback, or reprioritize plan objectives while reporting a held-out result: the comparison is invalid.
risks: A too-small grammar may suppress useful reasoning routes; refused plans and fallback frequency must be reported.
Model-proposed plan variants within one response are not independent samples and are not three solver attempts.
Exact structural metrics can prefer a concise but ineffective plan; no mathematical or causal guarantee follows from the frontier.
OPERADS colour checking validates declared interfaces only. Semantic preservation needs explicit host templates and review, and final mathematical claims remain evaluator obligations.
ideas.budget_formula: C_max <= 10000*p_in + 4000*p_out + sum(F_s) + R; two calls, no retry. At the conditional thresholds with R=0.01 this is USD 0.040. The full cost includes rejected plans and fallback use.

recommended_reusable_primitive.name: ProtectedMutationSelectionReceiptV1
recommended_reusable_primitive.recommendation: Implement one host-owned transaction binding immutable seed transport, actual wrapper mutation, observed occurrence, public metric provenance and exact selection. This is reusable across fixed siblings, one-step repair and typed-plan evolution; implementation and validation are prerequisites, not completed work.
recommended_reusable_primitive.invariant: The receipt is issued only after host replay, exact seed-message round trip, deterministic dominance validation and durable readback. Missing metrics are not zeros. Empty and singleton fronts are total operations; duplicate genomes remain distinct occurrences. A receipt never upgrades proxy fitness to correctness, declaration sealing to causal proof, or within-item adaptation to transfer.
recommended_reusable_primitive.research_prompt_instruction: Design and test this primitive using independent synthetic bytes, malformed plans and small exact metric vectors. Do not solve the public QM seed, read private evaluator storage, or make paid calls. Keep the original seed file unchanged. Freeze every policy and prohibit a PrivateEvaluation -> Workflow edge.
recommended_reusable_primitive.first_experiment: Host-only finite tests: empty/singleton/tied/dominated fronts and input permutations; UTF-8 multibyte protected segments and boundary edits; stale parent/observation substitution; duplicate occurrences; simulated persistence failure; typed-plan cycles and omitted sinks. After these pass and a paid campaign is separately authorized, run the two-call sibling ablation with frozen policies. No implementation or model experiment was executed here.

research_agent_reports.focus: Coloured operads, context-preserving typed composition, residual/effect laws, and bounded composition-order experiments

scope.seed_access: No seed or private evaluator material was read. Public protocol and workflow audit supplied task-type constraints. No seed solution, paid call, or private storage access occurred.
scope.novelty_claim: New proposed adaptations to this repository, not claims of literature-wide novelty. Typed substitution, algebraic effects, and experimental order comparisons have established precedents.
scope.implementation_boundary: All new adapters, laws, grammar, and experiments below are proposals. Current compilation yields Unadmitted candidate plans. LP, integer-sum, cochain, stabilizer, and finite certificate presets do not become arbitrary symbolic QM checkers by receiving one common seed.
scope.benchmark_isolation: The original UTF-8 seed remains a separate immutable input in every paid request; hash exact bytes before and after construction. No rewriting, normalization, omission, changed Hamiltonian convention, or substituted task. Online checks use only public predicates and submitted artifacts. Freeze all outputs before isolated trusted evaluation; no private scores, expected values, answer-bearing diagnostics, or key-selected hints return to a workflow.

primary_sources.title: David I. Spivak, The operad of wiring diagrams: formalizing a graphical language for databases, recursion, and plug-and-play circuits (2013)
primary_sources.relevance: Defines hierarchical wiring syntax through an operad and gives a relational algebra interpreting that syntax. Supports separating admissible interconnection from a particular semantic interpretation; it does not verify this repository's operation bodies. Paper PDF was opened.

primary_sources.title: Ohad Kammar and Gordon D. Plotkin, Algebraic Foundations for Effect-Dependent Optimisations (POPL 2012)
primary_sources.relevance: Derives transformation laws from type/effect semantics and distinguishes generally structural laws from laws requiring assumptions about effects. Motivates checking a specific law before eliminating, duplicating, or reordering workflow operations. Primary author-hosted paper was opened.

repository_evidence.observation: Distinguishes signature substitution, callable behavior, residual laws, and unsupported end-to-end QM certification.
Requires unchanged seed, private evaluator isolation, matched comparisons, and run-wide USD 0.10 reservations.
Records the NaN residual counterexample and limits of typed compilation; no repair is claimed here.
49 family designs; WF1-WF5 have public runner source, while WF6-WF49 remain family proposals with varying pilot evidence. No complete seed checker is established.
Candidate output is Unadmitted. Full port equality includes colour, schema reference/hash, and validator reference/hash. Fixed depth/node caps and effect/tool ceilings apply.
Rejects shared outputs, lowers a rooted single-consumer graph to an ordered tree, checks its entry boundary, and never admits or executes it.
Substitution checks an ordered slot; associativity witnesses compare computed signatures for one instance rather than arbitrary operation behavior.
Callable composition runs children in order and combines residuals. Colour equality alone places no runtime contract on Python values or hidden side effects.
Risk is converted to float without a finite-domain check; absorption uses max and tuple concatenation; discharge accepts strings rather than independently checking a witness.

common_budget_policy.formula: Reserve C_max = sum_s(I_s*p_in_s + O_s*p_out_s + F_s) + R <= USD 0.10 over the entire execution, including every branch and retry. O_s covers all billable reasoning and response tokens; I_s covers original seed, instructions, schemas, framing, and prior artifacts. Prices are USD/token.
common_budget_policy.conditional_example: The examples assume p_in <= 0.000001, p_out <= 0.000005, all fixed fees F_s=0, and R=0.01. These are admission thresholds, not observed prices. Refuse unknown fees, uncapped reasoning, unsupported token bounds, or a larger quote.
common_budget_policy.routing: Freeze current provider/model/tariff and actual input bounds before dispatch. Disable automatic fallback and retries. Timeouts keep full reservations. Paid evaluator cost must be separately budgeted and disclosed or included in the same ceiling. No paid campaign is authorized by this report.
common_budget_policy.receipts: Use the existing run-wide ledger and record exact request/output hashes, reservations, actual usage/charge, wall time, and summed provider time. All research here cost USD 0 in provider calls.
common_budget_policy.host_compute: Enumeration and finite contract fixtures use bounded local CPU with zero incremental provider cost. Any metered host service must be reserved. Per candidate, cap static checking at 5 seconds and 256 MiB; timeout means unknown, never accepted.

ideas.name: Context-indexed adapter diamonds

mathematical_basis.known_method: An operad supplies typed substitution; its algebra supplies the meaning of the composite. A matching interface is necessary but does not establish preservation of a task or proposition.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Index each port by immutable task, assumption-context, artifact, evidence-scope, and schema identities. An adapter must expose a preservation relation and a refusal branch. For two admitted routes from the same representation to the same target, compare the preserved requested-claim inventory and assumptions, not just serialized output equality. The commuting diagram is an obligation until a checker establishes it for the declared fragment.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: An edge requires equal full five-field native port contracts plus equal task/context indices. A bridge A:X->Y carries a checked relation P_A(x,y); composed preservation is P_A(x,y) and P_B(y,z). Without an implemented relation checker, append OPEN_BRIDGE and retain candidate-only status. No implicit coercion of numerical evidence into symbolic evidence.

assumptions: At most two explicit bridge routes, four bridges per route, and 24 claim identifiers; both routes retain the complete requested inventory.
Artifact mutation changes its hash and invalidates all artifact-bound receipts. Task and assumption hashes cannot be recomputed from rewritten prose to disguise a change.
New state types require reviewed schema/validator bindings under the current closed native colour vocabulary; naming a new colour is not an admitted extension.
ideas.hypothesis: Explicit context indices and checked bridges reduce invalid composition and stale-evidence acceptance compared with colour-only composition, while retaining all valid public controls and improving complete-answer quality at matched budgets.

stages.instruction: Freeze immutable seed, public inventory and adapter contracts; reject unresolved native mappings before any attempt to run them.
Return the requested response with explicit context and representation tags; do not assert host acceptance.
Run only implemented public bridge predicates on both routes. Detect dropped branches, changed assumptions, stale hashes and unsupported scope promotions; preserve refusals and open bridges.
Repair artifact-local interface failures from allowlisted public diagnostics, preserving the original seed and claim inventory. Unproved semantic bridges remain explicit.
Recompute bridge checks on current hashes, render bounded claim scopes, and freeze bytes before isolated evaluation.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Same two-call envelope with only colour/schema checks and ordinary critique.
ablations: Full native ports without context indices
Context indices without preservation predicates
One route only; no diamond comparison
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Public fixtures deliberately change assumptions, remove exceptional branches, reuse stale receipts, and preserve valid alternative encodings. Report false accepts, false rejects, completeness and trusted final scores separately. Diamond agreement is not semantic adequacy.

ideas.falsification: One accepted context-changing bridge or unjustified evidence promotion falsifies the preservation implementation. The performance hypothesis fails if matched-budget final quality does not improve or valid-control refusal offsets the reduction in false acceptance.
risks: Both routes can share the same faulty parser or omission.
Interface overhead can displace useful mathematical reasoning.
One finite fixture panel cannot prove a universal translation theorem.
ideas.budget_formula: Two calls, zero retries: I_total<=14000, O_total<=4400. At the conditional common thresholds, C_max<=0.014+0.022+0.010=USD 0.046 for the complete execution.

ideas.name: Law-carrying residual folds with replayable discharge

mathematical_basis.known_method: Program rewrites require laws for the effects that observations retain; associativity of syntax does not establish equality of effectful execution.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Use an append-only event word together with integer microusd cost, bounded integer diagnostic risk, and declared effect sets. Define accumulation as concatenation, exact addition, max, and union. Treat discharge as a checked event replay, not removal by matching a string. Keep chronological evidence separate from the currently open-obligation projection.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: For event words L and L', combine (L,c,r,E)*(L',c',r',E')=(LL',c+c',max(r,r'),E union E'); identity=(empty,0,0,empty), with c nonnegative integer and r in {0,...,100}. Refuse nonfinite, negative or out-of-domain values. The product is associative but generally noncommutative because logs retain order. A discharge event requires an earlier exact obligation ID/context/artifact hash and an independent public receipt; replay failure stays OPEN.

assumptions: At most 64 residual events and 24 obligation IDs per run; duplicate IDs are rejected.
The integer risk field is diagnostic, not an estimated probability or a correctness score.
Budget reservations and actual costs remain distinct; recomputing a fold never redispatches a paid operation.
ideas.hypothesis: A law-checked fold and evidence-bound discharge eliminate representation/order-dependent loss of obligations without increasing unsupported final certification or exceeding the matched two-call budget.

stages.instruction: Check all finite risk triples and bounded event-word controls for associativity/unit; include NaN, infinity, negative cost, duplicate IDs, forged discharge and stale-artifact controls. Tests establish only this finite implementation panel.
Produce the requested response with explicit open obligations and artifact-bound evidence references.
Check public artifacts and replay typed events in order; do not accept model-authored discharge strings as evidence.
Respond to the public residual frontier once, emitting new artifacts or retaining open obligations. Never delete historical events.
Validate new discharge receipts, invalidate stale dependencies, retain failures and freeze output before trusted scoring.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: The same draft/repair schedule with a plain unresolved-string list.
ablations: Finite integer risk and exact cost only
Append-only history without evidence-bound discharge
Reassociation tests without mutable-state/callable controls
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Compare folds for both bracketings of the same ordered operation occurrences on public fixtures; check full traces and values, not scalar risk alone. A separate adversarial body fixture mutates hidden state to demonstrate why residual laws do not certify arbitrary callables.

ideas.falsification: Any admitted unequal bracketing for the declared product or unproved discharge closes an obligation falsifies the contract. Equal diagnostic scalars with different trace meanings do not count as success. Final-quality benefits must survive matched-budget scoring.
risks: Correct event accumulation does not prove checker adequacy or pure operation behavior.
A trace schema may omit a relevant side effect.
Associativity permits rebracketing a fixed order, not swapping dependent operations.
ideas.budget_formula: Two calls, zero retries: I_total<=13000, O_total<=4200. At the conditional common thresholds, C_max<=0.013+0.021+0.010=USD 0.044 for the complete execution.

ideas.name: Typed order squares for screen-and-rewrite interactions

mathematical_basis.known_method: Commutation is a separate property from associativity and requires a declared observation and noninterference assumptions. A failure to commute can be an experimental interaction rather than a type error.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Compare A;B with B;A on the same frozen draft, where A adds public detector annotations and B is one bounded model rewrite that may consume current annotations. Both act on an indexed packet and both arms end with a common fresh A check. Different output distributions are allowed and measured; no equivalence is presumed.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: Packet(seed_hash,context_hash,candidate_hash,annotations) is the shared state type. A returns annotations bound to candidate_hash. B preserves seed/context but replaces candidate_hash and invalidates every old annotation. Identity of public interfaces makes both orders candidates; artifact validity rules and frozen effects determine executability. Final A never consults private evaluation.

assumptions: One draft and two branch rewrites: three model calls total across the paired execution, no retries or model judge.
A is a deterministic frozen public detector with an independently specified control panel; B uses the same model/settings and cap in each arm.
Each branch has isolated mutable state and child ledger reservations; both share immutable draft bytes. The pair is one correlated block, not two independent replicates.
A;B;A and B;A;A have equal public check counts. Randomize actual arm dispatch order; stale annotations are never silently reused.
ideas.hypothesis: Providing public diagnostic annotations before a rewrite improves the subsequent complete response relative to checking only afterward; any improvement is an order interaction on this seed, not a universal commutation law or transfer result.

stages.instruction: Freeze A/B interfaces, controls, budgets, effect declarations and dispatch randomization. Reserve both arms before starting.
Answer the unchanged seed; emit a bounded draft without private feedback.
Snapshot draft; run A before B only in AB. Use a neutral, explicitly diagnostic-free input in BA; record actual framing token counts.
Rewrite using current public annotations; preserve seed/context and emit new candidate bytes.
Rewrite using the frozen draft with no detector diagnosis supplied; preserve seed/context and emit new candidate bytes.
Run A once after AB and twice after BA, yielding two check occurrences per arm overall. Freeze both outputs, including refusals or truncations, with no score-based selection or repair.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Same-model direct answer at matched total dollars/tokens, reported separately from the paired order contrast.
ablations: Supply only schema-format diagnostics
Replace A with a preregistered irrelevant public control detector
Pure deterministic A/B fixture pair expected to commute; no paid calls
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Trusted evaluator scores both frozen answers independently after the pair ends. Across repeated independently generated drafts, randomize arm order and report raw paired differences, false rejections, completeness, cost and latency. Shared-prefix dependence must remain in uncertainty calculations; one item supports only within-item conclusions.

ideas.falsification: The claimed benefit fails if AB has no preregistered meaningful gain over BA at matched bounds, harms completeness, or depends on answer-bearing hints. Any stale annotation accepted after rewriting is a contract failure regardless of score.
risks: A's errors can anchor B; finite calibration is not semantic completeness.
Different prompt contents alter tokenization and can confound an unbalanced comparison.
The paired fork is a proposed external executor feature: the current native compiler forbids shared output nodes.
ideas.budget_formula: Entire paired execution, not per branch: three calls, I_total<=18000, O_total<=5400. At the conditional common thresholds, C_max<=0.018+0.027+0.010=USD 0.055; zero retries and zero paid judge calls.

recommended_reusable_primitive.name: Pinned typed adapter descriptor
recommended_reusable_primitive.definition: One record binds family/source/operation IDs, exact ordered full port contracts, immutable-context indices, implemented adapter entry point, preservation predicates, effect/read/write declarations, residual law versions, resource envelope, refusal behavior and status. It separates a research idea, a type-checkable candidate and a runnable configuration.

finite_composition_grammar.claim: Exhaustive only relative to a frozen finite descriptor registry, parameter grid, bridges, bounds and declared equivalence relation. No enumeration was executed here. Neither 49! arbitrary permutations nor every mathematically meaningful composition is claimed.
finite_composition_grammar.registry: Include exactly one audited descriptor per WF1..WF49 plus R04-I01..03; append the other research reports' ideas only after their finite descriptors are frozen. Retain each of the 46 existing variations as a separate finite parameter choice if desired, never an unbounded free-text knob. A family macro remains opaque until its own stages and finite cost bounds are pinned; it is not a generic solver.

state_types.RunContext: Exact SeedBytes plus task/context hashes, fixed claim inventory, public-only inputs, optional provenance-bound prior outcome, and one budget ledger ID.
state_types.Outcome: Candidate/refusal/failure sum type with exact answer bytes, public receipts, residuals, cost and provenance; contains no implicit correctness assertion.
state_types.Packet: RunContext plus candidate hash and artifact-bound annotations, used inside stage adapters.
state_types.CampaignSpec: Finite ordered run configurations, randomization, replicate count, stopping rule and explicitly authorized aggregate campaign ceiling.
state_types.CampaignReceipt: Frozen run outcomes and accounting; post-freeze private scores occupy a separate evaluator-only type with no outgoing workflow edges.
state_types.DetectorTask: Public detector specification and independent positive/negative fixtures; no private seed key.
state_types.DetectorSuite: Versioned predicates with finite calibration results and unsupported classes.
state_types.TranslationTask: Source artifact, target representation contract, task-preservation relation and scope.
state_types.CrosswalkReceipt: Translated artifact plus preservation evidence or explicit open bridge.
state_types.ResearchSpec: Finite hypotheses, admissible public witnesses and stopping criteria.
state_types.ResearchRecord: Frozen evidence and open obligations; no automatic solver adapter.
state_types.TransferDataset: Declared disjoint development and held-out task families, not repeated samples of one seed.
state_types.TransferRuleReceipt: Rules, lineage and measured split scope; cannot feed this benchmark's private scores back to solvers.
state_types.RewriteTask: Artifact, protected seed/context, explicit preservation predicate and finite mutation menu.
state_types.RewriteReceipt: New artifact with old/new hashes, preservation result and stale-receipt invalidation.
state_types.CustodyTask: Public manifests, hashes and provenance boundaries.
state_types.CustodyReceipt: Checked custody facts, missing evidence and failures; no mathematical correctness upgrade.
state_types.CheckerTask: Public checker contract and independently supplied mutation/control panel.
state_types.CheckerCandidate: Unadmitted checker implementation and bounded mutation results.
state_types.ClaimTask: Candidate claims, exact contexts and available public evidence.
state_types.AuthorityTask: Candidate receipts and explicit authority policy.
state_types.LeakAuditTask: Public feedback schema, allowed information flow and public probes.
state_types.GateReceipt: Pass/refuse/unknown with policy/version/candidate hashes; does not certify the underlying answer.
state_types.LawAuditTask: Finite typed operations, residual domain and explicit law registry.
state_types.LawReceipt: Finite counterexamples/passes with exact domain scope.
state_types.OrderPairSpec: RunContext plus two full Packet->Packet stage contracts and fixed paired schedule.
state_types.OutcomePair: Two distinct frozen outcomes under one aggregate budget; no best-score selector.

proposed_family_external_signatures.qualification: Proposed whole-run envelopes, not current native ports. Each original task restriction remains; unsupported QM presets are rejected rather than coerced.
Campaign/meta operations are not single-seed solver stages. WF31/WF37 additionally require appropriate hidden/transfer datasets.
Calibration must be independent of private answer-key feedback.
Internal adapter/law gates remain explicit nodes when lowering.
Candidate requires an external branch executor or two separately compiled arm trees; no native fan-out claim.

required_bridges: Outcome -> RunContext: explicit re-proposal bridge retaining original seed/context/claims, exact prior-outcome provenance, one shared ledger, and one consumed repair/re-entry fuel unit; refuses evaluator-derived content.
Outcome -> ClaimTask/TranslationTask/RewriteTask: separate named constructors with frozen public target contracts; receipts are side evidence and cannot silently replace the answer.
Outcome -> AuthorityTask and Outcome -> LeakAuditTask: explicit public policy/probe constructors; GateReceipt cannot cast to mathematically correct Outcome.
DetectorSuite plus Outcome -> Packet: a declared ordered binary annotation adapter preserves candidate bytes and calibration scope; applying it is not a completeness proof.
CrosswalkReceipt or RewriteReceipt -> Packet: requires successful preservation check and current artifact/context hashes; otherwise returns refusal/open obligation.
Finite list of run plans -> CampaignSpec: packaging only; execution requires a separate aggregate campaign authorization and cannot be smuggled under one per-run cap.

CheckerCandidate -> registered checker: no automatic edge; independent soundness/adequacy review and runtime admission are required. TransferDataset/ResearchSpec have no conversion from one seed that fabricates held-out evidence.

Immutable snapshot -> two branch inputs: external read-only copy bridge only. The existing single-output compiler cannot express a shared producer; compile arm trees separately and account the prefix once in the external ledger, or label the pair non-runnable.
syntax: T[X,0] ::= input_X, drawn from the finite preregistered external input slots.
T[Y,n] ::= op(T[X1,n1],...,T[Xk,nk]) when op:(X1,...,Xk)->Y is a frozen descriptor, k<=4, and n=1+sum(ni)<=16. Nullary constants are limited to finite frozen public configuration objects.

A composition candidate is a typed ordered tree with 2..6 nonadministrative macro occurrences, at least two distinct family/idea IDs, and at least one actual producer-consumer edge. Bridges count toward node/depth bounds. Mere juxtaposition, identity insertion, and pure administrative permutations are excluded.

Repeat/repair is not a grammar constructor. Expand at most one retry/repair per macro and at most two re-entry steps globally using decreasing integer fuel; every expanded stage consumes nodes, tokens and money.
For a fixed tree, enumerate only topological execution schedules of its explicit dependency/effect graph; never permute ordered input slots without a separately registered symmetry law.
finite_composition_grammar.enumeration: Dynamic-program over output type, exact node count, depth, fuel and cost envelope. Instantiate the finite parameter choices and ordered child partitions, then check indices/effects/preservation and canonicalize. Enumerate schedules by finite topological sorts. Record generated, rejected, unknown and deduplicated counts with reasons; stream the complete finite space or report partial traversal honestly. A heuristic shortlist cannot be labeled exhaustive.
admissibility: Every descriptor has concrete input/output schema and validator hashes, immutable task/context indices, source pins, resource upper bounds and typed refusal paths. The external signature table is a specification proposal, not evidence these bindings exist.

Native lowering respects the existing closed colour vocabulary, exact full port equality, source/capability ceilings, acyclicity, root reachability, ordered open inputs and single-consumer outputs. Missing schema/validator/executor bindings remain signature_pending or candidate_only.

No unknown provider cost, unchecked role count, unbounded loops, implicit paid retries, private evaluator input, changed task assumptions, hidden answer computation, or seed truncation. Missing task applicability is a refusal, not a new checker.

Any mutation invalidates artifact-specific receipts. Every claimed preservation or effect law needs its declared evidence; diagnostic agreement and scalar equality cannot discharge semantic obligations.

Same-seed experiments cannot supply new held-out task families. WF30 constraint changes are excluded from unchanged-seed arms unless they provably preserve the full original task; otherwise they are separately labeled benchmarks.
equivalence_dedup: Canonicalize occurrence IDs by ordered-tree position, JSON field order and exact source/parameter pins. Remove only declared pure administrative identities. Keep every real model-call occurrence distinct, including identical prompts, because stochastic draws and costs differ.

Quotient different syntax bracketings only when they denote the same ordered expanded occurrence tree and the relevant effect/residual law version is admitted. Otherwise retain both as law-audit candidates.

Swap adjacent independent deterministic host steps only with disjoint read/write sets and a checked commutation law preserving values, residuals, cost and observed trace modulo that specific law. Dependence tests alone do not establish commutation.

Do not merge screen-before-rewrite with rewrite-before-screen, different prompt order, different seeds/settings, different checker scopes, different refusal behavior, or different branch schedules merely because types or scalar diagnostics match.
statuses: descriptor_proposed: finite specification with missing implementation or schema bindings
typed_candidate: static declared interfaces and budget envelope compose; no execution or semantic admission inferred
compiled_unadmitted: existing compiler returns a candidate with pinned sources; still not executable admission

runnable_public_only: separately verified adapters/executor/checkers, public fixtures, immutable seed path, supported billing bounds and shared ledger are all installed; mathematical scope remains explicit
evaluated_frozen_seed: actually run, frozen and independently scored with complete accounting; success and failure outcomes retained
rejected or unresolved: preserve exact failed obligations; not silently removed from enumeration accounting
finite_composition_grammar.current_availability: This report supplies descriptors only. It implements no bridges, grammar enumerator, executor, checker or provider adapter. Existing WF1-WF5 runner source is not evidence that the proposed combined QM workflow is runnable. All three research ideas remain proposed_not_evaluated.

research_agent_reports.focus: Independent proposals, disagreement localization, blind critique, and consensus limits

scope.seed_access: Seed content was not read or solved. Its public commitment and SHA-256 were checked. No answer key, private storage, or paid model calls were accessed.
scope.novelty_claim: Proposed repository adaptations, not literature-wide novelty. The new mechanisms are premise-aware disagreement frontiers, candidate-blind challenge generation, and masked-conclusion seam replay; merely adding roles would duplicate existing workflows.
scope.implementation_boundary: All new schemas, symbolic adapters, masking rules, and panel selectors below require implementation. Existing WF4 exact-sum success does not establish a checker for a quantum derivation. Native PFP/EIS/OPERADS integration is proposed, not executed.
scope.benchmark_isolation: Every future model request includes the original seed as a separate message whose decoded UTF-8 content preserves its exact bytes. Hash before and after request construction; do not rewrite assumptions or requested parts. Workflow broker has no filesystem, shell, repository retrieval, or evaluator access. Freeze final candidate bytes before separate trusted evaluation; no private scores, labels, diagnostics, or key-derived repairs return to any stage.

primary_sources.title: Wang et al., Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models, ICLR 2023
primary_sources.relevance: Section 2 samples multiple reasoning paths and aggregates parsed answers; motivates an equal-budget sampled-answer baseline. Its empirical improvements do not certify any particular agreed answer or establish a calibrated independence model.

primary_sources.title: Du et al., Improving Factuality and Reasoning in Language Models through Multiagent Debate, ICML 2024
primary_sources.relevance: Primary proceedings paper studies proposal and debate rounds. Motivates separating additional proposal supply from effects of visibility and persuasion; its results are not evidence that our proposed two-call mechanisms improve this seed.

primary_sources.title: Choi, Zhu and Li, Debate or Vote: Which Yields Better Decisions in Multi-Agent Large Language Models?, NeurIPS 2025
primary_sources.relevance: Compares voting against debate and supplies a Dirichlet-Compound-Multinomial/Bayesian-update analysis. The martingale result is conditional on its stochastic model and update assumptions, not an impossibility theorem for arbitrary debate or sound external verification. Motivates retaining pre-debate candidates and a no-debate baseline.

repository_evidence.observation: Checker soundness and task adequacy are separate; declared correlation keys and finite clean panels do not establish statistical independence.
Immutable seed, isolated evaluator, retained failures, paired one-item comparisons, and aggregate USD 0.10 reservation are required.
All branches/retries/judges require reservations; token bounds and tariff components must be admitted before dispatch; unavailable usage cannot count as zero.
Existing family uses shared mining, five isolated solvers, local checks and global compatibility; the stated exact predicate is integer sum, not general mathematical agreement.
Existing proposal freezes prosecutor and defender before seeing each other, then delegates verdict to a finite host check.
Eight-role proposal retains host authority; l1 defect descent does not automatically measure semantic correctness of arbitrary derivations.
Tournament design uses a declared finite referee and held-out shares; its earlier rates were withdrawn. One frozen seed cannot supply independent task-level transfer evidence.

common_budget_policy.formula: Reserve C_max = sum_s(I_s*p_in_s + O_s*p_out_s + F_s) + R <= USD 0.10 before either call. I includes the exact seed, schemas, instructions, prior artifacts and provider framing; O includes all billable reasoning and response tokens. Two calls maximum, zero retries, zero automatic fallbacks, no paid judge or tool branch.
common_budget_policy.conditional_example: Conditional endpoint ceilings p_in <= USD 0.000001/token and p_out <= USD 0.000005/token, F_s=0, R=USD 0.01. These are admission thresholds, not current quoted prices or a model recommendation. R covers quantified framing/fee allowance; unknown fees or uncapped reasoning require refusal, not reliance on the allowance.
common_budget_policy.routing: Pin actual provider/model/version, current tariff, enforced output cap and a justified input-token upper bound. Each stage reservation is held even after timeout or ambiguous delivery; such events stop the run. Reserve parallel branches jointly before dispatch. If input bounds exceed caps, refuse rather than truncate seed or silently remove requested parts.
common_budget_policy.receipts: Record request hashes, visibility manifests, token allowances, provider usage, actual charges and unused reservation. Each ablation is a separately costed complete run; no campaign is authorized or executed here. Private evaluation is offline and separately costed, with no model feedback channel.
common_budget_policy.host_compute: Assume already provisioned local CPU has zero incremental monetary charge; otherwise reserve its metered cost. Cap each artifact at 24 claims and 48 edges, each expression at 512 AST nodes and 256-bit rational components, and each deterministic checker at 10 seconds and 256 MB. Unsupported or resource-exhausted checks remain UNKNOWN.

ideas.name: Frozen independent proposals with a premise-aware disagreement frontier

mathematical_basis.known_method: Independent proposal sampling plus deterministic claim comparison; dependency graphs locate the earliest represented divergence rather than counting answer strings.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Two isolated solvers receive different preregistered public method contracts but the same unchanged seed, with no shared model-generated mining. Freeze both complete answers. Align claims only by public obligation IDs, context and domain; compare exact normal forms in an admitted fragment. Compute the minimal disagreeing nodes under ancestor order and list their descendants. Unknown equivalence is a separate status. Select one complete candidate by a frozen public-check rule, retaining the other and the frontier; never splice prose with incompatible assumptions.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: For an aligned DAG G and proven-incompatible node set D, frontier F={v in D: no ancestor of v lies in D}. F is minimal only relative to the represented graph and admitted alignment. Equality f=g under Gamma says nothing about whether either solves the intended task. If equal-marginal Bernoulli error indicators have rate e and correlation rho under a declared sampling distribution, P(E1=E2=1)=e^2+rho*e*(1-e); rho is not inferable from two artifacts.

assumptions: Public obligation IDs and premise/domain schemas are fixed without consulting the answer key; incorrect semantic extraction remains an explicit residual.

A trusted equivalence checker exists only for an advertised rational/polynomial fragment. Different printed expressions are not automatically incompatible; non-equivalence needs a sound witness in a common valid domain.

Isolation establishes no cross-call artifact visibility. Distinct role labels, prompts or model families do not establish independent errors. Independent decoder draws may be conditionally independent on a fixed task while error rates across tasks share common difficulty; neither model is assumed here.
At most 24 aligned claims, 48 edges and two complete candidates; malformed, truncated or missing candidates remain recorded failures.
ideas.hypothesis: At matched total money or tokens, premise-aware frontiers identify more actionable disagreements and fewer false disagreements than final-string comparison, while preserving final-answer completeness.

stages.instruction: Bind exact seed and public schemas; record that neither solver can read the other, histories, evaluator or shared generated notes. Preregister ranking: fewer soundly refuted obligations, then more fixed obligations supported by admitted exact checks, then A on ties. Ranking is heuristic outside checked predicates.
Answer all original requested parts under method contract A; emit short public claim DAG with explicit domains and premises. Mark unsupported steps. No self-issued verification label.
Answer all original requested parts under method contract B without seeing A. Preserve obligation IDs and emit claim DAG. Declare method inapplicability rather than inventing an alternative task.

Freeze both artifacts; validate bindings, acyclicity and premises. Align admitted claims, check witnesses and compute the represented disagreement frontier. Mark unmatched/unsupported claims UNKNOWN. Do not use a model judge.

Apply preregistered ranking only to fixed obligation IDs; render the selected complete answer with explicit contradictions/open obligations and retain alternative provenance. Do not interpret agreement as certification. Freeze before private scoring.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Two isolated same-model answers under identical public contracts, final-answer equality with deterministic A tie-break; same combined token budget and no judge call.
ablations: Remove distinct method contracts while preserving isolation
Replace premise-aware comparison with final-string agreement
Replace frontier with an unordered full disagreement list
Use a single call with the same total output allowance
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Synthetic public pairs include equivalent rewrites, different domains, shared wrong answers and one corrupted ancestor. Measure localization precision, unknown rate and false disagreements. Separately evaluate frozen seed answers with paired repetitions; report correctness, completeness, joint errors and cost. No correlation estimate is justified by a single pair.

ideas.falsification: Advantage fails if localization does not improve over string comparison, if valid rewrites are labeled contradictory, or if ranking loses completeness beyond a preregistered tolerance. A shared wrong answer receiving a certified label immediately violates the design.
risks: Both solvers can share the same false premise; no disagreement detector catches universal agreement on an error.
Canonicalization can erase domain restrictions or confuse merely different with contradictory answers.
Check-count ranking can reward easy claims; only a frozen requested-obligation inventory may contribute.
ideas.budget_formula: Two branches together: C_max <= 12000*p_in + 5000*p_out + sum(F_s) + R. At conditional ceilings and R=0.01, reserve USD 0.047; 2500 output tokens per branch, no additional calls.

ideas.name: Candidate-blind challenge panel with witness-gated objections

mathematical_basis.known_method: Independent test design and finite counterexample checking separate candidate production from the search for disconfirming evidence.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Run one full solver and one challenge designer independently. The challenger sees the seed and public obligation types but never the solver answer, confidence, endpoint or check results. It emits bounded typed boundary tests and premise audits, not a rhetorical verdict. After both are frozen the host applies admissible challenges to the candidate and annotates exact counterexamples, numerical concerns, unsupported tests and untouched claims. No repair call follows.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: For a candidate universal assertion forall x in D, P(x), an exact witness x0 in D with checked not P(x0) refutes that assertion. Finite passing tests do not prove a universal statement. For a merely sufficient condition A=>B, failure of A is not a counterexample; require A(x0) and not B(x0). Numerical discrepancies require sound error bounds to count as exact refutations.

assumptions: Candidate claims explicitly encode quantifiers, domains, premise IDs and obligation IDs; ambiguous prose receives an uncheckable annotation.
The public challenge language is non-executable data: rational substitutions, domain-boundary probes and prerequisite-presence queries. No model-supplied shell or unrestricted code runs.
A challenger lacking the candidate may miss its specific failure; its statistical independence from the solver is unavailable even though candidate visibility is absent.
At most 12 challenges; each must target an existing public obligation and distinguish a required premise from an optional sufficient condition.
ideas.hypothesis: At matched budget, candidate-blind test design catches more shared-premise and boundary omissions than a visible prose critique without increasing false rejections of valid controls.

stages.instruction: Bind original seed, fixed obligation IDs and grammar; reserve both calls. Challenger receives no solver artifact or candidate-selected hint.
Answer all seed parts with explicit assumptions, domains and typed claim records. Supply candidate witnesses without claiming host approval.

From the immutable task and public grammar alone, propose at most 12 high-yield boundary/premise challenges. Do not solve the task or guess what another solver said. Encode sufficient-condition versus necessary-condition distinctions explicitly.

Freeze both outputs; validate challenge applicability against candidate domains and quantifiers. Evaluate only admitted typed predicates. Require checked witnesses for refutation; unsupported, floating-point-only and timed-out checks remain separately labeled.

Retain the original complete candidate, mark exact refutations as withdrawn claims and untested claims as open. Do not silently replace refuted conclusions. Record completeness loss and all challenge outcomes before trusted evaluation.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Same two calls/caps, but critic sees the complete candidate and emits the same typed challenge format.
ablations: Replace model challenge designer with a fixed deterministic public checklist
Allow candidate visibility while removing confidence/identity metadata only
Replace typed challenges with freeform critique, with verdicts still untrusted
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Use unrelated synthetic public controls with known boundary errors and valid sufficient conditions. Measure witnessed fault discovery, challenge applicability, valid-control false rejection and completeness. Seed scoring occurs only on frozen artifacts; no rejected claim is repaired using evaluator information.

ideas.falsification: Reject the advantage if blinded challenges miss more faults at equal cost, or if false rejections increase. A critique without a valid-domain witness being treated as a mathematical refutation falsifies the host contract.
risks: Blind challenge generation may duplicate generic checks and miss candidate-specific algebraic errors.
A wrong challenge interpreter can manufacture counterexamples outside the declared domain.
Absence of detected faults can be mistaken for global approval; render untested/unsupported coverage explicitly.
ideas.budget_formula: C_max <= 10000*p_in + 4500*p_out + sum(F_s) + R. At conditional ceilings and R=0.01, reserve USD 0.0425; solver cap 3000 plus critic cap 1500, no retries or repair branches.

ideas.name: Masked-conclusion replay at dependency seams

mathematical_basis.known_method: Blind reconstruction and compositional interface checking test whether intermediate conclusions can be reproduced from declared premises without exposing the proposed result.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: The first call supplies a full answer and typed dependency DAG. A deterministic host selects up to four seams by descendant requested-obligation count, ties by public ID. The second call receives the unchanged seed plus each seam's input premises, domains and output type, but not the candidate seam conclusion, downstream text, model identity or confidence. It reconstructs those outputs. The host compares the frozen reconstructions with originals and propagates disagreement/unknown status; it does not ask the critic to endorse the answer.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: If a seam declares Gamma and inputs P1..Pk, reconstructing Q' and proving Gamma entails Q iff Q' establishes equivalence under Gamma only. Correctness still requires Gamma and each Pi, and a sound rule from them to Q. A refuted/open parent propagates to dependent conclusions. Agreement of reconstructions does not close a proof obligation by itself.

assumptions: Seam inputs are explicit and treated as assumptions, not trusted facts. The original seed stays visible even if it permits independently inferring a masked conclusion.

Selection and masking use structural fields only, not private evaluation. All candidate-generated labels and prose are removed except whitelisted typed premises/conditions; residual leakage through premises is possible and logged.

This is conclusion-blind relative to selected candidate fields, not independent proposal generation: call B depends on call A's premise extraction and topology. The visible dependency is recorded, and no independence confidence bonus is assigned.
At most four seams from a 24-node/48-edge DAG; checker equivalence and substitution remain restricted to an admitted fragment.
ideas.hypothesis: At equal budget, masked seam reconstruction exposes more unsupported interface steps than an ordinary visible critique, with fewer endorsement flips driven by confidence or copied conclusions.

stages.instruction: Bind unchanged seed and public seam policy; reserve both calls including the worst-case second-input size.
Answer every requested part; attach the bounded DAG with explicit seam premises and conclusion fields. Do not pack conclusions into premise names or descriptive labels.

stages.role: Deterministic seam selection and field masking
stages.instruction: Validate DAG and choose up to four seams by fixed rule. Expose only whitelisted typed inputs and output types; exclude original conclusions, descendant text, confidence and identity. Freeze a visibility manifest. Empty or invalid DAG stops replay as incomplete, with unused reservation retained/reconciled normally.

Using the exact seed and masked capsules, reconstruct each requested seam output under its declared assumptions. Flag missing assumptions and unsupported interfaces; do not estimate the original author's likely answer.

Check scope-aware equivalence or exact counterexamples, retaining UNKNOWN when unavailable. Propagate original and reconstructed parent residuals to descendants. Render original full candidate with seam annotations; never replace a seam unless the complete dependency transport is checked. Freeze before separate evaluation.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Same two calls and allowances, with seam conclusions visible to the second call; all deterministic host checks unchanged.
ablations: Mask author/confidence only, leaving conclusions visible
Choose seams uniformly using a preregistered host seed instead of dependency influence
Replay every affordable seam without residual propagation
Replace the second call with deterministic checking alone
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Unrelated synthetic DAGs contain wrong conclusions, false shared premises, missing inputs and valid equivalent formulations. Measure seam fault discovery, false accusations and inherited-error propagation. On the fixed benchmark measure completeness and blinded trusted score after freezing; the four seams are not four independent experimental units.

ideas.falsification: The mechanism fails if masked replay does not improve fault localization over visible critique, if masking materially reduces completeness without benefit, or if any dependent conclusion is cleared despite a required unresolved parent. A copied hidden conclusion found in a visible field invalidates the blindness condition for that run.
risks: Premise choice and output type may reveal the candidate conclusion; blindness is limited and must be audited.
Both calls can reproduce the same erroneous rule or accept the same false premise.
Structural centrality may select easy steps while missing the important unsupported analytic bridge.
ideas.budget_formula: C_max <= 14000*p_in + 4700*p_out + sum(F_s) + R. At conditional ceilings and R=0.01, reserve USD 0.0475; output caps 2800 and 1900. Missing/invalid seams skip the second call; no replacement or repair call is allowed.

recommended_reusable_primitive.name: FrozenPanelComparisonV1
recommended_reusable_primitive.recommendation: Implement a host-owned visibility and comparison receipt shared by all three workflows before adding more model roles.
recommended_reusable_primitive.invariant: An agreement status never upgrades claim correctness. Isolation and blinding report information access, not statistical independence. Refutation requires a valid-domain witness; incomparable or unsupported claims remain UNKNOWN. No downstream output may drop inherited unresolved premises.
recommended_reusable_primitive.research_prompt_instruction: Implement receipt schemas and public synthetic controls for copied answers, shared false premises, equivalent rewrites, out-of-domain counterexamples and masking leaks. Do not solve the benchmark, alter seed bytes, access private evaluator storage, or launch paid calls.
recommended_reusable_primitive.first_experiment: Host-only synthetic comparison and visibility tests, then a separately authorized equal-budget R05-I02 blind-versus-visible challenge comparison. No experiment has been executed in this report.

research_agent_reports.focus: Adaptive compute, early stopping, abstention, model escalation, and cost-versus-accuracy measurement

scope.seed_access: No seed contents, seed solution, answer key, private benchmark storage, credentials, or paid-model outputs were read for this report.
scope.novelty_claim: Three proposed repository adaptations of established cascade and selective-prediction ideas; no literature-wide novelty claim.
scope.implementation_boundary: The durable benchmark ledger exists and is locally tested according to ACCOUNTING.md; the proposed policy compiler, checker registry, and live provider admission are not implemented or admitted here. An accounting cap is not a mathematical acceptance test.
scope.benchmark_isolation: Each model call must include the exact original UTF-8 seed bytes as a separate message, with no normalization, substitution, truncation, or assumption changes. Hash both the seed and actual rendered request, and verify decoded seed content matches original bytes. Other instructions and artifacts occupy separate messages. Public fixed predicates may guide routing; private scores, key-derived examples, and expected answers may not. Freeze outputs before separate trusted evaluation; no evaluator feedback can trigger another call.

primary_sources.title: Chen, Zaharia, and Zou, FrugalGPT: How to Use Large Language Models While Reducing Cost and Improving Performance (2023)
primary_sources.relevance: Primary cascade precedent: combining model calls can trade cost against accuracy. The reported benchmark improvements do not imply that any proposed gate, model pair, or physics answer here is accurate.

primary_sources.title: Geifman and El-Yaniv, SelectiveNet: A Deep Neural Network with an Integrated Reject Option, ICML 2019
primary_sources.relevance: Defines selective prediction through a prediction function and selection function, with risk and coverage reported together. Our host-rule rejection policy is an adaptation, not SelectiveNet training or a calibrated statistical guarantee.

primary_sources.title: OpenRouter Usage Accounting
primary_sources.relevance: Documents response token, reasoning, cache, and charged-cost fields. Observed usage supports reconciliation after dispatch; it is not an advance guarantee that an external charge fits a local reservation.

repository_evidence.observation: Requires identical seed bytes, isolated private evaluation, failed-run denominators, separate equal-money/token/time comparisons, and aggregate USD 0.10 per execution.
Ledger is implemented/tested, live adapters unadmitted; unknown fees or uncertain bounds cause refusal. Byte estimates do not establish guaranteed input bounds.
Quotes use integer microusd; duplicate call identities are refused; uncertain charges retain reservations and block the run; observed overruns remain recorded.
Bounds repair attempts, returns typed residuals, and stops on accepted predicates or exhaustion. Its finite parity/cochain checks are not general analytic validators.
Pre-registers model/stage arms, unresolved outputs, and paired item comparisons. Boosted arms are separate pre-registered arms rather than mid-campaign changes.
Requires parent binding and one original budget for every prefix. The proposals prohibit reset through restart or escalation.
Exhausted repair terminates in a typed boundary outcome; changing requested claims is a new problem. These proposals choose terminal unresolved, without seed change or automatic lift.
Binds a campaign specification and phase to a shared provider ledger, rejects unreconciled cost, and limits phase spending; reusable accounting precedent, not benchmark adapter admission.

Legacy gateway computes input_upper_bound from message UTF-8 lengths, can reserve fewer output tokens than transport max_output_tokens, and retains an uncertainty reservation on transport failure. These paths must not be taken as a proved hard cap for the new benchmark.
Raw duplicate sender is retired and refuses on invocation; it is not a usable benchmark transport.

Wrapper delegates accounting and dispatch to Rust, disables its own retries, and distinguishes NOT_SENT, OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, and REPLIED. This read did not audit the Rust billing bound or admit the wrapper for the benchmark.

common_budget_policy.formula: For every complete path pi reserve C_max(pi)=sum_s(I_s*p_in_s+O_s*p_out_s+F_s)+R <= USD 0.10 before dispatch. I_s bounds the entire rendered request, including seed/framing/artifacts; O_s bounds all billable output including hidden reasoning under verified provider semantics. F_s includes all additional metered fees. R is a non-dispatchable USD 0.01 margin in conditional examples, not permission to assume unknown fees are covered.
common_budget_policy.admission: Pin endpoint/model/version, current tariff and overrides, supported output caps, trustworthy input bounds, and charge semantics. Unknown billing components, unsupported caps, or bounds exceeding envelopes cause refusal. Conditional prices below are admissibility thresholds, not actual current price quotes. Byte count alone is not an external billing bound.
