Bind seed hash and full compiled-request hash, and verify byte inclusion rather than only hash equality. Wrappers cannot omit requested subparts or alter assumptions. The broker has no retrieval, filesystem, shell, or private-evaluator tool. Freeze all run outputs and the entire preregistered campaign before private grading; no private scores, labels, counterexamples, or key-derived hints enter allocation, stopping, wrapper mutation, or another run.
scope.inference_scope: Repeated stochastic samples of one seed estimate only this item's performance under the pinned model/provider/settings. A confirmation sample means fresh provider draws on the same item, never unseen-problem generalization. Public synthetic detector fixtures validate only detector behavior on those fixtures.

primary_sources.title: Howard, Ramdas, McAuliffe and Sekhon, Time-uniform, nonparametric, nonasymptotic confidence sequences (Annals of Statistics, 2021)
primary_sources.relevance: Develops time-uniform inference under stated assumptions. Motivates distinguishing a preregistered fixed sample size from optional stopping; this proposal uses fixed campaign sizes and no score-dependent continuation. An ordinary fixed-sample confidence interval is not made anytime-valid by calling a workflow sequential.

primary_sources.title: El-Yaniv and Wiener, On the Foundations of Noise-free Selective Classification (JMLR, 2010)
primary_sources.relevance: Formalizes selective classification and the risk-coverage tradeoff. Motivates reporting coverage alongside conditional error. Its noise-free classification guarantees do not transfer automatically to mathematical derivation, proxy detectors, or this single seed.

primary_sources.title: OpenRouter official provider routing documentation
primary_sources.relevance: Documents endpoint pinning, fallback controls, parameter requirements, and max_price filtering. Price ceilings filter providers; latency preferences are not deadline guarantees and neither mechanism substitutes for the aggregate run ledger.

primary_sources.title: OpenRouter official usage accounting documentation
primary_sources.relevance: Documents returned native-token counts, charged cost, and available reasoning/cache detail. Use returned accounting fields as observations and retain unavailable values explicitly. Admission quotes and output limits remain separate from actual usage.

repository_evidence.observation: Separates native finite mechanisms from semantic adequacy and identifies no complete verified checker for the frozen graduate-QM seed.
Requires unchanged seed bytes, isolated after-freeze grading, randomized repeated samples, failures in the denominator, distinct money/token/time comparisons, and an aggregate campaign budget.
USD 0.10 applies across a whole workflow; honest input/tariff bounds and provider-enforced ceilings are prerequisites; actual usage and both time metrics are mandatory.
Quotes are rounded upward in integer microusd, run/call identities prevent reset or redispatch, outstanding calls hold reservations, and uncertainty or observed overruns block the run.
Host-bounded feedback is distinct from raw judge diagnostics; missing or failing checkers and disagreement have explicit outcomes. Typed acceptance depends on the injected checker.
Runs the actual bound detector against known-clean fixtures and explicitly limits a passing result to that finite panel.
Immune suppression needs two named signals, while a host refusal remains independently enforceable. Provenance assertions do not establish population statistical independence.
Lineage distinguishes direct mutation, repair, retry, and precedent; requires witnessed edges and an acyclic inheritance graph.

Preserves explicit failure/infrastructure outcomes and assigned-unit completion denominators; comparative claims require a holdout indicator and multiplicity declaration, not merely a good-looking fitness number.
Ordered colour-compatible substitution rejects ill-typed insertion. Its associativity receipt is signature-level and does not certify operation bodies, scheduler behavior, or mathematical answers.

common_budget_policy.formula: For every run reserve Cmax = sum_j(Ij*p_in_j + Oj*p_out_j + Fj) + R <= USD 0.10, with prices in USD/token, before the corresponding dispatch. At most two model calls, no retries, model judges, paid search, tools, or implicit fallback. Ij includes exact seed, all wrappers and any prior artifacts. Oj bounds all billable completion/reasoning tokens under the endpoint's documented semantics; do not double-count a reported reasoning subset. Reserve every potentially concurrent call before either is launched. Unknown billing or unenforceable bounds cause preflight refusal.
common_budget_policy.conditional_example: Illustrative admission ceilings only: p_in <= USD 0.000001/token, p_out <= USD 0.000005/token, Fj=0 and R=USD 0.010 for explicitly priced remaining charges. These are not current tariff claims or a model choice. Envelopes are R09-I01: I<=16000/O<=4400/C<=0.048; R09-I02: I<=15000/O<=4200/C<=0.046; R09-I03: I<=12000/O<=4400/C<=0.044. If the actual bounded seed/request cannot fit, refuse; never truncate or replace the seed. Margin alone does not cover unknown fees.
common_budget_policy.routing: Pin model revision, provider endpoint, tariff snapshot, billable-token semantics and supported limits. Disable fallback and SDK retries. A timeout or cancellation is not evidence of nonbilling; retain the full reservation and block dispatch until trusted reconciliation. Do not infer an input-token upper bound from bytes/token averages.
common_budget_policy.receipts: Record all assigned run IDs and statuses; exact seed, wrapper, request, output and policy hashes; randomization stratum/assignment; observed input/output/reasoning/cache fields; quoted and actual monetary amounts separately. Missing token/cost/grade/time data remain unavailable. Record wall latency from run admission to frozen output, each dispatch-to-terminal elapsed duration, their sum called serialtime_proxy, and provider-reported compute duration separately if available. Sum of client durations is not measured accelerator compute time. Record late settlements without replacing frozen output. No paid calls were made.
common_budget_policy.host_compute: Local host checks have fixed caps: at most 64 claims, 256 dependency edges, 10000 AST nodes, 4096-bit exact integers, 1 MiB candidate bytes, 2 seconds per candidate and 256 MiB additional memory. Exceeding a cap yields OPEN or HOST_LIMIT, not an incorrect-mathematics label. Already provisioned local compute has assumed zero incremental monetary charge; otherwise reserve metered host cost or refuse. Private evaluation is a separately budgeted trusted activity after freeze, with cost and reviewer time reported separately; it is not a hidden free workflow call.
common_budget_policy.experiment_contract: Before paid execution, explicitly authorize and freeze campaign aggregate budget, N per arm, all arm manifests, fixed random order in complete blocks, endpoint/settings, primary endpoints, thresholds, and stopping. Conduct three separate panels: equal monetary allowance, equal total token allowance, and equal wall-time allowance. Equality concerns assigned allowance, not realized spend; retain savings as an outcome. Every panel still obeys USD 0.10 per run and two-call maximum. Do not force simultaneous equality or silently discard calls to match realized cost.
common_budget_policy.statistics_contract: Fixed N; no hidden-score-dependent early stopping, adaptive allocation, or future-wrapper selection. Infrastructure/budget safety may halt a campaign, preserving every assigned unit and labeling incomplete inference. Use a direct same-model baseline. For fixed primary paired normalized-score differences D in [-1,1], a conservative simultaneous bound is mean(D) +/- sqrt(2*log(2*K/alpha)/N), clipped to [-1,1], for K preregistered contrasts under independent blocks and stable mean; this is the elementary Hoeffding/union-bound construction, not the confidence-sequence theorem. Set alpha=0.05 and freeze K before launch. Drift/dependence invalidates that sampling guarantee and requires a descriptive result. Keep raw scores, status tables and uncertainty even when intervals are wide. Additional thresholds, rubric categories, budget panels, ablations and Pareto-front selections enlarge the family or remain exploratory. Any wrapper tuning needs a subsequent independently sampled, untouched confirmation block on this same item.
common_budget_policy.failure_contract: All assigned executions remain in intention-to-treat denominators, including preflight refusal, timeout, truncation, parsing failure, abstention and incomplete accounting. Raw mathematical score is separately scored where a frozen answer exists; the operational utility score is 0 for no delivered answer. For missing trusted grades, retain missingness and report worst/best bounds using 0 and 100 instead of inventing a measured score or dropping the row. Accepted-only accuracy and zero-cost ratios cannot replace unconditional score, coverage, cost and time deltas.

ideas.name: Randomized second-slot repair versus independent re-derivation

mathematical_basis.known_method: Randomized treatment allocation conditional on a pretreatment stratum, followed by intention-to-treat estimation.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Generate one complete compact derivation, freeze it, and classify its public-check residuals. Within each fixed stratum, allocate the only remaining model slot to either repair of that artifact or a fresh complete derivation that cannot see it. The output cap, model/provider and monetary allowance are identical for the two actions. Thus the experiment identifies the value of allocating the second slot to an informed repair rather than another sample, instead of confounding an elaborate workflow with more model calls.
mathematical_basis.allocation: H=h(C1) belongs to {actionable_public_failure, unsupported_or_no_failure}; h and fixtures are fixed before any seed execution. Z~Bernoulli(1/2) is revealed after C1 and H are frozen. Z=1 supplies C1 plus only approved public failure codes; Z=0 supplies the seed and a frozen PCIV wrapper variant, but not C1. Both slot-two roles return a complete answer. A pre-generated blocked allocation table prevents outcome-responsive scheduling.
mathematical_basis.estimand: For final normalized rubric outcome Y(z) in [0,1], tau=E[Y(1)-Y(0)] over repeated calls on this fixed seed. With randomized positivity, no interference and consistent execution, tau_hat=N^-1 sum_i[Z_i*Y_i/0.5-(1-Z_i)*Y_i/0.5] is unbiased for that assigned-population contrast. Stratified mean differences may improve precision. The allocation estimator's summand has range [-2,2], so it needs its own valid randomization interval or Hoeffding radius sqrt(8*log(2*K/alpha)/N); do not reuse the paired-difference radius without adjustment.
mathematical_basis.selection: Use the same host selector in both arms: among complete schema-valid candidates, prefer fewer demonstrated public-predicate violations, then fewer unresolved required fields, then the lower fixed slot ID. Emit the chosen original answer unchanged with a receipt. No model self-score or private rubric appears in selection. If no complete candidate is usable, freeze an explicit partial/abstention with preserved artifacts.

assumptions: Random assignment is generated independently of provider outcomes and private evaluation; service conditions are blocked by nearby execution time and the endpoint is pinned.
Public checks identify only their declared predicates. A detector stratum can be uninformative about mathematical error and is never a correctness label.
Second-slot repair and fresh-generation bodies obey their typed information boundary. A fresh answer cannot retrieve the first response through shared conversation history.
The local selection rule and all wrapper variants are frozen on answer-independent fixtures; fresh draws are not assumed statistically independent merely because prompts differ.
ideas.hypothesis: At equal second-slot allowance, repair improves unconditional mean rubric score by at least 3 points over fresh re-derivation in the actionable-public-failure stratum; the overall contrast and other stratum are separately preregistered secondary outcomes.

stages.instruction: Verify exact seed inclusion, type-check the OPERADS composition, reserve aggregate maxima and freeze the PCIV wrapper lineage. Prepare concealed randomized second-role assignment. Preflight refusal is a recorded assigned-run outcome.

Receive unchanged seed in its own message. Produce a complete compact derivation with explicit claim IDs, assumptions, requested-part coverage and public-check artifacts; identify open obligations. Return at most 2200 billable output/reasoning tokens under the admitted endpoint semantics.

Freeze C1, run PFP public checks and calibrated EIS screening, determine the fixed stratum, then reveal the randomized role. Bind h, Z, propensity and all input hashes. RepairInput contains C1 and bounded non-secret failure codes; FreshInput contains no C1. Never pass a raw private/evaluator diagnostic.

One mutually exclusive paid operation, not two branches dispatched: repair C1 if assigned RepairInput; independently derive a complete answer if assigned FreshInput. Both receive the exact seed and the same 2200-token ceiling. If the first call has uncertain billing or the remaining reservation fails, issue SKIPPED without a provider call.

Recheck candidate artifacts, apply the fixed public selector, retain failures and both original outputs, freeze final bytes and ledger. The private evaluator later sees frozen candidates/final output only after the full campaign closes; its results cannot reopen this DAG.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Direct same-model single call with the same assigned money or token allowance in its respective panel; also a two-call draft plus generic self-critique control isolates extra-call effects.
ablations: Replace detector-stratified allocation with unstratified randomized allocation
Repair with generic feedback instead of public failure codes
Select slot two unconditionally instead of the fixed public selector
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Freeze N, strata, primary contrast and K first. Report arm/stratum assignment counts, delivered-answer score, all-run score, slot-two improvement over frozen C1, actual cost, token fields, wall latency, serialtime_proxy and missingness. First-draft scores are computed only in delayed private evaluation. Randomize run order within complete blocks; common timestamps or provider seed labels do not create paired counterfactuals.

ideas.falsification: The 3-point actionable-stratum advantage is contradicted when its multiplicity-adjusted upper confidence bound is below 3; a nonpositive upper bound rejects even a positive gain. Wide bounds mean inconclusive. Any second-role dispatch seeing a hidden score or a supposedly fresh branch seeing C1 falsifies the isolation contract.
risks: Thin strata and a tiny paid campaign may make the randomized contrast extremely imprecise.
Provider changes, cache carryover or rate-limit interference can invalidate stable-mean assumptions; record and block rather than pool silently.
A public selector can reject a correct but unfamiliar derivation or favor formally neat nonsense; rubric score remains the endpoint.
Testing many strata, allocation probabilities or selector tie-breaks after seeing grades creates multiplicity and same-item tuning.
ideas.budget_formula: At most two calls. Cmax<=16000*p_in+4400*p_out+F1+F2+R. At the stated conditional price ceilings and R=0.010, Cmax<=USD 0.048. Slot-two alternative roles share one reservation; they are never both executed. Actual cost is measured separately.

ideas.name: Public-evidence continuation gate with explicit abstention accounting

mathematical_basis.known_method: Selective prediction with a reject option and a bounded two-stage cascade.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Run one complete derivation and a public obligation audit. Spend the second call only when a fixed predicate finds a repairable public defect and a safe reservation remains. Stop with the first answer when no such defect is found; stop with explicit unresolved claims or abstention when infrastructure failure or unsupported obligations cannot be repaired by the admitted second-stage operation. No high self-confidence threshold or private expected-answer signal is used.
mathematical_basis.policy: g(C1,receipt) in {STOP_WITH_UNCHECKED_ANSWER,REPAIR_ONCE,PARTIAL_OR_ABSTAIN}. REPAIR_ONCE requires at least one declared repairable schema/identity/coverage defect, healthy bound checker, known billing and sufficient reservation. Unsupported analytic obligations remain OPEN rather than being treated as false. A direct host integrity refusal is enforced even without both EIS danger signals; immune suppression must not manufacture a second independent signal from the same model statement.
mathematical_basis.metrics: Let A=1 only for a delivered output labeled full_answer; partial answers and full abstentions have A=0 for this selective metric. For normalized trusted score Y, coverage=E[A], selective risk=E[A*(1-Y)]/E[A] when E[A]>0, and full-answer delivered utility=E[A*Y]. This strict utility gives partial answers zero while their independently graded raw rubric score is still reported; the label full_answer asserts intended coverage, not correctness. Preserve the original unfiltered final rubric score too, including partial answers. Score-based risk is rubric loss, not the probability that every formula is correct; report the separately defined complete-correctness indicator if the evaluator supports it. C=C1+1{REPAIR_ONCE}*C2 and E[C]=E[C1]+E[1{REPAIR_ONCE}*C2]; factorization is not assumed.
mathematical_basis.stopping: All stopping happens from frozen public rules before private grading. Campaign N is fixed. A later confidence interval is descriptive or fixed-N inference under its stated assumptions, not permission to stop early when a convenient significance level appears.

assumptions: A fixed public registry distinguishes demonstrated errors from absent evidence and unsupported theories.
EIS negative-selection fixtures and false-rejection controls are answer-independent, versioned and disjoint from any fixtures used to choose detector thresholds.
The public repair packet cannot expose expected corrections from private evaluation; PCIV only mutates the allowed wrapper/repair instructions while preserving seed bytes.
An early accepted result is merely an unchecked answer with bounded public evidence. Neither coverage nor zero public defects certifies the complete derivation.
ideas.hypothesis: Relative to always-repair two-call execution, the gate reduces mean realized provider spend by at least 15% while losing no more than 3 points in unconditional mean rubric score; both conditions must hold with the preregistered uncertainty treatment.

stages.instruction: Pin seed bytes, wrappers, detector controls, typed branch operations and both potential call ceilings. Validate finite host limits and fail closed on uncertain pricing. Do not run the seed to tune thresholds.

Produce a complete answer to every seed request with a compact claim/assumption map and explicit unresolved obligations. Seed remains a separate exact-byte message. The admitted completion cap is 2600 tokens including billable reasoning where applicable.

Freeze C1, invoke PFP public checks and EIS fixture-bound rules, then apply the preregistered decision table. STOP means no flagged repairable defect, not proven correctness. A budget or infrastructure issue yields an explicit partial/abstention outcome; missing mathematical support stays OPEN. Record the counterfactual rule conditions without private labels.

Dispatch only on Repair and known settled prior billing, with unchanged seed plus the public artifact and bounded defect codes. Return a 1600-token bounded patch or explicit inability. No automatic retry. Patches cannot alter seed assumptions or erase unsupported obligations. Non-Repair branches produce a host Skipped token and incur no call.

Apply only well-formed patches linked to declared claims, replay affected public checks, and preserve the original response. If patch verification fails, keep the original with unresolved status rather than inventing a successful repair. Freeze final bytes, coverage, statuses and cost receipt. Close every branch before separate private grading.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Direct same-model call at matched assigned money/token allowance, and always-repair using exactly the same draft/patch prompts and ceilings; the latter is the primary cost-saving comparator.
ablations: Randomly skip the second slot at a preregistered fixed probability, separating detector value from generic economizing
Always deliver the first artifact without selective status
Use single-signal detector matches for continuation only, preserving direct host integrity refusals
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Report unconditional raw rubric score, operational delivered utility, abstention and partial rates, score-loss coverage curve at the one preregistered gate, actual spend and both time metrics. Selected-answer accuracy is secondary. Validate the gate using synthetic valid/invalid receipts including missing usage, checker exception, exact contradiction and unsupported expression. Retain all assigned failures; grade missingness gets bounds. Any extra gate thresholds are exploratory or increase K.

ideas.falsification: Reject the declared savings/noninferiority conjunction if either the upper confidence bound on savings is below 15% or the upper confidence bound on the score difference is below -3 points; intervals crossing the thresholds are inconclusive. Any path labeling unsupported mathematics as certified or hiding abstentions from the denominator falsifies the mechanism contract.
risks: Reducing coverage alone can improve accepted-only accuracy, so that metric cannot establish benefit.
The gate might spend more often on intrinsically difficult outputs; naive repaired-versus-unrepaired comparisons are confounded and are not causal evidence.
Public fixed thresholds can be overfit to the same seed after viewing grades; no within-campaign changes are permitted.
A short patch can leave stale downstream dependencies; replay is required and residuals remain visible.
ideas.budget_formula: Cmax<=15000*p_in+4200*p_out+F1+F2+R<=USD 0.046 at the conditional ceilings. Actual cost equals the first-call bill plus a second-call bill only when dispatched, plus priced fees. Reserve for the worst branch before admission; unused capacity is a measured saving, never an automatic extra retry.

ideas.name: Deadline-frozen two-candidate portfolio with serial and parallel schedules

mathematical_basis.known_method: Bounded algorithm portfolios, fork/join scheduling and performance profiles under a fixed deadline.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Create two complete candidate attempts with fixed PCIV wrapper variants, neither seeing the other, and compare parallel dispatch with serial dispatch using the same two-call allowance and public selector. At a preregistered deadline, freeze a usable completed candidate or abstain. This directly measures whether concurrency buys delivery latency on the fixed seed without pretending it reduces total provider work or cost.
mathematical_basis.time_model: Let dj be each observed dispatch-to-terminal duration and h total host overhead. Without queue contention, parallel wall latency is approximately h+max(d1,d2), serial wall latency approximately h+d1+d2; serialtime_proxy=d1+d2 in both schedules. Actual timestamps, concurrency contention and transport time override this approximation. Provider-reported compute time, if absent, is unavailable rather than inferred.
mathematical_basis.deadline_rule: D is fixed before dispatch and measured from run admission. At D choose only schema-usable candidates whose full bytes arrived and public checks completed by D using the same fixed selector; deterministic slot ID breaks ties. No usable candidate yields abstention. Late results are retained for accounting and a clearly separate offline sensitivity analysis, never substituted into the frozen primary result. Client cancellation does not release an uncertain billing reservation.
mathematical_basis.resource_rule: Use two predeclared full-answer variants with 2200-token ceilings; no extra synthesis/judge call. The serial comparator starts slot 2 only if policy permits before D, with an undisbursed reservation otherwise unused. Keep assigned two-slot allowance fixed and compare actual dispatch/cost separately. A second no-deadline paired panel isolates scheduling overhead from deadline censoring.

assumptions: The provider permits the declared concurrency and documents charge/token caps. Concurrency itself may induce queueing or rate limits, which are measured rather than assumed absent.
Both PCIV wrapper variants preserve the full immutable seed and are fixed before execution; no specialized seed subproblem or derived formula is substituted.
The final selector uses only PFP/EIS public receipts and slot IDs. It does not select by a private score, model self-confidence, or answer agreement.
A strict wall deadline includes bounded host validation time; the adapter must reserve time to freeze a result and label any missed deadline explicitly.
ideas.hypothesis: At equal monetary and output-token allowance, parallel scheduling increases the fraction of assigned runs delivering a candidate by the fixed deadline, with at most a 3-point reduction in unconditional mean rubric score; any latency advantage must be reported alongside unchanged or higher actual aggregate spend and serialtime_proxy.

stages.instruction: Create two typed operations from protected PCIV wrapper variants. Randomize schedule/run order within preregistered blocks. Reserve both worst-case calls transactionally before parallel dispatch; set an absolute deadline and a fixed host-check margin. No private feedback is available.

Receive the entire unchanged seed and variant A. Return a complete compact derivation with claim IDs and explicit open obligations, at most 2200 billable output/reasoning tokens. No access to B, filesystem, retrieval or evaluator. Execute when the scheduler assigns slot A; scheduler order is an explicit resource constraint rather than a data dependency.

Receive the entire unchanged seed and variant B, never A's output. Use the same 2200-token ceiling. Parallel mode starts both ready operations; serial mode permits only one active call and randomizes which slot goes first. If the deadline or uncertain billing forbids dispatch, return NotDispatched with no provider request.

Treat every dependency as a total terminal result including PendingAtDeadline, not an instruction to wait forever for both providers. Apply bounded PFP/EIS checks to arrived candidates, choose via the fixed selector, and retain detector/control receipts. OPERADS type compatibility alone does not validate this deadline semantics; the scheduler adapter needs synthetic event-trace tests.

Freeze chosen bytes or abstention no later than the admitted deadline, recording a miss if overhead exceeds it. Late provider settlement is append-only accounting outside the answer-producing DAG; never change selected bytes. All charged or uncertain work remains in the aggregate ledger and denominator. Private grading begins only after campaign output freeze.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Direct same-model one-call answer with matching assigned total monetary/token allowance, plus serial execution of the identical two candidate operations as the primary scheduling comparator.
ablations: Parallel candidates with identical wrappers, isolating diversity from scheduling
Choose the fixed first usable slot instead of ranking public receipts
No-deadline execution of both schedules, keeping both calls and reporting complete-run latency separately
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Use a fixed deadline chosen from infrastructure-only timing pilots or a user latency requirement, never from private seed scores. Report deadline-delivery fraction over all assigned runs, unconditional rubric score, abstention, per-slot error/rate-limit counts, actual tokens/costs, critical-path wall latency and sum of observed call durations. Completed-by-deadline results are the primary endpoint; survivor-only latency summaries and late-result scoring are secondary and explicitly labeled. Shared endpoint contention means paired blocks need workload isolation or a descriptive caveat.

ideas.falsification: A simultaneous upper confidence bound at or below zero for the deadline-delivery improvement rejects a positive scheduling benefit. A score-difference upper bound below -3 points rejects the noninferiority requirement. A late candidate replacing the frozen answer, a third model call, or a cancellation treated as zero cost falsifies the implementation contract.
risks: Parallel calls can worsen queueing, throttle each other or multiply timeouts; shorter theoretical critical path is not observed benefit.
Selecting among completed candidates creates completion-time selection bias; keep late, failed and undispatched slots visible.
Polling/stream parsing overhead can miss the wall deadline even if the provider completed earlier.
Changing wrapper diversity, schedule and selector simultaneously confounds mechanisms; retain the serial identical-body control and fixed ablations.
ideas.budget_formula: Two calls maximum. Cmax<=12000*p_in+4400*p_out+F1+F2+R<=USD 0.044 at the conditional ceilings. Parallel dispatch holds both reservations before any request. Deadline expiry never refunds an uncertain call. Serial and parallel have equal assigned limits; actual realized costs may differ because the serial second slot can remain undispatched.

recommended_reusable_primitive.name: FrozenPolicyRunReceiptV1
recommended_reusable_primitive.recommendation: Implement a typed run/policy receipt and deterministic host-only scheduler simulator before any paid experiment. It connects randomized allocation, selective continuation and deadline portfolios without introducing a semantic correctness bit.
recommended_reusable_primitive.invariant: The generation/selection DAG has no edge from delayed evaluation. All stage result types include bounded failure/skip outcomes, every paid stage consumes a unique reservation, and no model path can make more than two calls or exceed the conditional USD 0.10 run quote. Receipt fields distinguish actual observations from estimates and preserve residuals; typed composition does not establish semantic truth.
recommended_reusable_primitive.research_prompt_instruction: Implement only the policy compiler and synthetic scheduler/receipt fixtures first. Do not read or solve the seed, inspect private key storage, or make paid provider calls. Include positive/negative fixtures for duplicate dispatch, concurrent reservations, delayed billing, deadline censoring, hidden-feedback rejection, deterministic assignment, protected seed mutation and missing accounting.
recommended_reusable_primitive.first_experiment: After host-only validation and separately authorized campaign admission, preregister a small fixed-N R09-I01 comparison with a direct same-model baseline. Keep all outputs and the entire campaign frozen before grading. Report it as a pilot on one item if precision is inadequate; do not turn a wide or selected positive estimate into a general workflow-improvement claim.

research_agent_reports.focus: Nonredundant hybrids: compositional blindness, countermodel-based premise audits, and identifiable mechanism interactions

scope.source_baseline: 8050c66900899771766f33e8f5fdd200b7dd9120 plus the in-progress dag audit and research_01 through research_09
scope.seed_access: Did not read seed_prompt.txt, any answer key, its path, private storage, or any paid-model output. Only FOUNDATIONS.md, EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL.md, research_01..09, selected source code, and composition_catalog.json metadata were inspected. No task-specific answer or derived seed formula is included.
scope.novelty_claim: Adaptations to this repository, not literature-wide inventions. Information-flow control, bounded countermodel search, and factorial experiments are established methods. Each idea identifies its nearest prior report and the additional mechanism or estimand.
scope.implementation_boundary: The information-flow compiler, premise encoder/replayer, and factorial assignment contract below are proposals. Native port checks, lineage taint, exact rational arithmetic, and existing selection code do not implement them or certify graduate-QM reasoning.
scope.benchmark_isolation: Every model stage receives the identical original UTF-8 seed as a separate immutable message, with request assembly checked for actual byte inclusion as well as seed and request hashes. Wrappers and audit artifacts are separate. No stage has repository retrieval, shell, filesystem, private-evaluator, or answer-key tools. Private scoring occurs only after final output is frozen and never returns to workflow stages.
scope.catalog_boundary: At inspection the catalog metadata recorded nine reports and 3836 candidates in a finite ordered-macro slice. Its exclusions explicitly omit general multi-input/campaign operations and implicit fan-out. Adding this report does not update that count or make the enumeration exhaustive. Proposed single-consumer packet chains require concrete product schemas, exact native port contracts and a broker implementation before lowering.
scope.external_envelope: A partially applied workflow with every policy/checker/control bundle frozen can expose RunContext -> Outcome. The uninstantiated mechanisms do not have that type: I01 requires VisibilityContract and SyntheticLeakPanel; I02 requires PublicPremiseTheory and ReferenceReplay; I03 requires a campaign-generated FactorialAssignment and frozen FactorialProtocol. These may be explicitly bundled into an extended RunContext but cannot be manufactured from a prior Outcome. Native compilation must retain every unsatisfied external input.

primary_sources.title: Sabelfeld and Myers, Language-Based Information-Flow Security, IEEE JSAC 2003
primary_sources.relevance: Source for language-level information-flow policies and security typing. We adapt the distinction between access permission and downstream propagation to preservation of experimentally blind stages; this is a proposed application, not a proven security implementation.

primary_sources.title: Alloy Language Reference, official Alloy distribution
primary_sources.relevance: Defines assertion counterexamples relative to model facts and finite analysis scope. Motivates explicit premise satisfiability and bounded countermodel receipts; failure to find a finite counterexample is not an unrestricted theorem.

primary_sources.title: NIST/SEMATECH Engineering Statistics Handbook, 5.4.3 How to model DOE data
primary_sources.relevance: Full factorial designs distinguish main effects and interactions, while fractional designs need alias assumptions. Motivates a full two-factor experiment rather than attributing a hybrid's performance to each named subsystem.

repository_evidence.observation: Separates declared witness checking, finite detector tests, metric-relative selection, typed substitution, and intended semantic adequacy. None supplies an end-to-end graduate-QM checker.
Preserves the exact seed, excludes the private evaluator from all online stages, requires repeated same-item comparisons and one complete-run USD 0.10 ledger.

Metadata has nine research reports; only a declared finite grammar is enumerated. External campaign/control inputs and general fan-out are excluded; blind stages and shared reservations must survive composition.
Repair rules are host-authored because raw judge text may contain answers. Missing checkers and checker disagreements are infrastructure/checker failures rather than positive evidence.

LineageTaintEngineV1 propagates marked ancestry in one pass over supplied edges. Unsorted edges can require another pass; it is not a general transitive information-flow analysis and tracks no control dependence.
Inheritance edges require a sealed witness naming parent and child and reject cycles. A lineage seal does not prove absence of unrecorded prompt/context channels.
The mutation service applies edits with protected spans and rechecks exact bytes. Its content-addressed child can record wrapper variants without changing the seed.

Clean-panel screening does not admit a detector. evaluate_rule activates a probe to avoid vacuous success from an inactive matcher. Similar positive and negative controls are needed for leakage and premise detectors.
The independent-signal entry point checks explicit evidence provenance before conjunction. That interface is not a statistical-independence theorem and cannot repair shared parser errors.
Native port equality includes name, colour, schema reference/digest and validator reference/digest. Human-readable RunContext/Outcome names do not suffice for a bridge.
Agent slices restrict operation and source/target colours, but the method does not examine request bytes, control dependencies, tools, caches, or broker-visible fields.
Compilation accepts a finite single-consumer graph with injected validation, checks source pins and full ordered interface, and explicitly grants no admission or execution authority.
Exact rational input rejects floats/booleans and enforces canonical positive denominators; it can replay bounded rational witnesses but is not a complete symbolic/QM model finder.
Selection requires paired records, provenance and fresh confirmation. Its improvement predicate is not an estimator of a factorial interaction; the latter needs a separately preregistered analysis.

common_budget_policy.formula: For a complete assigned run reserve C_max = sum_s(I_s*p_in_s + O_s*p_out_s + F_s) + R + C_metered_host + C_paid_evaluation <= USD 0.10 before the first call. Prices are USD/token. Count the unchanged seed, system/schema messages and prior visible artifacts in I_s, and every billable reasoning/output token in O_s. Account for every branch, helper, fallback, cancellation and retry; all proposed runs have at most two model calls, zero automatic retries and zero model fallbacks.
common_budget_policy.conditional_example: All examples assume pinned endpoints with p_in <= 0.000001, p_out <= 0.000005, F_s=0, R=USD0.01, zero incremental unmetered host cost and no paid scoring call. I01 reserves USD0.043; I02 and each assigned I03 run reserve USD0.046. These are admission thresholds, not quotations of current prices. Unknown fees or uncapped reasoning cause refusal.
common_budget_policy.fail_closed: Both slots share one durable ledger. Input tokenization, endpoint price semantics and hard output caps must be validated before admission. Timeout/cancellation retains the full uncertain reservation. An overlong request is refused or the run frozen incomplete; never truncate or rewrite the seed. Any paid post-freeze scoring must fit the same cap and call allowance or be refused.
common_budget_policy.host_bounds: I01: at most 64 workflow nodes, 128 edges and 64 synthetic twin-trace probes. I02: at most 8 claims, 8 premises per claim, 256 assignments per explicit finite carrier, 512 AST nodes per claim, 256-bit integer arithmetic. I03: same frozen bounded checker per arm. Each host pass has 2-second CPU and 256-MiB limits; limit exhaustion is OPEN_RESOURCE, never success.
common_budget_policy.campaign: The run cap is not campaign-spend authorization. For I03 each assigned arm is one complete two-call run; a replicated four-arm campaign contains 4N runs and up to 8N calls, needs a separate aggregate budget and randomized fixed-N plan, and is not hidden inside one USD0.10 invocation.
common_budget_policy.receipts: Retain request/seed/response hashes, endpoint/version and price snapshot, reserved and settled costs, all available provider usage fields, wall time, sum of provider durations, refusal/truncation/timeout states and final freeze time. Unavailable fields are unavailable, not zero. Zero actual paid calls were made.

ideas.name: Information-flow certificates that preserve blind stages under composition

mathematical_basis.known_method: Information-flow typing, provenance propagation and relational noninterference tests.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Compile each stage's declared visibility into an origin-set effect alongside its mathematical port type. PFP binds the exact materialized request to a contract; PCIV records wrapper and broker transformations; EIS screens the compiler with benign and deliberately leaking synthetic controls; OPERADS rejects substitutions whose information effects exceed the recipient's allowed view. Demonstrate it on a complete solver followed by a candidate-blind challenge call, while keeping the challenge input independent of the solver output.
mathematical_basis.rule: For a node v, L(v) contains its direct data origins plus all data and control-dependency origins. In a DAG compute the union in topological order, or reach a fixed point. A request for blind role b is allowed only if L(request_b) is a subset of Allowed(b). Candidate presence, candidate-derived IDs/hashes, exception strings, token counts and dispatch decisions are origins too. Merely renaming or hashing a field does not declassify it.
mathematical_basis.relational_obligation: For deterministic request compiler K, synthetic hidden inputs h,h' and identical public p and randomness r, require Observe_b(K(p,h,r)) = Observe_b(K(p,h',r)). Observe includes exact message bytes, tools, model/settings, budget allowance, dispatch flag and routing metadata. Challenges must be scheduled independently of candidate content. Finite twin probes falsify leaks but do not prove noninterference for arbitrary code. Real provider timing/cache channels are outside this bounded claim and recorded as residual.
mathematical_basis.system_bridge: A compiler receipt names the pinned request builder and field-level origin derivation. That receipt is consumed by the broker before dispatch; a separate synthetic mutation panel challenges the same builder, not a textual copy. Lineage-only OR taint is insufficient because wrapper choice can leak via control flow.
mathematical_basis.distinct_from_prior: R05-I02 proposes candidate-blind challenge generation, and R08-I03 tests fault propagation. This proposal tests whether that blindness survives composition, including implicit channels and a correct-colour but wrong-visibility substitution. It does not claim a new challenge strategy or that two same-model calls have independent errors.
mathematical_basis.external_signature: (RunContext, VisibilityContract, SyntheticLeakPanel, PinnedRequestBuilder) -> OutcomeWithVisibilityReceipt. RunContext -> Outcome is valid only after the three external bundles are independently supplied and frozen; no prior candidate Outcome can supply a clean calibration panel or retroactively authorize visibility.
mathematical_basis.native_lowering: Use a serial product packet with a host-only sealed candidate and separately materialized model views. Passing a host packet down one edge is not permission to serialize all its fields into the model. No implicit native fan-out or coercion from candidate-sealed to candidate-visible ports.

assumptions: The trusted broker has no private answer key, private evaluator route, filesystem/repository retrieval or model conversation history beyond the explicitly constructed messages.
Allowed origin sets, synthetic leak/benign fixtures, observation fields and request-builder source pins are frozen before seeing a candidate.
Host-only sealed artifacts are inaccessible to the model transport adapter; all referenced views have concrete schemas and validators.
Timing, provider caching and underlying model pretraining may correlate attempts; absence of declared data flow does not establish statistical independence.
ideas.hypothesis: On a held-out synthetic composition panel, origin/control-flow enforcement blocks every preregistered candidate-to-blind-role leak while rejecting at most 2% of valid compositions, and catches more leaks than colour-only or data-lineage-only enforcement. The benchmark accuracy effect is measured separately and may be zero.

stages.instruction: Bind external inputs, reserve both calls, preserve the exact seed, and build isolated model views. PrivateEvaluation is not an input type.

Check topological data/control-origin closure and run finite twin probes against the pinned builder. Public synthetic values only; never use real private storage as a leak probe. Any prohibited observed dependency refuses dispatch.

Receive only the unchanged seed and frozen answer instructions. Produce one complete derivation with public claim IDs. The broker stores output in a host-only field and retains both pre-reserved slots.

Receive only the unchanged seed and the preregistered generic challenge grammar. Never receive candidate bytes, length, hashes, checks, confidence or candidate-dependent routing. Emit up to four public predicate tests without producing or endorsing a full task answer. Dispatch remains fixed even if the first response is unusable, except run-wide infrastructure refusal.

Only after both outputs are frozen, apply admissible public tests and annotate the original answer. Do not splice or repair it. Record bounded visibility assurance, unresolved channels and all failures. Trusted private grading is strictly afterward.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: The same two-call solver/challenger schedule with ordinary port-colour checks and the same token caps; host-only synthetic tests compare composition enforcement before any paid benchmark.
ablations: Origin tags without control-dependency propagation
Correct type checks with full-packet serialization enabled in the synthetic harness
Data-flow enforcement without twin-trace compiler probes
Compiler probes without pinned request-builder identity
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Use disjoint public development and confirmation compositions. Leak fixtures include candidate-conditioned wrapper selection, candidate hashes, swallowed-error text and shared-history serialization; benign fixtures carry host-only artifacts without exposing them. Report leaks admitted, benign refusals, OPEN channels and complete-answer score/cost separately. No intentionally leaking paid seed run is required.

ideas.falsification: Any known prohibited origin appearing in an admitted blind request falsifies the contract. A candidate-dependent dispatch choice also falsifies it even when message text is unchanged. Failing the false-refusal threshold or showing no gain over data-only taint falsifies the practical hypothesis; unchanged QM scores do not invalidate a genuine isolation improvement.
risks: Incomplete origin instrumentation or a shared buggy serializer can satisfy both type checks and synthetic probes.
An opaque model/provider can have undeclared cache/history channels beyond the observed broker boundary.
Copying only a candidate hash still breaks strict candidate blindness; cryptographic opacity is not noninterference.
The challenge pattern is inherited from earlier research; the novel contribution is enforceable visibility at composition, not an additional correctness witness.
ideas.budget_formula: Two calls, zero retries: I_total<=12000; O_total<=4200 (3600+600). C_max<=12000*p_in+4200*p_out+sum(F_s)+R+C_metered_host+C_paid_evaluation. Under common conditional assumptions reserve USD0.043. Every later added compiler/helper/judge call consumes the same two-call and USD0.10 limits.

ideas.name: Premise stress tests with replayable finite countermodels

mathematical_basis.known_method: Bounded model finding, antecedent satisfiability checks and countermodels for premise dependence.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Require candidate inference claims to expose a bounded, independently interpretable premise context. The host enumerates a frozen public carrier and separately tests whether the antecedent has any instances, whether the stated implication has a countermodel, and which declared premise omissions admit countermodels. EIS reports distinct vacuity, invalid-inference and dependence findings; PCIV produces a single wrapper patch tied to a replayed witness; OPERADS keeps audit-view hypotheses separate from immutable task premises.
mathematical_basis.finite_queries: For explicit finite Omega and candidate Gamma={a1,...,ak}, Q, let S={w in Omega: all a in Gamma hold}; W0={w in S: not Q(w)}. For each j let Wj={w in Omega: all a_i with i!=j hold, not a_j(w), and not Q(w)}. Nonempty W0 is a checked countermodel to the encoded implication. Empty S is VACUOUS_IN_SCOPE, not proof of global inconsistency. Nonempty Wj demonstrates that dropping a_j permits a failure in this finite interpretation; it does not prove a_j is globally necessary or scientifically causal.
mathematical_basis.countermodel_scope: A valuation over uninterpreted atoms may be unrealizable under the intended mathematics. Such valuations are only abstract dependency diagnostics. A claim-level refutation requires a concrete witness satisfying a separately checked decoder and every original domain constraint. Empty W0 is NO_COUNTERMODEL_IN_SCOPE unless Omega is demonstrably the entire declared finite domain; it never certifies an unbounded analytic statement.
mathematical_basis.system_bridge: PFP's relation is encoded-premises-and-counterexample, checked by independent exact replay. The EIS signal is the replayed failed implication or vacuous scope, not agreement with the solver. PCIV records the public witness class and a protected wrapper edit. OPERADS ports distinguish OriginalTaskContext from AuditContextMinusPremise and forbid substituting the latter for the former.
mathematical_basis.distinct_from_prior: R01-I01 checks dependency closure; R01-I02 checks formula definedness/branch coverage; R08-I02 challenges extractor distinctions; R05-I02 generates blind tests. This mechanism instead searches for premise inconsistency and relative premise necessity in a fixed finite interpretation, including cases where every listed parent is present but the implication is invalid or vacuous.
mathematical_basis.external_signature: (RunContext, PublicPremiseTheory, FiniteCarrier, ReferenceReplay) -> OutcomeWithPremiseAudit. These theory/decoder inputs must be frozen independently of private scores. A solver-generated premise AST is untrusted input, not authority to define the host theory. Missing interpretation produces OPEN_UNSUPPORTED rather than an invented checker.

assumptions: Only explicit finite relations, bounded Boolean formulas with independently justified interpretation, and bounded exact-rational ASTs are admitted.
Candidate claims remain linked to original seed obligations; audit deletions never modify seed bytes, task assumptions or the final requested scope.
The independent replayer does not reuse the candidate evaluator's parsing/normalization path for every critical operation.
Countermodels or apparent vacuity under abstract/unrealizable interpretations are not passed off as task errors; each receipt carries its interpretation scope.
ideas.hypothesis: Against dependency-closure checking alone, premise stress testing detects more injected vacuous or invalid local implications on an untouched synthetic panel while preserving every supported valid implication; on the frozen seed it reduces unqualified use of extra assumptions without losing more than 3 rubric points at equal total resources.

stages.instruction: Freeze public interpretation, bounds and controls; reserve the two-call envelope and include exact original seed bytes. Refuse a theory bundle derived from private seed labels.

Return a complete answer and at most eight local implication claims with explicit premise ASTs and public-obligation bindings. Do not select or relabel host interpretation rules. Extra assumptions must be identified as extra.

Evaluate S,W0,Wj within the declared carrier, replay selected witnesses independently, and preserve all original task assumptions. Select at most four findings in fixed claim-ID order. A failed realization bridge remains abstract; empty search and resource exhaustion are never correctness.

Receive the unchanged seed, original candidate and only allowlisted public claim IDs, premise IDs, scope labels and witness classes. Correct the original derivation or qualify unresolved local steps; never weaken the task. No private evaluator feedback and no second search/repair cycle.

Apply schema-valid claim patches, recheck changed public implications and dependency receipts, retain the original if patch binding fails, and freeze answer plus all unresolved premise/encoding obligations. Public finite checks remain separate from private mathematical grading.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Same two-call complete draft plus dependency/context audit and one repair, with identical endpoint, input/output ceilings and checker CPU allowance.
ablations: Countermodel search without antecedent satisfiability
No premise-removal views
Shared candidate/replay evaluator instead of separately implemented replay
Abstract Boolean witnesses accepted without realization checks, in synthetic controls only
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Synthetic confirmation families include inconsistent antecedents, an omitted necessary premise, a genuinely redundant premise, a valid implication with no sampled antecedent instance, and unrealizable Boolean countermodels. Report scope-conditioned false refutations, witnessed invalid implications, vacuity findings, premise coverage, original-answer completeness and later trusted rubric score.

ideas.falsification: A purported concrete countermodel that fails an original domain constraint falsifies the replay bridge. Treating an empty sampled antecedent as globally inconsistent, or an empty search as a universal proof, falsifies the reporting contract. No increased detection over closure-only checking, any false refutation of supported valid fixtures, or violation of the preregistered accuracy-loss margin defeats the stated benefit.
risks: An independent finite interpretation may be unavailable for the seed's analytic claims; many results may correctly remain OPEN.
Candidate and replayer may share the same erroneous semantic encoding even when their arithmetic code differs.
A premise needed in one finite carrier need not be globally minimal, and a redundant premise need not be safe to delete from the user's requested formulation.
A patch may repair its abstract encoding while leaving prose wrong; unlinked prose remains unchecked.
ideas.budget_formula: Two calls, zero retries: I_total<=14000; O_total<=4400 (3000+1400). C_max<=14000*p_in+4400*p_out+sum(F_s)+R+C_metered_host+C_paid_evaluation. Under common conditional assumptions reserve USD0.046, with all public searches local and bounded.

ideas.name: Factorial isolation of proof-context and diagnostic-repair synergy

mathematical_basis.known_method: A randomized full 2x2 factorial experiment identifies interactions separately from main effects.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Fix one two-call draft/repair graph. Factor A adds typed premise/dependency context to the draft and host validation. Factor B replaces generic repair instructions with a calibrated, allowlisted public diagnostic packet. PCIV freezes the four wrapper configurations and their ancestry, PFP checks candidate-bound artifacts, EIS supplies the fixed diagnostic intervention, and OPERADS guarantees the same input/output skeleton and visibility policy in every arm. Each run executes only its assigned arm.
mathematical_basis.estimand: For fixed-seed expected final rubric score mu_ab under A=a,B=b, define Delta=mu_11-mu_10-mu_01+mu_00. With Y=beta0+betaA*A+betaB*B+betaAB*A*B+error and 0/1 coding, betaAB=Delta. Positive individual gains do not imply Delta>0. Report all four cell means, marginal contrasts and Delta; do not claim every named subsystem contributes from mu_11 alone.
mathematical_basis.design: Use equal allocation within preregistered time/model blocks, fresh provider samples, fixed N per cell, no arm selection from private outcomes, and intention-to-treat inclusion of refusals/truncations/timeouts. Endpoint/settings and total output allowance are equal across arms. Actual input/cost differences remain measured; equal-token and equal-money comparisons are distinct preregistered analyses, not assumed identical.
mathematical_basis.finite_uncertainty: For independent bounded scores Y in [0,100] and N samples per cell, Hoeffding plus a union bound gives simultaneous mean radius epsilon=100*sqrt(log(8/alpha)/(2*N)). Then Delta is within plus/minus 4*epsilon of the plug-in contrast with confidence at least 1-alpha under those assumptions. This deliberately conservative bound can be inconclusive; no invented small-N significance or cross-problem generalization. Blocking/randomization may justify a tighter preregistered randomization analysis.
mathematical_basis.distinct_from_prior: R04-I03 studies operation order; R09-I01 randomizes repair versus re-derivation; R03-I01 compares sibling wrappers. This experiment isolates the interaction of two independently toggled mechanisms at a fixed order and fixed call count. A hybrid win with zero or negative Delta is reported as additive benefit or interference, not synergy.
mathematical_basis.external_signature: Single assigned run: (RunContext, FactorialAssignment, FrozenFactorialProtocol, CalibratedPublicCheckerBundle) -> OutcomeWithArmReceipt. Analysis: (FrozenOutcomes, PostFreezeTrustedScores, FactorialProtocol) -> InteractionReport. The analysis is a separate offline campaign operator, not RunContext -> Outcome and not eligible for blind solver composition.
mathematical_basis.composition_constraint: No four-arm branch executes inside a run. Four isolated invocations form a campaign block, each with its own complete-run cap and an aggregate campaign ledger. Private scores enter only the terminal offline analysis, which has no edge back to wrappers, selection or either model call.

assumptions: All four configurations are semantically the same full unchanged seed task; disabling A removes optional artifact structure, never requested mathematical content or task assumptions.
The same public checker definitions apply wherever an arm has a parseable artifact; missing machine-readable claims remain unavailable rather than being counted correct.
Factor B's off arm still performs the same bounded generic revision and final public measurement; it simply receives no candidate-specific detector guidance before revision.
Assignments and sample sizes are frozen before results. Repetitions estimate provider variability on one item; shared model/parser biases remain possible in every cell.
ideas.hypothesis: The joint mechanism has Delta at least +3 rubric points and mu_11 is no more than 2 points below the best single-mechanism arm, while every assigned run respects USD0.10 and two calls. Claim synergy only if the preregistered interval supports the +3 threshold; otherwise report inconclusive or antagonistic interaction.

stages.instruction: Verify the precommitted arm and external checker provenance. Reserve just this run's two calls under its cap and the already-authorized aggregate campaign budget. Preserve the exact seed and fixed graph shape.

Receive the unchanged seed and exactly the assigned A wrapper. A=1 requests premise/dependency artifact context; A=0 requests the same full derivation with ordinary section labels. Both have identical output ceilings.

Run fixed public checks without private scoring. B=1 exposes only calibrated, scope-labelled public diagnostic classes; B=0 supplies the fixed generic revision instruction. Bind diagnostics to the draft hash. Do not adapt the selected arm or spend ceiling.

Receive the unchanged seed, draft and assigned revision view. Return a complete revised answer under the same 1600-token ceiling in all arms, with explicit unresolved parts if needed. No additional judge or synthesis call.

Run the same final public measurements and freeze the revised answer, or an explicit failure when no usable revision exists, with both raw artifacts retained. Later trusted scores belong only to offline analysis. No best-arm selection or prompt update occurs within this protocol.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: A=0,B=0 is the same-model two-call draft plus generic revision baseline. A=1,B=0 and A=0,B=1 identify the single-mechanism controls; A=1,B=1 is the hybrid.
ablations: Remove candidate binding from diagnostics only in public fault controls
Replace calibrated diagnostics with length-matched generic guidance in a separately budgeted follow-up, not an unregistered fifth primary arm
Compare raw draft and final response offline to locate repair-induced harm without choosing between them online
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: The campaign has four cells, not one eight-call run. Record every raw score/cost and all failures before aggregation. Report common failure clusters across all cells to expose shared-semantic/parser errors. Freeze one primary interaction contrast and uncertainty method; additional contrasts are labelled exploratory. No score-driven PCIV promotion until a separately preregistered fresh confirmation experiment.

ideas.falsification: If the interaction interval excludes +3 from above, the specified synergy hypothesis fails; an interval spanning the threshold is inconclusive. Unequal call counts, answer-key-dependent assignment, hidden arm-specific retries or dropping failed runs invalidate the comparison. A positive Delta cannot certify the checker or imply transfer beyond this item.
risks: Short revised-answer caps may create arm-specific truncation; that is an observed failure, not permission to silently expand one arm.
Typed contexts consume prompt/output space, so equal ceilings estimate the complete mechanism package rather than an isolated zero-cost mathematical effect.
A common faulty parser or shared model misconception can make all arms agree while remaining wrong.
Four-arm replication can require substantial aggregate spend despite small per-run costs; no campaign has been authorized or launched here.
ideas.budget_formula: Each assigned run makes exactly two planned calls and zero retries: I_total<=14000; O_total<=4400 (2800+1600). Conditional reserve USD0.046 per complete run. A four-cell block reserves up to USD0.184 at these thresholds, or USD0.40 at the absolute per-run caps, and needs separate aggregate authorization. Offline analysis uses no paid model calls.

recommended_reusable_primitive.name: VisibilityAndContextBoundaryV1
recommended_reusable_primitive.recommendation: Start with a host-owned packet/view contract separating immutable task context, model-visible public artifacts, host-only artifacts and offline private evaluation. Validate it on synthetic compositions before any benchmark call.
recommended_reusable_primitive.invariant: A composition cannot erase an origin, turn an audit premise deletion into a task change, grant a blind stage candidate access, or create external calibration/campaign authority from a solver Outcome. Each explicitly declassified field requires a separately frozen allowlist rule; private evaluation is never declassified to the workflow.
recommended_reusable_primitive.research_prompt_instruction: Implement only generic host-boundary contracts and public synthetic controls. Do not read or solve the frozen seed, include seed-specific answers, consult private storage, or launch paid calls. Preserve exact seed bytes when a later authorized broker injects them.
recommended_reusable_primitive.first_experiment: Host-only synthetic noninterference and premise-replay tests, then a separately authorized fixed-arm pilot. The factorial campaign is a later independently budgeted experiment; no experiments or paid calls were executed in this report.

composition_space.exhaustiveness_scope: All distinct ordered solver pairs and solver-to-annotation pairs in this pinned registry; all length 3..4 ordered research-solver permutations satisfying paid-call/node bounds. This is not every possible operadic tree, branch structure, model setting, parameter choice or future idea.
composition_space.definition_of_nontrivial: At least two distinct mechanisms connected by an explicit producer-consumer bridge; order is retained. Administrative renaming and JSON key order are quotiented; stochastic draws, prompt order and distinct mechanism orders are not identified.
excluded_grammars: Campaign/transfer/detector-construction operations require independent typed external inputs and are retained as standalone catalog entries; they are not cast from a solver response.
Opaque historical macros occur only in pairs until internal calls, stages and applicability are pinned.
General multi-input trees and native fan-out require additional adapters and are not enumerated in this slice.
No repeated mechanism, free-text parameter sweep, private-score feedback, or implicit retries.

COMPOSITION_ADMISSION_V1: Exact original seed bytes and requested conclusions remain unchanged and actually included in every solver request.
Every bridge has concrete schemas, validators, source pins and a preserving implementation; external type names alone are insufficient.

Every independently required checker/panel/theory/assignment bundle is supplied and frozen. Curried RunContext->Outcome notation does not manufacture these inputs from a prior answer. Post-freeze and offline campaign outputs have no workflow consumers.

Prior-outcome input is public candidate evidence, never trusted truth. Standalone blind/independent stages retain their visibility rules; otherwise the combination is refused or relabeled as a changed experiment.
Do not inherit integer-sum, cochain or graph checker adequacy for the QM seed. Unsupported mathematics remains OPEN.
Mutated candidates invalidate stale receipts; annotation does not upgrade a predicate-scoped result into global correctness.
Reserve the complete expanded path under a single durable USD0.10 ledger using validated input/output/reasoning/fee upper bounds and current tariffs; sum of standalone estimates is not sufficient.
Keep key and post-freeze evaluator completely outside workflow context and tools.
Apply native OPERADS restrictions if lowered there, including exact full-port equality and single-consumer outputs. No fan-out is inferred.

grad_qm_applicability.reason: Arbitrary seed can use schema_only; only integer_sum_v1 has a supplied mathematical judge. Add a QM certificate schema and pinned independent predicates before mathematical acceptance.
Slot plumbing can preserve the seed; operation/slot schemas and exact QM judges need a domain adapter.
Mining and frozen guidance can wrap the seed; integer-sum guidance and L2 checks do not certify QM. Screen for answer leakage and bind a QM contract.
Runner requires integer_sum_v1. Replace domain contract and global compatibility with independent checks of the same QM claims; consensus is insufficient.
Exact-sum source language and decoder refuse this seed. A complete reversible QM representation, protected-query map and independent decoder are required.
Use only reversible presentations of the identical seed and one fixed QM judge; one seed gives within-item evidence, not a cross-domain effect.
Separate missing-premise refusal from resource/checker refusal. Singular parameter cases in this seed are required obligations, not grounds to erase the task.
Map the five obligations to typed stages with unchanged target and hash-bound interfaces; custody does not validate the formulas.
Bounded repair applies after a QM checker and non-answer-bearing residual vocabulary are registered; cochain/parity residuals cannot be substituted.
A generic cohomological obstruction certificate is not a spectral or thermal calculation. A claimed cochain encoding needs a task-preserving bridge and its own adequacy evidence.
LP/flow/assignment/Farkas/Bareiss judges do not check this complete symbolic QM task. Design exact identity/branch certificates independently.
Fixed-seed mechanism ablations are possible with one QM judge; rank-difference carrier is not the QM task and a single seed does not measure transfer.
The existing battery is many different problems. Add this seed as one explicitly scoped domain capsule; do not count other domain passes as QM checks.
A QM-specific known-good/self and failure panel must precede detector admission; historical negative selection alone cannot establish adequacy.
Freeze opposing candidate arguments then check named QM claims. Finite modal/attack-graph checkers do not verify symbolic derivations.
Source-to-formal/symbolic translation needs relations, parameter assumptions and exceptional branches preserved; a finite table alone is insufficient.
Witness/countermodel discipline is useful, but each QM equivalence and universal claim needs its own admissible certificate; this is not a universal runner.
Replay plumbing can be adapted; the 5x5+5 finite-carrier campaign changes tasks and cannot be run as one unchanged-seed benchmark.
One seed can generate exploratory failure rules, but disjoint held-out transfer cannot be measured by repeatedly solving the same seed.
Existing finite-QM staged work has domain-specific controls and private-runtime/layout dependencies. It requires reviewed operations and task-applicable checkers, not generic C4 admission.
Protected-byte graph rewrites can attach guidance while keeping seed bytes intact. Meaning preservation of transformed formulas requires a separate checked map.
Use preregistered fixed-seed arms and explicit budgets; empirical population cost/accuracy conclusions need a declared item bank and repetitions.
Hash, version and leakage controls transfer to QM packets; audit metadata without exposing this benchmark's private key. Custody alone is not mathematical validity.
Replace nonabelian-holonomy token grammar with the declared QM certificate grammar. Operational formatting is not a correctness proof.
The seed has two spins, not a large lattice of certified flat blocks. Hierarchical holonomy decimation has no declared semantics here.
Accumulate only non-answer-bearing typed failure constraints under a QM checker. Historical leaked-answer runs are plumbing evidence only.
A stationary-loop detector can compare typed QM failure signatures. The historical full-repair hint cannot be used in a fair unchanged-seed unassisted arm.
Roles may review a frozen candidate, but l1 cochain descent needs a legitimate task-specific residual. No role or arbiter can self-certify QM.
Useful to audit a newly built QM checker using valid and adversarial branch cases; mutation survival is bounded evidence, not general checker soundness.
Adding forbidden steps or forced mathematical constraints changes the task. Such variants must be separate benchmarks, not unchanged-seed permutations.
The supplied SO(4N) referee is a different problem. Define QM evaluation and an actually hidden split; one public symbolic seed alone has no held-out task sample.
Directly useful as a claim ledger: independently checked claims, numerical examples and unverified prose receive distinct statuses.
Shared fuel and parent receipts transfer, but each re-entry must preserve the target via declared maps; loops are bounded and unrolled for a DAG.
Future-faithful compression requires a finite declared state/transition model and retention of all branch obligations; equal diagnostics do not prove equal mathematical content.
A fixed QM oracle can compare prompt/grammar channels; unavailable attention/activation hooks are explicitly non-executable arms.
Replace the cochain syndrome with complete task-specific obligations and schema guards; stage completeness is distinct from correctness.
Harness evolution needs fresh confirmation and untouched transfer panels. Tuning and grading on one seed cannot establish these claims.
A cochain primal-dual/lexicographic diagnostic is not a QM derivation score. Define independently recomputed QM predicates before ranking repairs.
Bind exact candidate bytes to registered QM verifiers and all required guards; an authority firewall cannot repair an inadequate verifier.
Typed refusal/checkpoint/restart policy applies. A restart that changes Hamiltonian, assumptions or claim set is a different task and must leave the unchanged-seed arm.
No detector was admitted by the described work. Calibrate each proposed QM detector over declared classes; finite calibration completeness needs its own class assumptions.
A graph extractor's exact cochain result covers only its image. Establish extraction adequacy for the actual QM claims before using it as evidence.
Use answer-free refusals, empty objects and constant formulas to challenge the frozen QM judge without revealing the private answer key.
Existing l1, pairing and DSL certificates are different tasks; new QM certificates require an explicit typed adapter and correctness argument.
Finite survivor selection can compare submitted formulas under declared tests; unique survivor is only relative to that family and does not prove universal validity.
Define cross-part consistency among spectral, dynamic, entanglement and thermal claims. NGD is undefined when no run has all local checks accepted.
A finite QM candidate grammar and verifier must replace sign-gauge search; checkpoint keys bind the full task and representation, with UNKNOWN retained.
Commit candidate/checker versions before tests and mutations. Keep this benchmark's key private; historical reference self-scores are not model scores.
Use explicitly typed stage/mode contracts and the unchanged QM query; existing proposal reports zero campaign cases, so it supplies no new effect estimate.

evaluation.cap_scope: aggregate all model calls, parallel branches, retries and chargeable model judges in one workflow execution
limits: One seed measures within-item behavior, not generalization.
Prompt evolution on the scored seed is exploratory adaptation, not held-out transfer.
Unknown cost or timeout retains the reservation and stops dependent calls.
Model agreement and schema success are not mathematical accuracy.
evaluation.private_evaluator: separate trusted process after outputs are frozen; no key in prompts or retrieval

workflow_wiki_documentation.completion_rule: As each workflow implementation is completed, publish its Wiki entry and navigation with procedure, mathematical scope, inputs/outputs, costs/tokens/time, validation, measured outcomes and limits. Link its DAG node; preserve private answers.
limits: Documentation does not promote proposals into executable workflows or synthetic tests into measured model improvements.
Original WF1-WF5 evidence remains task-specific historical documentation.
